jobs.title: HR Business Partner Lead
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The HR Business Partner Lead leads the people management agenda in a business unit/area, and acts as a facilitator for the company's management team.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The HR Business Partner Lead leads the people management agenda in a business unit/area, and acts as a facilitator for the company's management team. Applies broad experience in various Humana Resources (HR) areas of expertise. The HR Business Partner Lead works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The HR Business Partner Lead is a strategic advisor and trusted partner to senior business leaders across an assigned region within the PCO organization, helping shape and execute people strategies that support business priorities, strengthen organizational effectiveness, and enable a high-performing culture. This role applies broad HR expertise across talent management, workforce planning, organizational design, change leadership, compensation practices, talent acquisition, and employee engagement.


In this role, the HR Business Partner Lead will play a key part in advancing organizational success and HR transformation by partnering with senior leaders to promote knowledge sharing, adoption of best practices, and consistent HR processes across the assigned business area.


This position advises on people strategies aligned to operational goals while building strong, trusted relationships with leaders. The HR Business Partner Lead also represents the business area’s people data needs and partners closely with People Analytics to deliver insights that support talent attraction, retention, workforce planning, and informed decision-making.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and/or support execution of People Plan initiatives that strengthen talent attraction, retention, engagement, and a high-performance culture.
  • Lead and influence HR transformation efforts that support both short- and long-term business success.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing between business areas to promote adoption of best practices and increased efficiencies.
  • Develop and implement frameworks that increase consistency, scalability, and effectiveness of HR practices.
  • Drive performance improvement and enable positive change in people management practices.
  • Establish KPIs and metrics to measure the impact of programs and actions; monitor performance, generate insights, and recommend course corrections to improve outcomes.
  • Strengthen organizational practices and controls related to talent management, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Leverage data analytics to support HR decision-making, providing insights into talent retention, employee engagement, turnover trends, root causes, and workforce planning needs.
  • Use data-driven insights to guide leadership in strategic decision-making and resource allocation in support of business goals and budget priorities.
  • Ensure effective use of HR technology and tools to collect, analyze, and report on key HR metrics.
  • Partner with M&A teams and business leadership to support successful acquisition and integration activities.
  • Lead change management efforts to support successful implementation of new processes and standards, coordinating with HRBP teams and appropriate subject matter experts.
  • Collaborate with other HR colleagues and CoE specialty partners (e.g., People Analytics, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Culture and Engagement, etc.) to drive cohesive HR programs and strengthen culture.
  • Present and report on HR metrics and strategic priorities to senior leadership.
  • Lead confidential and special projects that improve organizational effectiveness and operational efficiency.
  • Advise on workforce planning and succession strategies to help ensure a strong pipeline of future leadership talent.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Expectations:

  • Partners effectively with cross-functional business teams and knows when to engage HR Centers of Excellence to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Applies data-driven decision-making and translates insights into practical, actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrates initiative by independently identifying gaps, taking action to resolve issues, and following through on commitments.
  • Prioritizes work effectively and adapts quickly as needs shift to ensure the most critical work is delivered on time.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience coaching and advising senior leaders, including serving as an accountability partner for company values and leadership behaviors.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise on workforce planning and succession strategies that build a strong pipeline of future leadership talent.
  • Ability to lead and/or facilitate effective change initiatives and activate change through influence rather than direct oversight.
  • Seven or more years of progressive HR experience, with emphasis on strategic business partnership, talent management, and data analysis.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret performance analytics and identify meaningful insights that inform action.
  • Proven track record contributing to improvements in talent retention and organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong proficiency with HRIS platforms, business intelligence tools, and other technology required to perform the essential functions of the role.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% based on business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PHR or SPHR certification.
  • Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in the healthcare industry and/or with a multi-site, multi-state employer.
  • Experience working in a highly matrixed organization.


Work Schedule: This role supports leaders and associates across multiple regions, with the majority of business activity occurring during Eastern and Central time zone business hours. Candidates should be comfortable aligning their work schedule to effectively support these business needs.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$115,200 - $158,400 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-19-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Looker)
jobs.excerpt: About Fusemachines Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider.
jobs.description:
About Fusemachines
Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator - Contract
jobs.excerpt: About BuildkiteBuildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day.
jobs.description:
About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both — giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

We're opening a large volume of new roles, to be hired through the first half of 2027. Every one of them means interview loops spread across Australian, US and European time zones, candidates waiting to hear what's next, Greenhouse stages to keep clean, and new starters who need contracts, checks and a laptop before day one. Our recruitment team needs support with the coordination and scheduling that comes with this many roles. We need someone to make sure activities and conversations happen on time and in the right order, that everyone's informed, and that candidates have a great experience throughout.

This role is for an experienced recruitment coordinator. You'll need to have done this job before and be able to hit the ground running from your first week. With this much hiring underway, there isn't room to learn recruitment coordination on the job. If you haven't worked as a recruitment coordinator or in talent operations, this role isn't the right fit.

You'll own scheduling, candidate communications, Greenhouse admin and the handover from hire to onboarding in HiBob, end to end.

As a team member, you'll work with recruiters, hiring managers and the wider People team. Our process is deliberately human — every candidate talks to a real person at every stage — so speed can't come at the cost of how candidates are treated. Some of our processes are still being refined, so so you'll need to be comfortable with being a bit scrappy at times.

Scheduling one interview across three time zones is easy. Doing it all week without a candidate ever feeling the effort is kind of the crux of the job.

The Sort Of Things You'll Do

Keep candidates moving

  • Schedule interview loops across Australian, US and European time zones, and rebook them quickly when plans change.
  • Move candidates through stages in Greenhouse and send the communication that goes with each step, so no one is left waiting to hear back.
  • Jump in on other recruitment/people activities when needed.

Keep the system clean

  • Build job posts, stages and interview kits in Greenhouse from our templates.
  • Own reporting and data hygiene, so recruiters and hiring managers can trust what the pipeline tells them.
  • Find the friction in how we coordinate and fix it, using AI tools like Claude where they help.

Get new starters in the door

  • Coordinate background checks, contracts and letters in HiBob once an offer is accepted.
  • Manage the handover to IT and answer new starter questions before day one.
  • Support our onboarding education program: hiring manager follow-up, group sessions and welcome sessions.

This Is You If...

  • You've worked as a recruitment coordinator or in talent operations, and you can walk us through a heavy week and how you kept it under control.
  • You know how a hiring process runs end to end and can take on a full scheduling load from your first week.
  • You catch errors before they reach anyone else — a wrong time zone, a duplicate candidate, a stage that hasn't moved — and you can give us an example.
  • You can juggle competing requests from recruiters and hiring managers across time zones and decide what goes first without being told.
  • You write to candidates the way you'd want to be written to: clear, prompt, and with the next step spelled out.
  • You're comfortable where processes aren't written down yet, and you use AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work.

Bonus Points If...

  • You've used Greenhouse: job posts, stages, interview kits or reporting.
  • You've used HiBob, or a similar HR system, for hiring or onboarding.
  • You've worked in SaaS or tech.
  • You've coordinated onboarding for new starters.

A Typical Day Might Include

  • Rebooking a four-person interview loop after an interviewer drops out the day before, and letting the candidate know what's changed.
  • Finding a slot that works for interviewers in Australia, the US and Europe.
  • Building the Greenhouse job post and interview kits for a newly opened engineering role.
  • Cleaning up stale stages and duplicate candidates so the pipeline report is right.
  • Chasing a background check and getting a contract out in HiBob.
  • Running a welcome session for this month's new starters.
  • Reviewing applications with a recruiter and talking through why some move forward.
  • Noticing the same scheduling email gets rewritten every week and turning it into a template.

Benefits

  • 20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 for secondary)
  • Remote-work allowance for home-office equipment, co-working spaces, or alternate locations
  • Confidential EAP & mental health support
  • Support for professional development through conferences, courses, and coaching
  • Retirement and health coverage (varies by region)

Exact benefits may vary slightly by country.

Location & Work Arrangement

Like all of Buildkite, this role is 100% remote, however it does need to be located in the ANZ timezone.

This is a full-time, 6-month contract with occasional overlap with US and European working hours, and you'll need Australian work rights.

🌈 Equal Opportunity Employer

If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at .

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution.

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).

Responsibilities

  • Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high.
  • Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
  • Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.
  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings.
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.
  • Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments.
  • Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
  • Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
  • Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them.
  • Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers.
  • Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
  • Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
  • Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects.
  • Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support

  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
  • 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan

More Than a Role...

We don’t just need a Global Entity Operations Associate (internal title: Global Entity Infrastructure Associate) — we need a builder, problem-solver, and operator who can bring structure to complexity and keep WorkMotion’s global infrastructure running smoothly. We’re looking for someone who gets their energy from solving complex operational challenges, coordinating across borders, and turning moving parts into clear, scalable processes, while keeping a sharp eye on compliance, accuracy, and business impact.

Not Your Typical Team…

Not Your Typical Workplace.…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building atWorkMotion. Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role...

We don’t just need a Global Entity Operations Associate (internal title: Global Entity Infrastructure Associate) — we need a builder, problem-solver, and operator who can bring structure to complexity and keep WorkMotion’s global infrastructure running smoothly. We’re looking for someone who gets their energy from solving complex operational challenges, coordinating across borders, and turning moving parts into clear, scalable processes, while keeping a sharp eye on compliance, accuracy, and business impact.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of WorkMotion’s global entity infrastructure — driving day-to-day entity operations, coordinating compliance obligations, supporting international expansion, and helping build the infrastructure that enables WorkMotion to operate compliantly around the world. From license renewals and corporate filings to entity set-up, provider management, audits, and process improvements, you’ll help ensure everything you touch is accurate, compliant, well-organised, and built to scale.

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate closely with Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, Legal, and other internal teams, while coordinating with external legal, corporate, compliance, and local infrastructure partners across multiple jurisdictions. You’ll become a trusted point of contact for entity-related matters, bringing people, information, and timelines together to ensure consistency, accountability, and momentum across WorkMotion’s global operations.

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Manage daily operations and corporate maintenance activities of WorkMotion’s global entities, ensuring compliance and operational efficiency across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Track and drive corporate compliance obligations, including license renewals, UBO reporting, KYC filings, corporate governance tasks, etc., while working with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Help execute WorkMotion’s international expansion strategy by helping to manage the set-up of entities and the operating infrastructure for WorkMotion across the globe to employ compliantly worldwide.
  • Source, select, and manage external partners and providers that are part of our local EOR infrastructure.
  • Support with project management of various expansion or improvement initiatives related to our global infrastructure, as well as special company and strategic projects.
  • Collaborate with WorkMotion’s internal Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, and Legal teams, and serve as a point of contact for entity-related queries.
  • Maintain and update documents, records, and data to ensure accuracy and audit-readiness.
  • Support audits, regulatory inspections, and internal reviews by preparing necessary documentation.
  • Identify and solve problems, inefficiencies, or gaps in our entity management systems and internal processes.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, International Affairs, or other relevant field.
  • 2+ years of work experience, with prior roles in international operations, project management, entity set-up/maintenance, or relevant work in legal operations or compliance management.
  • Project management skills, with the ability to take lead on initiatives, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and manage timelines.
  • Open-minded and organized work attitude, with the ability to respond flexibly across a varying set of topics and tasks.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and team-player skills to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in high-paced dynamic environments.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can anticipate challenges and risks, and look for solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation practices.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Bonus Points If You Bring...

  • Experience in entity management, legal/paralegal work, or project coordination roles.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments, ideally in FinTech, SaaS, or multinational operations.
  • An understanding of corporate governance, entity compliance, regulatory obligations, and operational risk management in a global context.
  • Experience working asynchronously in a remote-first or globally distributed environment.

Not Your Typical Team…

We are a team of 26 highly talented Finance minds, who are based in Ukraine, Germany, Egypt and Austria. We’re a team of motivated, and fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected."

We don’t just “work” together — we create, challenge, and grow together. If you’re looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, cross-collaboration on bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork you’ll feel right at home.

The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on . We’re here to support you every step of the way!

jobs.description:
Job Title: Spanish-Bilingual Medical Virtual Receptionist
Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)
Work Hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (1-hour unpaid lunch break)

Work Days: Monday-Friday

Salary: $6–$8 per hour, depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: Latin America

About the Practice

Our Client runs a specialized physical therapy practice based in California, dedicated to providing compassionate, personalized care focused on women's pelvic floor and abdominal health. Our services support patients experiencing pelvic pain, urinary incontinence, pregnancy and postpartum recovery, pelvic organ prolapse, core dysfunction, and related conditions.

As the practice continues to grow, they are looking for a confident, proactive, and patient-focused Bilingual Medical Virtual Receptionist to help manage daily front desk operations and deliver an exceptional patient experience.

This is more than just answering phone calls! They need someone who can take ownership of patient scheduling, appointment follow-ups, waitlist management, and administrative coordination while ensuring patients feel supported throughout their care journey.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Scheduling & Appointment Management (Top Priority)

  • Schedule initial evaluations, follow-up appointments, cancellations, and rescheduled visits using Jane App.
  • Proactively contact patients to schedule appointments and coordinate approved treatment visits, including multiple-session treatment plans.
  • Manage patient waitlists and actively fill available appointment slots resulting from cancellations.
  • Follow up with patients who have remaining authorized visits but have not scheduled their appointments.
  • Coordinate provider schedules to ensure smooth daily operations and efficient appointment utilization.
  • Support scheduling needs as the practice expands and adds additional providers.

2. Patient Communication & Follow-Ups

  • Handle approximately 20 or more inbound calls daily, along with high-volume text messages and outbound calls.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to patient inquiries, missed calls, voicemails, and scheduling requests.
  • Communicate confidently and compassionately with English- and Spanish-speaking patients.
  • Explain appointment availability, scheduling procedures, and general practice policies.
  • Assist patients with scheduling insurance-authorized visits, including Kaiser referrals, following established practice guidelines.
  • Conduct proactive patient outreach to encourage continuity of care and minimize missed scheduling opportunities.
  • Follow up regarding available services or treatment packages as directed by the practice.
  • Escalate clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate healthcare professionals.

3. Front Desk Administration & Patient Intake

  • Send patient intake forms, registration documents, and required paperwork before scheduled appointments.
  • Monitor incomplete forms and proactively follow up with patients to ensure timely completion.
  • Maintain accurate and updated patient information and administrative records in Jane App.
  • Coordinate with office management and billing personnel regarding insurance authorizations, scheduling concerns, and other administrative issues.
  • Maintain daily checklists, trackers, and follow-up records to monitor completed and pending tasks.
  • Identify missing patient information or documentation early to prevent appointment delays.
  • Provide timely updates on outstanding tasks and escalate issues requiring additional assistance.

Systems & Tools

  • Jane App: Patient scheduling, administrative chart management, and practice management.
  • Google Voice: Inbound and outbound calls, voicemail management, and patient text messaging.
  • Daily Checklists & Trackers: Task management, patient follow-ups, and administrative accountability.
  • Other Practice Systems: Additional client-provided tools as needed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Patient calls, messages, and voicemails are addressed promptly.
  • Provider schedules are accurately maintained, with proactive efforts to fill cancellations and available appointment slots.
  • Patients receive consistent follow-ups regarding appointments and authorized treatment visits.
  • Intake forms and administrative documentation are completed before appointments.
  • Patient records remain accurate, organized, and updated.
  • Daily responsibilities are completed independently, with clear communication about pending or escalated matters.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Medical Receptionist, Healthcare Virtual Assistant, Patient Scheduling Coordinator, or Medical Front Desk Specialist.
  • Hands-on experience with patient scheduling, appointment coordination, intake processing, and administrative follow-ups.
  • Strong English and Spanish communication skills, both verbal and written, to assist a bilingual patient population.
  • Experience using an Electronic Health Record (EHR) or healthcare practice management system.
  • Comfortable managing high-volume inbound and outbound calls, text messages, and voicemails.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations, patient confidentiality, and appropriate handling of sensitive medical information.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.
  • Confident, assertive, and compassionate communication skills when assisting patients.
  • Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and follow through on tasks without constant supervision.
  • Must be available to work the required Pacific Time schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in physical therapy, rehabilitation, chiropractic, or outpatient healthcare settings.
  • Familiarity with Jane App or similar medical scheduling and practice management platforms.
  • Experience using Google Voice or comparable cloud-based phone systems.
  • Knowledge of insurance-authorized treatment scheduling, particularly Kaiser referrals.
  • Experience managing patient waitlists, coordinating multiple providers, and improving appointment utilization.
  • Familiarity with multi-visit treatment plans and patient follow-up workflows.

Note: A medical degree, active clinical license, or previous virtual assistant experience is not specifically required. Relevant healthcare front desk or scheduling experience is essential.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing English clearly and professionally, in addition to Spanish.
  • Must have relevant healthcare administrative or front desk experience.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance background check before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with the camera on when needed.
  • Must demonstrate professionalism, reliability, accountability, and strong attention to detail.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Not Your Typical Workplace.…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role.…

We don’t just need an Engineering Manager — a deep understanding of software engineering, can challenge technical decisions, coach engineers, improve engineering practices, and create an environment where teams consistently deliver meaningful outcomes. Do you enjoy building strong teams, have a strong Java engineering background, want to stay close to technology, and can turn ambitious product goals into reliable execution? We'd love to hear from you.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of it all — ross-functional engineering team responsible for delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality product capabilities.

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, Principal Engineers, Platform, AI/ML, Security, and other stakeholders across WorkMotion bringing everything together to ensure consistency, impact, and momentum across the board.

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, creating clear expectations and supporting their professional growth.

  • Maintain strong technical awareness and actively participate in architecture, design, and engineering discussions.

  • Work with Principal and Senior Engineers on architecture and complex technical decisions.
  • Use engineering metrics and qualitative signals to continuously improve team effectiveness, quality, and delivery.

  • Experience with modern software development practices, Java-based backend systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and CI/CD.

  • Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into structured execution plans.
  • A data-informed approach to engineering performance without reducing productivity to simplistic metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our Engineering Culture…

  • Quality with speed We move quickly without treating engineering quality as optional.
  • Pragmatism over perfection We make deliberate trade-offs based on business and technical context.
  • Transparency Risks, mistakes, and disagreements should surface early.
  • Continuous improvement Our architecture, processes, and ways of working should get better as we scale.
  • Collaboration Great products come from Engineering, Product, Design, Security, Data, and business teams working together.

The Case Manager demonstrates Cigna’s Care Solutions cultural beliefs, acting with accountability, collaboration, compassion, and innovation in support of both customer needs and business objectives.

  • Collaborate with customers and providers to establish goals, interventions, and evidence‑based plans of care.

  • Apply motivational interviewing, behavior change strategies, and shared decision‑making to drive engagement and improved health outcomes.

  • Empower customers to effectively navigate the healthcare system and communicate with providers.

  • Coordinate care across customers, caregivers, providers, and internal partners via phone and digital channels (email, text, chat).

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams—including pharmacists, nutritionists, behavioral clinicians, Medical Directors, and Medical Management programs—to support whole‑person health.

  • Track, analyze, and document daily activity, volume, and outcomes to support performance and quality goals.

  • Follow established policies, procedures, and Case Management performance measures.

  • Efficiently navigate multiple systems and applications in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.

  • Complete required training and maintain clinical knowledge, licensure, and certifications.

Required Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in your state of residency.

  • Minimum of two (2) years of full‑time direct patient care experience as an RN.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Specialty case management experience, with ONCOLOGY experience preferred for specialty roles.

  • Ability to obtain a URAC‑recognized Case Management certification within four (4) years of hire.

  • Strong clinical judgment with the ability to assess risk, prioritize care, and act decisively.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across phone and digital platforms.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and online research tools.

  • Demonstrated ability to resolve conflict, collaborate across teams, and interact with diverse populations.

jobs.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.


Job Description

Senior Manager, Clinical Data Management (CDM) is primarily an oversight role, working cross-functionally with internal and external partners to support our efforts in this fast-growing and important area of cell therapy. The role will report to the Associate Director, CDM or higher.

This position may be responsible for managing data managers and data management associates, overseeing CDM vendors (external and/or CRO), overseeing the creation of project timelines and data management documentation to ensure effective study delivery across the program.

  • Drive and execute the management of CDM deliverables within the Kite sponsored NIS program (including Post-Marketing Required (PMR) studies and Expanded Access Programs (EAP)), in coordination with internal and external cross-functional teams
  • Provide support and expertise on non-Kite sponsored collaborative and Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR), where needed

  • Oversight of study documentation, ensuring timely completion and ongoing adherence to regulatory expectations, relating to data integrity and patient safety
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external study team members
  • Oversee the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of clinical data and data structure across the program on an ongoing basis
  • Perform management of CDM deliverables as described or provides oversight and guidance to Data Manager leading CDM deliverables
  • Lead CDM representative during internal audits as well as Health Authority audits
  • Lead the development, review, and implementation of processes, policies, SOPs, and associated documents affecting CDM and cross-functional groups
  • Lead and/or participate in CDM cross-functional initiatives
  • Proactively provide input into CDM organizational strategy and implements departmental change
  • Proactively provide input to continuous improvement activities within Clinical Data Management and leads the relevant support for implementation
  • Flexible to changing priorities, detail-oriented, works well under pressure, and able to take on unfamiliar tasks
  • Prioritize and effectively delegate study and initiative responsibilities
  • Assume expanded scope of responsibility with respect to volume and complexity of clinical project work as well as direct report responsibility
  • To be proficient in web-based Electronic Data Capture (such as Medidata Rave and other clinical data management systems)
  • Experienced with industry wide thesauri/dictionaries such as MedDRA and WHODD
  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly describe critical technical CDM aspects to non-CDM staff
  • Experienced project management skills

High School degree and 12 years of experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant industry experience with clinical trials and a successful track record of leading through influence, working across complex, global organizational matrices
  • Experience in Industry Standards Guidelines (e.g., CDISC) in either the collection (CDASH), tabulation (SDTM), or analysis (ADaM) models

jobs.title: Director of Ecommerce
jobs.excerpt: Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand committed to making early learning engaging, screen-free, and fun.
jobs.description:
Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand committed to making early learning engaging, screen-free, and fun. Our journey began with hand-drawn educational tools and has grown into a beloved brand, trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. We design developmentally sound products for children ages 3 to 8, such as educational posters, busy books, and emotional learning kits. Our mission is to create tools that help children thrive through connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our vision is bold. We want to become the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes and passed down for generations, and we are building toward $100M in revenue by 2030.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Director of Ecommerce to own our Shopify business as its general manager. You will own the Shopify P&L and the growth engine that feeds it, from paid acquisition and creative testing to offers, funnels, and lifecycle marketing, and you will build the team and systems that let the channel scale without the founder in the day to day.

Shopify is our dominant D2C channel, and it does not stand alone. Our Amazon team owns Amazon, and TikTok Shop is an important part of our ecosystem. You will see the whole customer life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the halo our launches create on Amazon and how acquisition converts there, and you will connect the dots so a launch lifts all three.

Your target is to scale our direct-to-consumer business to $20M+ in profitable revenue, with a net margin of at least 15% on Shopify.

You will work closely with our CEO, partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts both channels, and lead our ecommerce team.

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Own Shopify revenue and profitability, with a net profit margin of at least 15%.
  • Customer acquisition. Run Meta and other paid media to unit economics, with a Meta ROAS of at least 2.5, and keep a high-velocity creative testing rhythm fed by our AI content engine, creator video, UGC, and in-house production.
  • Offers, funnels, and CRO. Launch new funnels that meet our KPI thresholds every month, build bundles and ascension paths, and keep homepage, collection, and product pages aligned with what converts.
  • Lifecycle and LTV. Drive email and SMS to at least 25% of Shopify revenue through Klaviyo and Postscript, and keep the 30-day GPLTV to CAC ratio above 3.
  • Channel connection. Partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts Amazon too, understand TikTok Shop's place as a social-commerce channel, and keep each channel's role in the customer journey deliberate.
  • Team leadership. Lead our ecommerce operators with clear ownership, weekly operating rhythms, and scorecards, and bring in freelancers and contractors as output grows.
  • Reporting. Deliver a weekly scorecard and P&L review, and a monthly plan and forecast for the CEO.
  • Systems and compliance. Document a playbook for every working funnel, keep the store and ads compliant, and turn repeat work into AI-assisted workflows.
  • Brand. Protect and build what the brand stands for in every ad, page, and customer touchpoint.

How Success Is Measured

  • Profitable growth in Shopify revenue against the plan
  • Net profit margin of at least 15% on Shopify
  • Meta ROAS of at least 2.5
  • Email and SMS at 25% or more of Shopify revenue
  • 30-day GPLTV to CAC above 3
  • A team and operating rhythm that run without daily founder involvement

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a high ownership leader who thinks like a general manager, not just a marketer. You are energized by building systems, leading people, and owning outcomes.

  • You have 5 to 10+ years of experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands on Shopify with paid social.
  • You have a proven track record growing brands beyond $20M in revenue.
  • You have owned a P&L and hit revenue and profit targets.
  • You understand the full D2C life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the Amazon halo, and you have run or worked alongside social commerce, not Shopify alone.
  • You have built and led a team, and the people who worked for you will say so.
  • You are deeply fluent in Meta ads and high-velocity creative testing, including AI-assisted creative pipelines.
  • You are hands-on with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Postscript.
  • You understand bundles, upsells, and LTV, and you can write and review a landing page that converts.
  • You are comfortable leading a remote team with weekly cadences.
  • You use AI every day to get more done with less. That is a capability, not a particular tool, and it is a must-have here. You also work inside a CRM and documented SOPs, and you want to build how we use all three now and going forward.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

You will have real ownership. Real trust. And real impact. Hadley Designs is a remote first company built on autonomy, creativity, and accountability. You will work closely with our CEO and a leadership team that moves fast and expects results.

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process

Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today

If you are ready to own the growth of a brand families love, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Ecommerce.

P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in U.S. orthopedic medical billing, CPT/ICD-10 coding, and EOB/ERA analysis, with a persistent follow-through mindset to resolve unpaid claims and secure authorizations efficiently.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Medical Biller / Billing Support Specialist
  • Practice: Han Orthopaedics
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time)
  • Core EHR/Billing Platform:eClinicalWorks (eCW) (Strongly Preferred)
  • Specialty Focus: Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal Care

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorizations: Verify patient coverage, determine prior auth rules, compile clinical documentation, submit requests, and follow up relentlessly through final approval.
  2. Accounts Receivable (A/R) & Payment Posting: Work aging reports, investigate unpaid/underpaid claims with payors, post insurance ERAs/EOBs and patient payments, and resolve balances.
  3. Claims & Medical Billing Support: Scrub and submit primary/secondary claims, clear billing rejections, draft denial appeals/corrected claims, and maintain clean billing records in eCW.

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end authorization process, ensuring authorization numbers and validity dates are meticulously documented in eCW before patient encounters.
  • Audit clearinghouse and payor claim rejections, making timely coding or demographic corrections to ensure rapid clean-claim resubmissions.
  • Work A/R aging work queues systematically, contacting commercial and government payors to overturn denied or stalled claims.
  • Accurately post line-item payments, contractual adjustments, and deductibles from EOBs/ERAs.
  • Maintain complete HIPAA compliance and protect patient financial records across all workflows.

Requirements

  • U.S. Billing Experience: 3+ years of direct U.S. medical billing experience spanning verification, prior auths, A/R, posting, and claims.
  • Coding & Terminology Knowledge: Mastery of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS codes, modifier applications, and medical terminology.
  • RCM Competency: Strong proficiency in reviewing EOBs/ERAs, working denials, and navigating commercial payor portals.
  • Autonomous Execution: Exceptional attention to detail, proactive follow-through, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Communication & HIPAA: Excellent written/spoken English and comprehensive knowledge of HIPAA regulations.
  • Remote Workspace: Private, HIPAA-compliant office setup with a high-performance computer, primary high-speed internet, backup power/internet, and a headset.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • EHR Mastery: Recent hands-on experience in eClinicalWorks (eCW) billing, eligibility, auths, posting, and A/R modules.
  • Specialty Background: Direct orthopedic medical billing and surgical/diagnostic authorization experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a seasoned revenue cycle specialist who understands the nuances of orthopedic billing. You hit the ground running in eClinicalWorks, handle payor authorizations with precision, and never leave money on the table when working A/R.

At Yelp, our product suite reaches and engages diners, creating unforgettable guest experiences on the largest restaurant discovery platform in the world. Our mission: deliver the best possible experience to every diner, while becoming the essential partner for restaurants navigating daily challenges.

Enter Yelp Host, an AI-powered phone answering agent built just for restaurants, and Yelp Guest Manager, our established reservations and waitlist platform. Together, they help restaurants answer every call 24/7 in 17 languages, capture every reservation and takeout order, and run a smoother front of house, all backed by Yelp's unparalleled restaurant data and thriving consumer platform.

Why this role

  • Shape the playbook for bringing a new, fast-growing AI product to market while growing an established product with a loyal enterprise customer base

  • You will lead the team through change as products, pricing, processes, and priorities evolve quickly, explaining what's changing and why, and keeping the team focused, confident, and executing

  • You will hire and onboard top talent as the team scales, and build an inclusive, high-performing culture where people feel valued, accountable, and empowered

  • You will travel strategically for executive meetings, onsite business reviews, team development, and industry events, up to 50%

What it takes to succeed:

  • You have 7+ years of experience in enterprise customer success, account management, implementation, or client-facing sales at a SaaS company, including 2+ years directly managing a customer success, account management, or sales team
  • You are well versed in the full post-sale lifecycle and have personally done the work: leading multi-location implementations, managing executive relationships, owning renewals, and closing expansion revenue

  • You have experience managing both new and established products at the same time, such as launching and scaling an early-stage product (like Yelp Host) while protecting and growing a mature customer base (like Yelp Guest Manager)

  • You have a track record of influencing cross-functional partners and senior leaders without direct authority: turning customer insights into product and process changes, negotiating tradeoffs across competing priorities, and earning trust as the go-to partner for enterprise customer needs.
  • You have strong executive presence and you're confident presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior operations leaders
  • You are data-driven and operationally minded, with experience building processes and using Salesforce and reporting tools to manage team performance
  • You have experience leading a team through rapid change, such as new product launches, shifting priorities, or evolving processes, and you help people stay focused and adaptable when things move fast

  • You will need access to an individual hardline high-speed internet connection in your workspace. This job cannot be performed using satellite internet or a mobile hotspot

Post-Sales Enablement Manager

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the Director of Customer Programs | Remote

Salary range: [$145,000-$165,000]

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Reporting to the Director of Customer Programs, we need an operator to own enablement for a post-sales organization that is growing fast: Support, Customer Success, Customer Growth, Adoption and Flagship Account Management. Every new hire, product release and system change has to become something our teams can do on day one. You will own how that happens, end to end: the strategy, training, standards and cadence that keep every post-sales role ramped and current. You are the first dedicated owner of this work, and you will define it while the organization roughly doubles its individual contributors in 2027.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a trusted-advisor relationship to the VP and post-sales leaders. You will work alongside the CX Enablement Specialist, who also reports to the Director and knows how Backblaze really works: the backend, customer provisioning, the core systems and Salesforce. The Specialist brings deep knowledge of how things work here, and you bring structure and learning design. Together you turn that knowledge into learning paths and training that every new hire can follow, and you shape how the two of you share the work.

You have built and run post-sales teams, you know how to turn chaos into a working system, and you bring a point of view on how a post-sales organization should be enabled at scale.

What You Will Own

Build

  • The post-sales enablement strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, tied to the 2027 plan and to the metrics each team is accountable for. You present it to the VP and post-sales leaders and adjust it as the business changes.
  • A clear read on where teams struggle, using scorecard data and conversations with leaders, and the judgment to decide which gaps to close first.
  • The enablement operating model: how enablement is requested, built, approved, updated and retired, the quality standard for all content, and who owns what.
  • Role-based learning paths, skill levels and a formal certification and badging framework, designed with the post-sales leaders, so each role has a clear way to progress and to prove readiness.
  • Formal onboarding for Customer Success managers and Support, where onboarding today is largely informal, then extended to Growth, Adoption and Flagship. You run it through the 2027 hiring wave so new hires reach productivity quickly and consistently.
  • The release-to-enablement process with Product: product releases and roadmap changes turned into training, talking points and resources for each role, ready before customers ask.
  • Readiness for major system and process changes, such as the Planhat rollout, the move from Zendesk to Salesforce and new handoffs between teams.
  • Playbooks and cross-team handoffs (Sales to Adoption, Adoption to Customer Success, Support to Enterprise Support), led with the team leaders who own them, and with SOPs and RevOps so we build on company-wide processes.

Own

  • One enablement calendar for all post-sales teams, so leaders know what is coming and when.
  • The enablement scorecard: new-hire ramp time, onboarding completion, playbook adoption and the effect on team metrics such as CSAT, time to first value and retention. You review results quarterly with post-sales leadership and advise on decisions where enablement is a constraint, such as hiring pace and ramp expectations.
  • Your partnership with the CX Enablement Specialist, whose knowledge of how Backblaze works is the foundation of our training. You turn that expertise into structured, repeatable training and agree how to share the work.
  • Working with Sales Enablement, who own sales skills, so handoffs from Sales and SEs are consistent. Working with Product on release content, and with Marketing, who own customer-facing content, so internal enablement builds on what exists and never competes with it.
  • Sharing your methods and coaching leaders and team members on how to build and deliver enablement that sticks.

What You Will Personally Build in Year One

Build with the leaders and the team, not over them. The point is not to arrive with finished answers. It is to bring people into the work and make enablement something leaders build into their own plans.

  • First 30 days: Learn each team's work, review today's onboarding for Customer Success and Support, and agree priorities with the Director and the Specialist, working as partners.
  • First 60 days: Present the enablement strategy and roadmap to post-sales leadership, launch version one of the Customer Success manager onboarding path, agree the release-to-enablement process with Product, and plan Support onboarding.
  • First 90 days: Support onboarding live, the learning-path and certification framework agreed with leaders, the enablement calendar and scorecard running with baselines for ramp time, and a cohort process ready for the 2027 hiring wave.
  • First year: Every post-sales role has a defined onboarding path, learning path and certification level. New hires reach productivity faster than the 2026 baseline. Leaders build enablement into their plans for hiring and releases.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • You have spent 10 years running and building support, customer success and onboarding teams, ideally in a B2B technology or infrastructure company.
  • You have taken a messy, fast-growing post-sales organization of dozens to hundreds of people and brought order to it: documented processes, clear handoffs and consistent ways of working, with measurable results such as faster ramp, better CSAT or higher retention.
  • You have defined onboarding, learning-path and certification frameworks that other teams adopted and that kept working after launch.
  • You have onboarded and ramped technical customer-facing teams at scale, such as support engineers, customer success managers and technical account managers.
  • You have worked across support, customer success, onboarding and account management, and you know how they hand off to each other. You have built or run more than one of them.
  • You influence VPs and Directors, set direction without direct authority, and lead change in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. You’ll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportun’s business objectives.
  • You’ll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance.
  • You’ll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities.
  • You’ll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation.
  • You’ll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.
  • You’ll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions.
  • You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences.
  • You’ll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions.
  • You’ll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team.
  • You’ll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • You’ll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked.
  • You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity.
  • You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a strategic and hands-on product leader who combines strong customer judgment with data, business acumen, and disciplined execution. You know how to build products that customers value while making thoughtful trade-offs across growth, economics, risk, and operational complexity.

You’re comfortable leading through ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and creating clarity across teams. You communicate directly, build strong partnerships, and stay close enough to the work to understand what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

You’re also a strong people leader. You know how to coach product managers, raise the quality of product thinking, and create accountability for measurable outcomes.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with increasing responsibility for product strategy, roadmap ownership, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Significant experience building and growing consumer digital products.
  • Proven experience owning engagement, retention, growth, monetization, or other meaningful product-performance outcomes.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers.
  • Strong track record leading cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Experience setting product strategy and translating it into focused, executable roadmaps.
  • Strong product judgment and a high standard for simple, intuitive, and customer-centered experiences.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience with funnel analysis, cohort performance, product economics, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience evolving established products while balancing current customer needs with new strategic priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with competing priorities and significant ambiguity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, payments, savings, budgeting, investing, or financial wellness.
  • Experience building consumer mobile products or other high-engagement digital experiences.
  • Experience with subscription, recurring-use, or habit-forming consumer products.
  • Experience serving customers managing complex or variable financial needs.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and incorporating Risk, Legal, and Compliance requirements into product experiences.
  • Experience leading products through periods of growth, transformation, or significant strategic change.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve product research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, or team productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you
