jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An Enterprise AI Architecture leader who is ready to shape how our clients' customer service ecosystems scale with AI. You lead teams of architects and Forward Deployed Engineers, designing AI components and cooperating AI agents connect with the platforms service runs on (CRM, contact center, knowledge, telephony, and data) and setting the reusable patterns that govern how AI is deployed. You bring a clear point of view on what good looks like when many agents, models, and systems have to work as one.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams include Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), hybrid practitioners who embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You may have been one yourself; now your job is to also lead them, set the standard for how they work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee multiple AI integration architecture programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across architects and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as containment, resolution, and cost-to-serve.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Own future-state architectures for AI-enabled service: how virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents integrate with CRM, contact center, knowledge management, ticketing, and enterprise data platforms through APIs, events, and tool-use patterns such as MCP.
  • Set the agentic design standards your FDEs build to, including agent roles, memory, tool-use, and orchestration logic across cloud agent platforms, and how agents are grounded in client data through RAG, vector search, and knowledge graphs.
  • Set the reusable patterns that govern AI deployment across the enterprise, including multi-agent orchestration, human handoff and escalation, context and identity across channels, and the right balance of build, buy, and platform-native AI.
  • Act as the decisive voice on high-stakes engagements, guiding architecture tradeoffs across cost, latency, accuracy, compliance, and vendor dependency.
  • Ground service journeys and conversation designs in what the architecture can support from day one, shaping feasibility early and translating design recommendations into integration specifications and working builds.
  • Build security, MLOps, and responsible AI guardrails into every architecture, working with specialists across Accenture.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and shaping architecture-led roadmaps and proposals that turn one project into a lasting partnership.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on agentic service architecture and how enterprises should scale AI across their service ecosystems, positioning Song as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with ecosystem partners across contact center, CRM, cloud, and data platforms to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow Forward Deployed Engineers and architects, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: hire the right hybrid profiles, define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify reference architectures, integration patterns, and accelerators that make delivery repeatable across clients.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders. Experience leading Forward Deployed Engineers or similar client-embedded technical teams, such as solutions architects, sales engineers, or technical consultants; a hands-on FDE or engineering background yourself is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Deep experience in solution and integration architecture for enterprise systems, including API design and management, event-driven and microservices architectures, and integration platforms.
  • Architecture experience with GenAI and agentic systems in production, including RAG, agent orchestration, tool-use and MCP integration, on at least one enterprise agent platform such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, or Databricks Mosaic AI.
  • Experience architecting across customer service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect.
  • Experience designing conversational AI and agentic solutions across voice and digital channels, including IVR modernization, chat and messaging, intelligent routing, and seamless handoff between AI and human agents with full customer context.
  • Experience integrating AI into the service agent desktop and knowledge ecosystem, including CRM case management, knowledge bases, and workforce and quality management systems.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.
  • Professional-level cloud architect certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Experience establishing architecture governance or a design authority across a multi-vendor enterprise estate.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams spanning design, advisory, and technology, turning research insights and design recommendations into engineered solutions.
  • Experience working in management consulting or a professional services environment.
  • You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

Description

Matrix is seeking an experienced Business Analyst - NICE Actimize AML to support the implementation and enhancement of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) transaction monitoring solutions. The ideal candidate will serve as the critical link between AML Compliance stakeholders, business users, and technology teams, translating regulatory and operational requirements into functional specifications and validated technology solutions within the NICE Actimize platform.

This role requires strong expertise in NICE Actimize Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM) and ActOne, combined with hands-on experience in AML transaction monitoring, data analysis, requirements management, testing, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Collaborate with AML Compliance, Operations, Risk, and Technology stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for transaction monitoring initiatives.
  • Conduct workshops, interviews, and requirement discovery sessions to understand business processes and regulatory obligations.
  • Develop detailed Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and translate business needs into clear functional specifications and process flows.
  • Perform gap analysis between current and target-state AML operating models and identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure traceability from business requirements through development, testing, and implementation.

NICE Actimize Solution Design

  • Define and document functional specifications for NICE Actimize SAM detection scenarios, transaction monitoring rules, thresholds, and tuning requirements.
  • Document and support ActOne/RCM alert management, investigation workflows, and case management processes.
  • Work closely with development teams to clarify requirements, review Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), and ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation.
  • Support solution customization and configuration activities within the NICE Actimize platform.

Data Analysis & Data Mapping

  • Analyze source system data and create detailed source-to-target mapping documents for AML platform integrations.
  • Validate inbound and processed data for completeness, accuracy, and quality.
  • Use SQL to perform data analysis, reconciliation, and root-cause investigation of data issues.
  • Partner with technical teams to resolve data quality, integration, and transformation discrepancies.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
  • Execute functional testing, system testing, regression testing, and quality assurance activities.
  • Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) through defect management and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Verify that implemented solutions meet both functional and regulatory requirements.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and presentations to communicate requirements, findings, recommendations, and project status.
  • Contribute to project planning, risk management, issue tracking, and delivery governance.
  • Support release management activities, including migration of configurations and code across environments.
  • Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting AML solution implementation or development within banking or financial services.
  • Proven experience delivering AML transaction monitoring initiatives in enterprise environments.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams in Agile delivery environments.

NICE Actimize Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with NICE Actimize SAM (Suspicious Activity Monitoring).
  • Hands-on experience with ActOne/RCM (Risk Case Manager).
  • Experience documenting and supporting:
  • SAM detection rules and scenariosAlert generation and tuningThreshold calibrationActOne workflows and customizations

AML Domain Knowledge

Strong knowledge of:

  • Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
  • Transaction Monitoring
  • Alert Investigation
  • Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR)
  • Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR)
  • Financial Crime Compliance
  • Regulatory and compliance-driven monitoring frameworks

Technical Skills

  • Strong SQL expertise with Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Hands-on experience writing complex SQL queries, joins, procedures, and data validation scripts.
  • Experience with data analysis, reconciliation, and source-to-target mapping.
  • Strong understanding of data quality controls and validation methodologies.

Testing & Tools

  • Experience creating and executing test cases and quality assurance procedures.
  • Hands-on experience with project management and testing tools such as:
  • JiraTrelloHP ALM / Quality Center
  • Experience working in Scrum and Agile delivery environments.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to business and compliance stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality outputs with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AML programs within Capital Markets or Investment Banking environments, in addition to retail banking.
  • Knowledge of adjacent NICE Actimize modules, including:
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD)Watch List Filtering (WLF)
  • Familiarity with:
  • KYC (Know Your Customer)Sanctions ScreeningFinancial Crime Compliance frameworks
  • Experience participating in NICE Actimize upgrades or migration projects.
  • Professional AML certifications such as:
  • CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist)Equivalent financial crime compliance certifications

Success Profile

  1. The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  2. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  3. Ability to quickly learn new technologies and drive issues to resolution.

  5. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

About NRG

NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology. We stay ahead of what’s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AI Manager or Director to help people across NRG use AI confidently and build better ways of working. You’ll turn deep, current AI knowledge into practical capabilities that improve our research, client service and operations.

You’ll work across the organization with all our teams and senior leaders to introduce shared tools and coach colleagues. This will be a highly visible role that combines experimentation, communication and collaboration to help the whole firm learn about, use and build with AI.

We welcome people with different backgrounds and career paths. We’re interested in the AI knowledge, relevant experience and practical contribution you can bring to NRG.

  • Stay current with AI. Explore new models, tools, techniques and open-source projects, test and benchmark their performance and usefulness, and bring practical recommendations and examples to NRG.

  • Lead initiatives that give teams shared AI building blocks: reusable Skills, agents, workflows, apps and connections between tools, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Partner with Engineering to define needs, test solutions and clarify support responsibilities before launch.
  • Assess third-party tools, help choose suitable solutions, and guide their introduction. Bring together documentation, demonstrations and training support so people can use them confidently and build on them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A background in market research, media, analytics consulting or another field requiring strong research and professional judgment.
  • Practical Python skills and working knowledge of SQL.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, MCP integrations and API-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.

About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning.
  • Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions.
  • Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development.
  • Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development.
  • Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality.
  • Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role.
  • Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work.
  • Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development.
  • Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches.
  • Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects.
  • Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates.
  • Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development.

Requirements

  • C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted.
  • AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable.
  • Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools.
  • Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable.
  • Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development.
  • Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions.
  • Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve.

Nice to Have

  • AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable.
  • Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience.
  • AI / Machine Learning – 1+ years: Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including integrating code with large language models (LLMs) or ML-based optimisation. Python experience combined with strong applied mathematics knowledge, or a demonstrated interest in AI through side projects, is also acceptable.

ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Manager of Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & Revenue Growth) to build and lead a new function within our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team. This team will focus on improving the experience of paying subscribers, increasing engagement, growing customer lifetime value, and strengthening retention through data-driven lifecycle marketing programs.

In this role, you'll lead a team of three marketers and shape how our Retention & Revenue Growth function operates. You'll translate business objectives into a cohesive approach to post-purchase engagement and revenue growth, establish priorities and ways of working, and guide the team in developing programs that drive measurable improvements in subscriber behavior. You'll navigate competing opportunities, make informed trade-offs, and work across teams to build solutions that scale.

This is an opportunity to build a new function while developing a high-performing team. You'll establish a strong foundation for experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement, while advancing thoughtful AI adoption and helping your team develop the capabilities to work more effectively and independently. As the business evolves, the function may also expand into emerging opportunities such as community-driven growth and sharing.

ABOUT THE GROWTH LIFECYCLE MARKETING TEAM

Our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team operates with a high degree of end-to-end ownership. We use customer behavior and data to identify opportunities, develop strategies, build and launch lifecycle experiences, measure performance, and turn what we learn into the next experiment. Rather than routinely handing work from one function to another, our lifecycle marketers have the tools and autonomy to move work forward themselves while partnering with teams across onX where their expertise is needed.

We move quickly, experiment often, and stay close to both the customer experience and the results of our work. That means being strategic and hands-on aren't separate parts of the job—they go together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Team Leadership & Development: Build and lead a team of three marketers, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, performance expectations, and operating practices for a new function. Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and meaningful ownership, strengthening their ability to independently navigate complex work, make sound decisions, and deliver measurable results. Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Functional Strategy & Prioritization: Translate broader business objectives and customer insights into a cohesive retention and revenue growth approach. Establish the team's roadmap, identify and evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions about priorities, resources, and trade-offs. Balance near-term performance with longer-term improvements while adapting plans as business needs and customer behaviors evolve.
  • Post-Purchase Lifecycle: Lead the development and ongoing improvement of lifecycle marketing programs that strengthen the paying subscriber experience. Guide the team in identifying customer needs, designing relevant experiences, and optimizing programs across email, push, and in-app messaging to drive meaningful behavior change.
  • Revenue Growth: Lead a coordinated approach to growing revenue from existing subscribers, including upsell, churn prevention, add-on attachment, cross-sell, and bundling. Evaluate opportunities across these interconnected programs, make deliberate trade-offs, and ensure initiatives work together to improve customer value and business outcomes.
  • Experimentation, Measurement & Optimization: Establish a disciplined experimentation and measurement approach that enables the team to test hypotheses, evaluate incremental impact, and make evidence-based decisions. Guide the development of meaningful success measures, strengthen the team's analytical capabilities, and use insights to prioritize improvements, scale successful programs, and retire ineffective approaches.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Build effective partnerships with vertical marketing, Product, Analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders to connect lifecycle initiatives to shared business priorities. Influence program direction, navigate competing needs, and help teams align around customer behavior and measurable outcomes. Identify opportunities to extend successful approaches across verticals while accounting for differences in business maturity and customer needs.

Balance adoption goals with team capacity, workload, and change readiness to ensure improvements are sustainable.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Experience using lifecycle marketing platforms such as Braze and product analytics tools such as Amplitude to guide program development, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment around shared priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Applied experience using AI tools to improve workflows, analysis, or marketing effectiveness, along with the ability to evaluate appropriate use cases, exercise sound judgment over outputs, and help others adopt effective and responsible practices.

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. jobs.description:
Why this role and why now?

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and every North American customer deserves a steady, predictable experience from contract signature to go‑live. That’s why we’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to give each implementation a single, accountable owner.

This is not a status-reporting role. You understand the work well enough to judge whether a project is really on track, and you catch issues while they are still small.

If you enjoy ownership, bringing structure to fast-moving projects, and shaping how a growing team delivers, this is your moment.

Your impact

As Project Manager, Technical & Functional, you own the plan, budget, risks, and communication for Ultimo implementations across North America. A customer’s maintenance director and IT lead should each see you as someone who understands their side of the project, from work orders and preventive maintenance to data, integrations, and cutover.

You are trusted to lead the project, not just to track it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own scope, plan, budget, resourcing, risks, and issues for North American implementations, from sales handover through go‑live and transition to support
  • Receive the sales-to-delivery handover, confirm nothing promised is undocumented, and run the customer kickoff
  • Run a consistent communication cadence for customers, internal teams, and subcontractors: weekly status, a shared risk and issue log, steering committees, and clear escalation paths
  • Own the change order process, identifying scope change early and securing customer approval before work proceeds
  • Act as the single point of contact for support tickets raised on active projects and track each one to resolution
  • Coordinate consultants, the Solution Architect, the data migration lead, and internal Ultimo services such as our European practice and product specialists as one team
  • Plan and run cutover, go/no‑go decisions, hypercare, and the formal handover to support
  • Help build the North American delivery playbook, and use AI tools to reduce administrative effort
  • Close projects in a way that turns customers into references

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of experience managing EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations for asset-intensive organizations (IBM Maximo, IFS, SAP PM, MainSaver, or similar)
  • Have strong domain knowledge in maintenance work processes, preventive maintenance, inventory, and reliability, and can discuss them with plant and maintenance leaders
  • Understand data migration, integrations, and cutover well enough to plan them, judge progress, and ask the right questions
  • Have managed fixed-price and time-and-materials projects, raised change orders, and protected margin without damaging the relationship
  • Stay calm under pressure, have stabilized a strained project, and deliver difficult messages clearly
  • Enjoy turning ad hoc ways of working into simple, repeatable standards that a growing team will actually use
  • Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and use AI tools in your daily work
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

Ready to step up?

If you’re looking for a role where customers rely on you to keep their implementation on course, and where you can shape how a growing team delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites for kickoffs, steering committees, and go‑live.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.

Noora Health Bangladesh is part of Noora Health’s broader mission to improve health outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with essential skills to care for their loved ones.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 51.4 million caregivers and patients across 16,000+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

Question Collection & Follow-up

  • Actively listen to patients' and caregivers' questions, concerns, and feedback during calls, and accurately document them for follow-up.
  • Coordinate with the Medical Support Executive (MSE) team to obtain appropriate responses to health-related queries and communicate the responses to the respective users.

Campaign Monitoring & User Feedback

  • Conduct mid-campaign follow-up calls seven days after onboarding to assess message delivery, user engagement, and any questions or concerns.
  • Conduct post-campaign feedback calls to understand users' experience and satisfaction with the service and collect feedback to identify areas for improvement.

Call Documentation & Operational Support

  • Record all calls, upload recordings to the designated Google Drive folders, and maintain accurate call statuses, notes, and follow-up records in the assigned Tracker.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Demonstrated empathy, adaptability, integrity, and attention to detail, particularly when handling sensitive patient information. jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, highly technical role responsible for securing JLL’s global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a security-first mindset, a bias towards action, and deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies alongside broad command of API security, WAF/CDN platforms, and complex troubleshooting across network and application layers. You’ll work collaboratively with global engineering, application, and security teams to ensure security controls are intelligence-driven, optimized, and aligned to industry best practices.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks technologies (NGFWs, Cloud NGFW, Panorama), Web Application Firewall, Content Delivery Network, API Security, IDS/IPS, and DDoS prevention
  • Own onboarding, policy tuning, and lifecycle management for WAF and CDN platforms; lead firewall ruleset optimization, IDS/IPS tuning, and DDoS protection configuration
  • Partner with internal teams to drive the global rollout, tuning, and operational management of URL filtering and TLS decryption across the network estate
  • Lead API security efforts — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, identifying vulnerabilities, and working with application teams on fixes
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex, multi-layer global network and application issues — from packet captures on inter-continental BGP topologies to WAF false-positive triage
  • Partner with business and application teams to produce clear, actionable security documentation, change proposals, and executive-ready findings
  • Analyze existing network security architectures, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive meaningful improvements
  • Configure and report on defensive measures against advanced threat actor tactics; maintain current awareness of the evolving threat landscape and the effectiveness of our defenses against them
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both global engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders
  • Champion the broader Security team’s initiatives, not just Network Security Engineering
  • Participate in the maintenance and tuning of all network security technologies including WAFs, CDNs, VPNs, and application-aware firewalls
  • Leverage and contribute to automation pipelines for global firewall rule deployment and policy management across the network estate
  • Utilize security tooling telemetry and data collection automations to produce actionable reporting and metrics for internal teams and executive stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale security solutions
  • Expert-level proficiency in Palo AltoNetworks — NGFWs, Panorama policy management, and PAN-OS; PCNSE or PCNSC certification strongly preferred
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, including packet capture analysis on complex, dynamically routed architectures
  • Deep understanding of layer 7 web application technologies and WAF/CDN platforms (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, Imperva, F5) — onboarding, policy tuning, break/fix troubleshooting, and operational management
  • Solid grounding in API security — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, evaluating identified vulnerabilities, and partnering with application teams to drive remediation
  • Strong HTTP/application security knowledge: TLS interception, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, command injection, LFI/RFI, rate limiting, bot detection, geo-blocking, and sinkholing
  • Intermediate to advanced network routing and switching knowledge with focus on DNS, TCP/IP, IPsec, TLS, GRE, OSPF, and BGP
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) and familiarity with Linux/CLI tooling
  • Working knowledge of public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform for log analysis, behavioral analytics, and rule tuning
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of taking ownership in unstructured environments — cutting through ambiguity, making sound decisions with incomplete information, building stakeholder consensus, and delivering security improvements without waiting for top-down direction

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications: PCNSE, PCNSC, CCNP/CCIE Security, GIAC (GWAPT, GPEN, or similar)
  • Experience building metrics pipelines and KPI reporting for security operations
  • Familiarity with interconnecting disparate security technologies to solve unique application and security challenges

jobs.description:
About us

At Longdue, we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.

We focus on creating games with real depth—whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality—everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.

Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.

With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new—a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.

We’re Longdue, and we’re finally here.

The role

We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.

Responsibilities

  • Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.
  • Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.
  • Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.
  • Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.
  • Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.
  • Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.
  • An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.
  • Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.
  • Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.
  • Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.
  • Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits

Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Lead Technical Marketing Manager to shape how Lumen brings its cybersecurity capabilities to market. This role translates complex security technologies, architectures, and threat intelligence into credible technical narratives, demonstrable solutions, seller-ready guidance, and customer experiences that accelerate adoption and revenue.

As a senior individual contributor, you will consult on and lead initiatives in partnership with many functions—Product Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partners, and our threat research team, Black Lotus Labs. You will own high-impact technical marketing programs across the cybersecurity portfolio and influence product and go-to-market decisions through customer insight, market evidence, technical depth, and commercial judgment.

Location and Schedule

This is a work-from-home position in the United States. Occasional travel is expected for customer engagements, industry events, demonstrations, sales enablement, and team planning sessions.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the technical marketing strategy: Define and execute technical marketing priorities for Lumen cybersecurity solutions, connecting portfolio strategy to customer use cases, architectures, adoption motions, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Create differentiated technical positioning: Develop clear, defensible messaging and value propositions for technical buyers and practitioners, including CISOs, security architects, SOC leaders, network leaders, and cloud security teams.
  • Build solution narratives and architectures: Translate cybersecurity capabilities into end-to-end reference architectures, validated use cases, solution blueprints, integration patterns, and deployment guidance across network, cloud, edge, and security operations environments.
  • Demonstrate the technology: Design and deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical workshops, webinars, videos, labs, and proof-of-value experiences that show how Lumen and its partners solve priority customer problems.
  • Lead technical content development: Create and govern high-value assets such as white papers, technical briefs, solution guides, blogs, FAQs, architecture diagrams, competitive guides, and technical launch materials.
  • Enable sellers and technical teams: Develop role-based training, discovery guidance, objection handling, battlecards, demo scripts, technical FAQs, and field playbooks that improve seller confidence, solution quality, and conversion.
  • Launch and support growth motions: Serve as the technical marketing lead for attach, cross-sell, and expansion motions. Ensure product, marketing, sales, and partner readiness before market activation.
  • Bring market and customer insight into decisions: Use customer conversations, competitive intelligence, analyst research, win-loss findings, field feedback, and performance data to identify gaps and recommend changes to product strategy, positioning, packaging, and activation.
  • Advance partner-led solutions: Collaborate with strategic cybersecurity partners to create integrated technical narratives, validated architectures, joint demonstrations, content, enablement, and go-to-market programs.
  • Represent Lumen as a technical authority: Engage customers, analysts, partners, and industry audiences as a cybersecurity subject-matter expert while maintaining accurate, evidence-based, and brand-safe claims.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Lead complex workstreams without direct authority, establish clear outcomes and ownership, resolve dependencies, and create repeatable methods that improve the quality and speed of technical marketing execution.
  • Measure and optimize impact: Define success metrics and use adoption, pipeline, content, enablement, demonstration, and customer-feedback data to improve programs and prioritize investment.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, engineering, marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree or relevant security certifications are a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in technical marketing, product marketing, product management, solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, cybersecurity consulting, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated cybersecurity depth across several domains such as network security, DDoS mitigation, SASE/SSE, firewalls, cloud security, threat intelligence, or security operations (SIEM/XDR/MDR).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, cloud and hybrid architectures, security controls, telemetry, APIs, integrations, and operational workflows.
  • Proven ability to convert complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, credible proof points, and actionable field guidance.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, reference architectures, workshops, white papers, solution guides, or comparable practitioner-focused content.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from hands-on practitioners through executive audiences.
  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives across multiple functions without direct authority, while maintaining clear decisions, accountability, and momentum.
  • Commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to connect technical marketing investments to adoption, pipeline, revenue, attach, retention, or expansion outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple priorities, high visibility, and a strong expectation for quality and execution.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience marketing managed security, network-embedded security, threat intelligence, or integrated networking and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Experience working with global telecommunications, cloud, networking, or managed security providers and their technology ecosystems.
  • Hands-on familiarity with security platforms, product labs, demonstration environments, scripting, APIs, or data visualization.
  • Established credibility with customers, analysts, technical communities, or industry events through presentations, publications, workshops, or thought leadership.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Genesys Cloud Access Management supports the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of the Genesys contact center platform in support of the Humana Military organization. This role contributes to the development and execution of contact center and customer experience strategies while ensuring seamless integration with existing IT and telecommunications infrastructure. Work assignments are varied and frequently require the interpretation of business and technical requirements, independent judgment, and the determination of appropriate solutions.

This Genesys Cloud Access Management position supports Humana Military's customer engagement and contact center technologies by administering, securing, and optimizing the Genesys Cloud platform with a primary focus on access management, user lifecycle administration, and platform governance. The associate is responsible for provisioning and deprovisioning user accounts, managing roles, permissions, groups, queues, and authentication controls, and ensuring compliance with organizational security and regulatory requirements.

This role partners closely with business, operations, security, and technology teams to ensure associates have appropriate access to Genesys resources while maintaining the integrity, security, and performance of the platform. The Genesys Engineer 2 supports identity and access management processes, audits, reporting, and remediation activities, and assists with implementing role-based access controls, single sign-on integrations, and governance best practices.

In addition to access administration responsibilities, the associate contributes to the ongoing maintenance, enhancement, and support of Genesys Cloud solutions that enable service excellence for military members, providers, and internal associates. Work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation of business and technical requirements, independent judgment, and the determination of appropriate courses of action to resolve complex issues, improve operational efficiency, and support Humana Military's strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and govern access within the Genesys Cloud platform.
  • Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role assignments, and permission sets.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, audits, and compliance reporting.
  • Support integration with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including SSO and MFA.
  • Maintain queue, division, group, and organizational access structures.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve access-related issues impacting agents, supervisors, and administrators.
  • Collaborate with Security, Compliance, and Operational teams to enforce access governance standards.
  • Support Genesys platform enhancements, upgrades, and operational initiatives.
  • Document access management processes, standards, and technical procedures.
  • Ensure platform security and adherence to Humana and Humana Military policies and controls.


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving user access, authentication, and authorization issues.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity.

The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes.
  • Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions.
  • KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards.
  • Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms.
  • AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation.
  • Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines.
  • Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
  • Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth.
  • Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses.
  • Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics.
  • 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization.
  • Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization.
  • Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation.
  • Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance.
  • Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management.
  • Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation.
  • Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

Additional information

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.

You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.
  • Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.
  • Build and automate a data quality process. Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.
  • Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.
  • Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.
  • Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.
  • Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.
  • Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.
  • Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.
  • Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.
  • Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.
  • An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.
  • Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.
  • Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.
  • Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

  • Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).
  • Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.
  • Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.
  • Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role
  • Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.
  • Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.
  • Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.
  • Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.
  • Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround
  • AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.
  • Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.
  • Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity.
