Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

The Program Manager, Engineering Services is the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients and owns their success end to end: delivery quality, client satisfaction and commercial growth. You will lead multidisciplinary teams delivering utility design and subsurface engineering scopes, keep contracts on schedule and on margin, and turn strong delivery into follow-on work.

This is a true seller-doer role that sits between delivery and growth. You run the work, you own the relationship, and you help win what comes next.

What You'll Do

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients, from contract award through closeout and renewal.
  • Own client satisfaction: set expectations, report status, resolve issues quickly and escalate early on scope, schedule or budget risk.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across owner and prime-consultant organizations, from project engineers to program directors.
  • Lead regular project and business reviews covering performance, outcomes and value delivered.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on engineering design processes, adoption of AI technologies, and management of project risk.

Deliver engineering-services contracts

  • Take overall accountability for the quality of engineering-services deliverables, including utility design, conflict analysis and subsurface utility engineering scopes.
  • Establish the work plan, fee estimate, schedule and staffing for each phase, and lead the kickoff with client stakeholders.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams of engineers, designers, and data specialists to produce on-time, on-budget deliverables.
  • Confirm deliverables meet client, agency and industry standards at conceptual and final design levels.
  • Drive the QA/QC plan, assign qualified technical reviewers and ensure sealed or certified deliverables meet professional standards.
  • Manage subconsultants and teaming partners against scope, schedule, quality and contract requirements.

Control scope, schedule and margin

  • Own project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs; track hours, expenses and earned value.
  • Maintain the project management plan, risk register, decision log and change documentation.
  • Identify scope changes early and manage change requests and contract amendments with the client.
  • Lead recovery planning on troubled projects and run lessons-learned at closeout.

Win future work with key clients

  • Join pursuit teams for future work with key clients, contributing to go/no-go decisions, win strategy, pricing and risk reviews.
  • Lead or support technical approach, staffing and scope sections of proposals, and present in interviews.
  • Track upcoming client programs, solicitations and contract vehicles (IDIQ, on-call, task-order and design-build teaming).

Grow key accounts

  • Own commercial growth of assigned key accounts, with targets for retention, expansion and follow-on contract value.
  • Build and execute account plans aligned to each client's capital program, project pipeline and digital-delivery goals.
  • Identify expansion opportunities: new task orders, additional programs and divisions, and cross-sell of Exodigo mapping and digital-twin services.
  • Partner with Sales on handoffs into long-term account ownership and on new opportunities you surface.
  • Keep CRM records current for account health, pipeline and forecast.

Lead and collaborate

  • Mentor and develop project staff; provide performance input to their managers.
  • Work with Engineering, Operations, Product and Sales to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Feed client insight back into Exodigo's service offerings, AI-assisted design tools and product roadmap.
  • Represent Exodigo at client meetings, industry events and professional organizations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Electrical or a related engineering discipline.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in at least one US state, with the ability to obtain comity licenses as needed.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years managing design or engineering-services contracts for clients.
  • Public-sector client experience (state DOTs, transit agencies, airports, public utilities or municipalities) is required.
  • Proven record of growing and retaining large, complex client accounts, with follow-on work you helped win.
  • Working knowledge of utility design and coordination, and of subsurface utility engineering.
  • Strong command of project controls: work plans, fee estimates, budgets, schedules, earned value, change management and risk registers.
  • Experience preparing proposals and presenting in client interviews.
  • Understanding of public-sector procurement and contract types, including QBS, IDIQ / on-call, task-order and design-build delivery.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% and work effectively in a remote, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Engineering.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), DBIA or CCM certification.
  • Experience in transportation, rail, aviation, power or water infrastructure programs.
  • Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build or alliance delivery, including bridging documents.
  • Experience working for or teaming with large AEC/EPC firms as prime or subconsultant.
  • Familiarity with geophysical methods (GPR, EM, magnetics) and ASCE 75 utility as-built data standards.
  • Proficiency with design and BIM tools (MicroStation/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, Revit) and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Interest in applying AI-assisted design to engineering production.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations (ASCE, ACEC, ARTBA, APTA, ACI-NA or similar).

Key strengths

  • Ownership: you take full accountability for delivery quality and account outcomes.
  • Trusted advisor: clients call you first when a project gets hard.
  • Commercial instinct: you see the next contract inside the current one.
  • Builder: you thrive where processes are still being written.

Compensation - We offer a highly competitive, above-market total compensation package

  • Base: $156,000 - $192,000
  • OTE: $260,000 - $320,000

Location: Miami, FL or Seattle, WA (or easily accessible to)

﻿Ability to travel up to 30%

Exodigo encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants without regard to characteristics protected under applicable federal, state, or local law, including race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.﻿

Learn more

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to directly impact customer success and long-term growth
  • Work with cutting-edge solutions transforming infrastructure and capital programs
  • Collaborative, no-ego team environment focused on customer outcomes

Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.

jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business. We have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About The Team And Position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

We expect bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Position Overview:

This position is responsible for creating, auditing, and processing customer paperwork to timely and accurately register a vehicle. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What the Job Requires

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Hourly Position.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Legal stuff

Franchise Brand Marketing Manager – Kitchen, Bath & Closet Remodeling

Role Details
Reports to: VP of Marketing
Location: On-site (Huntersville, NC) or remote
Employment type: Full-time, exempt
Travel: Up to 30%, for location visits, grand openings and brand events.

About Us
Based in Huntersville, NC, Homefront Brands is an established platform for franchised property services businesses in North America. We have 6 brands (and growing) operating on our platform. Our mission is to be the growth engine for aspiring entrepreneurs, established business builders and our veterans to create and enhance the American dream of building a better future, through the application of our world class franchise models.

About the Opportunity

The Brand Marketing Manager supports the VP of Marketing as the marketing point of contact for The Designery franchise locations and leads implementation of the overall marketing strategy. The role focuses on social media, content, reputation management, grand openings and grassroots community marketing.

The Designery is a HomeFront Brands franchise offering custom kitchen, bath and closet design from local showrooms. As the system grows, this role helps give franchise owners clear direction from day one, consistent local content and reviews, and launches that turn into design consultations.


Additional resources include: HomeFront Brands CMO and marketing team, franchise owners and their staff, Operations, Franchise Development and onboarding.

Key Responsibilities

Social media and content
  • Own social media strategy, content development and audience growth on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook for brand and franchise locations.
  • Build a steady content pipeline with locations: before-and-after project photos, video and reels, and showroom and designer features, with credit standards when imagery is shared across the brand.
  • Measure and report social and content performance monthly.
Reputation management
  • Manage reviews and online reputation across Google, Facebook and other platforms: response standards, review generation and escalation.
  • Report review volume, ratings and response times by location monthly.
Franchise support and strategy implementation
  • Support the VP of Marketing as the marketing point of contact for franchise locations, from signing through opening and ongoing operations.
  • Implement the overall marketing strategy across locations, helping each franchise owner build an annual local marketing plan, backing lead goals out of their revenue target and close rate and aligning spend to brand guidance.
  • Run regular marketing reviews with owners: lead volume and source, cost per lead, consultations booked, and where to shift budget.
  • Coach owners on local SEO, Google Business Profile, paid search and social, email, referral and B2B (designer, builder, realtor) programs, and community marketing.
  • Keep Google Business Profile setup, categories and listings consistent across all locations.
  • Create templated, easy-to-adopt toolkits: campaign kits, social and content guidelines, before-and-after project content standards, email templates, and event formats such as Lunch and Learns.
  • Host recurring franchisee marketing trainings and workshops, and stay current on kitchen and bath marketing tactics and trends so the team is seen as the expert resource.
  • Act as the franchisee's voice inside the brand team, surfacing feedback to improve tools, vendors and processes.
Grand opening playbook
  • Own and continuously improve The Designery's turnkey grand opening playbook: a repeatable process for the marketing team and clear for franchise owners.
  • Lead each new location through pre-opening, grand opening and first-90-days marketing: signage and showroom readiness, local launch campaigns, event registration and RSVP tracking, PR and community outreach, and post-event follow-up that converts guests to design consultations.
  • Coordinate timelines with Franchise Development, onboarding and Operations so every new owner knows what is needed, by when, from the first day.
  • Measure every launch (registrations, attendance, leads, consultations, first-year revenue) and feed lessons back into the playbook.
Grassroots and community marketing
  • Develop grassroots programs locations can run: designer, builder and realtor events, Lunch and Learns, home shows, sponsorships and community partnerships.
  • Provide event kits and track the leads and consultations each program produces.
Vendor and agency management
  • Manage the brand's marketing vendors and agencies, including the local marketing platform (social, reviews, listings), signage and print, direct mail, digital and paid media partners, and PR support.
  • Hold vendors to their contracts and statements of work: service levels, turnaround times, revision limits and reporting.
  • Onboard franchisees to approved vendors with clear instructions so owners are never left to navigate agencies alone.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and cost and recommend changes or new partners as the system grows.
PR support and brand communications
  • Assist with national and local PR as needed, in partnership with the VP of Marketing, including agency coordination, media requests and story ideas from locations.
  • Support each location's local PR: launch announcements, ribbon cuttings, community partnerships and project features.
  • Help run brand-level influencer and creator partnerships that showcase high-end projects in priority markets.
  • Protect brand standards in all franchise and consumer-facing marketing while leaving room for authentic local content.
Other duties as assigned
  • Support brand initiatives such as the annual franchise conference, website and content updates, and brand fund reporting.
  • Perform other duties assigned by the VP of Marketing.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 2 years supporting franchise owners or multi-location businesses.
  • Hands-on experience in social media, content and reputation management, plus grand opening, event and grassroots marketing.
  • Proven experience managing agencies and vendors against contracts and budgets.
  • Working knowledge of local digital marketing: Google Business Profile, local SEO, paid search and social, email, and review management.
  • Experience supporting PR efforts, such as media outreach and agency coordination.
  • Comfortable reading lead and campaign data and turning it into clear recommendations for small-business owners.
  • Excellent communicator who builds trust quickly and can coach, and push back, with confidence.
  • Highly organized; able to manage many locations and projects at once.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Willing to travel for location visits, grand openings and brand events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Home services, home improvement, remodeling, kitchen and bath, cabinetry or interior design experience.
  • Experience with high-consideration, consultative purchases and premium or luxury audiences.
  • Experience with influencer or creator programs and B2B trade referral marketing.
  • Familiarity with the tools we use, such as Searchlight and ServiceMinder, plus local marketing platforms, CRM and email tools (such as HubSpot), event registration tools, and project management tools (such as Monday.com).

What success looks like

First 90 days
  • Met with each franchise owner alongside the VP of Marketing and documented each location's marketing plan, vendors and gaps.
  • Audited the current grand opening process and shipped version 1 of the playbook for the next openings.
  • Reviewed every marketing vendor's contract and SOW and set a regular performance review with each.
  • Standardized Google Business Profile setup across locations.
First year
  • Every location has a written local marketing plan with lead goals tied to revenue.
  • Each new location launches on the playbook, with registrations, attendance and consultations tracked end to end.
  • Franchise owners rate marketing support higher in satisfaction surveys than the prior year.
  • Monthly social, content and reputation reporting in place, with followers, engagement and review ratings trending up.
  • Vendor turnaround and revision issues reduced, with documented SLAs.


HomeFront Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace.

jobs.description:
Description

Java Developer – Data Adapters (AML Platform)

Position Overview

Matrix is seeking experienced Java Developers to design, develop, and support data adapters that integrate banking source systems with an enterprise anti-money-laundering (AML) platform powered by NICE Actimize.

Data adapters are responsible for extracting data from upstream banking systems, validating and transforming it into the required target format, and loading it into the AML platform. These feeds include transactions, trades, accounts, customer and party information, and reference data. The accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of this data are critical to effective AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case management.

The ideal candidates will have strong backend Java development experience, hands-on expertise in ETL or data integration, and the ability to manage data adapters throughout the development lifecycle—from source-to-target mapping and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Java-based data adapters to ingest data from batch files, database extracts, message queues, and REST APIs.
  • Analyze source-system specifications and translate source-to-target mapping requirements into reliable transformation, enrichment, and validation logic.
  • Integrate data from banking systems into the AML platform, ensuring alignment with the platform's data model and interface requirements.
  • Implement data-quality and reconciliation controls, including schema validation, null checks, duplicate detection, record counts, control totals, and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • Develop robust error-handling and recovery mechanisms, including reject and error queues, restart and reprocessing capabilities, idempotent processing, logging, and alerting.
  • Optimize adapter performance to process high-volume data efficiently and meet defined batch windows and service-level agreements.
  • Apply bulk loading, partitioning, parallel processing, and SQL optimization techniques to improve throughput and processing efficiency.
  • Develop and execute unit and integration tests, and support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production deployments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement fixes across source, adapter, and target systems.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, Actimize implementation teams, and client source-system teams to onboard new data feeds and manage upstream changes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, data lineage, and operational runbooks to support auditability and ongoing maintenance.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding, security, testing, and release-management standards.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Java: 5+ years of backend Java development experience, with strong knowledge of Core Java, including collections, concurrency, streams, I/O, and exception handling. Java 11 or 17 preferred; Java 8 or later required.
  • Data Integration: At least 2 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting production ETL, data ingestion, or data integration solutions.
  • Frameworks: Strong experience with Spring and Spring Boot; hands-on experience with Spring Batch or an equivalent batch-processing framework.
  • SQL and Databases: Strong SQL skills with Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, JDBC, and bulk-loading techniques.
  • Data Formats and Integration: Experience working with delimited and fixed-width files, XML, JSON, SFTP, REST APIs, and messaging technologies such as Kafka or IBM MQ.
  • Data Mapping: Ability to interpret source specifications and target schemas and develop accurate, documented source-to-target mappings.
  • High-Volume Processing: Experience processing large datasets, including millions of records per execution, within defined batch-processing windows.
  • Testing: Hands-on experience with JUnit, Mockito, and integration testing using representative datasets.
  • Development Tools: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux, shell scripting, Git, Maven or Gradle, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
  • Scheduling: Experience with enterprise job schedulers such as Control-M or AutoSys.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work directly with client stakeholders in an onshore/offshore delivery model.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or supporting data integrations for NICE Actimize modules, including AIS, UDM, ActOne, AML-SAM, or CDD.
  • Exposure to other AML, financial-crime compliance, or transaction-monitoring platforms.
  • Banking or capital markets domain experience, particularly with trades, payments, wire transfers, accounts, customer data, and KYC attributes.
  • Understanding of AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case investigation processes.
  • Familiarity with big-data and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka Streams, or Hadoop.
  • Exposure to cloud data services on Microsoft Azure or AWS.
  • Experience with data lineage, data-quality frameworks, and regulatory audit requirements.
  • Previous experience working in regulated financial-services environments with formal change-management processes and controlled development, testing, and production environments.

WHY JOIN US

﻿Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

  • Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.

  • Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.

  • Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.

  • Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.

  • Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.

  • Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.

  • Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.

  • Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline reliability, data freshness, and data quality meet agreed targets.

  • AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.

  • Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.

  • Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

If you are passionate about building the data foundation for practical healthcare AI solutions, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Modeling & Simulation Engineer: Power Systems
jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe technology that powers Mainspring’s linear generator is unlike any other generator technology on the market.
jobs.description:
Overview

    The technology that powers Mainspring’s linear generator is unlike any other generator technology on the market. The linear generator relies on innovative power electronics and control systems to achieve its best-in-class efficiency while meeting the world’s strictest emissions requirements. Our generators are being deployed in both front-of-the-meter and behind-the-meter applications, as blackstart-capable backup power and prime-power applications, and in microgrids, datacenters, and utility installations. Before a single unit is energized, our customers and suppliers need to know exactly how it will behave on their electrical systems.

    We have a high impact opportunity for a Modeling and Simulation Engineer to own the electromagnetic transient (EMT) models that Mainspring delivers to customers and suppliers. On the system modeling and simulation team, you will turn our product specifications and control system behavior into professional, versioned, customer-facing simulation models: an executable version of what Mainspring commits to. This role requires a quantitative understanding of power systems combined with a passion and aptitude for software, and the ability to bridge controls, electrical engineering, and product teams.
    Your success in this role will be instrumental in helping customers confidently integrate Mainspring linear generators into their electrical systems, shortening the path from proposal to interconnection to deployment. As the steward of how our generator appears to the outside world, you will collaborate across technical domains, frequently working with leaders in controls, electrical engineering, product development, and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the EMT models (e.g. PSCAD) of Mainspring linear generators that we deliver to customers and suppliers. These models cover DC power generation, startup, load steps and sheds, voltage and frequency disturbance, and IEEE 1547/2800 or NERC PRC-029 ride through scenarios
  • Identify the salient electrical behavior of the generator and its control system, and capture it in reduced-order and behavioral models that integrate with supplier inverter models and customer interconnection studies
  • Partner with product management and leadership to make sure every delivered model faithfully represents the contractual specified generator capabilities and maintain requirements for the simulation system based on input from customers and product management
  • Work with suppliers, such as inverter manufacturers, to integrate their models with ours, and support customers in grid integration and system studies
  • Manage models as a software product: maintain the git repository, version each release, write release notes and user documentation, and package deliverables professionally for external audiences
  • Generate test plans to validate model behavior against measured data from Mainspring linear generators. Oversee the execution of those plans with support from the test team
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers and suppliers using Mainspring models. Troubleshoot integration issues and feed what you learn back into the models
  • Contribute power systems expertise to the team's model-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments and to system simulations
  • Participate in peer review of code written in support of modeling, control, and software work throughout the team.
  • Generate written documentation (presentations, reports, etc.) of model design and simulation results for audiences both inside and outside Mainspring

Qualifications

  • Engineering degree (Electrical preferred, or another discipline with a strong electrical background) with a strong foundation in applied mathematics
  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with 5+ years of practical experience in power systems or power electronics: grid integration, inverter-based resources, electrical machines, DC systems, etc.
  • Familiarity with numerical techniques for simulating electrical systems and their use within commercial packages (e.g. PSCAD, EMTP, PowerFactory, Simulink/Simscape Electrical, PLECS, etc.)
  • Experience designing, building, and validating dynamic system models in a simulation environment or high-level programming language
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical behavior to external audiences
  • A power systems or power electronics background is the key filter. DevOps skills can be learned on the job. Previous PSCAD experience is a very strong nice to have, and should be achievable

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Project Scheduler to build, manage, and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) in support of a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role ensures schedule accuracy, alignment with program milestones, and transparency across stakeholders. The Project Scheduler supports dependency tracking, milestone reporting, MTAR workflow integration, and cross-team coordination to ensure program execution aligns with contractual and mission requirements.

The Project Scheduler collaborates with program managers, technical leads, governance teams, and customer stakeholders to maintain a reliable, data-driven schedule foundation that drives decision-making and operational readiness.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Project Scheduler will:

  • Build and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) using industry-standard tools.
  • Manage schedule dependencies, constraints, critical paths, and milestone sequencing.
  • Integrate MTAR workflows, task approvals, and stage-gate requirements into the master schedule.
  • Provide forecasting, schedule health analysis, and “what-if” scenario modeling.
  • Ensure schedule transparency and accessibility for government and contractor stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with PMO leadership to align scheduling with program plans, resource assignments, and contract deliverables.
  • Develop schedule-related reports, dashboards, and briefing materials for governance meetings.
  • Support risk and issue management by identifying schedule threats and mitigation opportunities.
  • Maintain schedule baselines, version control, and change documentation.
  • Participate in IPTs, sprint planning, technical syncs, and milestone review sessions.
  • Ensure schedule management practices align with DoD, federal, and PMO standards.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess an active Secret clearance or higher.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project scheduling or project control within federal, DoD, or enterprise IT programs.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Integrated Master Schedules for complex technical programs.
  • Experience supporting PMO, program governance, or multi-team engineering environments.
  • Experience with dependency mapping, critical path analysis, and milestone planning.
  • Experience using Atlassian Jira, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn and become proficient in the platform, to maintain accurate and up-to-date Task 1 project information, work items, and tracking data; develop and generate reports; and configure and maintain task-level dashboards to support project scheduling, progress monitoring, performance reporting, and leadership visibility.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Primavera.
  • Understanding of work breakdown structures (WBS), baselines, and earned value concepts.
  • Familiarity with MTAR, stage-gate, or similar program review processes.

Skills

  • Excellent communication skills for interfacing with technical teams and senior stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areFlow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people globally.

Why we are hiring

We run a creator community on TikTok Shop that just took off. Our creators need someone who has done it, consistently, to show them what works. We are looking for one active creator to coach them on a monthly retainer, a couple of hours a day, without giving up your own channels.

You would work directly with our CMO and co-founder and with our TikTok Shop manager.

What you will own

  • Coaching. Helping and training our creators in Discord: hooks, formats, what to post and what to stop posting.

  • Group calls. One or two a week with the community.

  • Content. Making videos with us until we find the formats that win, then teaching the community to make them.

  • Standards. Telling us which creators are worth more samples and which are not.

What this role is not

This is not a full-time job, not a management role and not a UGC contract. You keep your own channels and your own business; this sits beside them.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been consistently profitable on TikTok Shop for at least the last 12 months, every month, not one spike.

  • You have survived bans and algorithm changes and you know why.

  • Your content is the kind people watch for a minute: commentary, clips, stories, not bottom-of-funnel offer spam.

  • You understand direct response and you can explain why a video sold.

  • You like teaching and you are patient with people who are two steps behind you.

What is hard about this

  • We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

  • Our creators are at every level. Some need basics, some need a push.

  • Our category has claim restrictions, so some of what works elsewhere does not work here.

  • We will ask you to make content for a brand that is not yours until the formats are proven.

The engagement

Type

Monthly retainer, independent contractor. Roughly one to two hours a day, reachable during US business hours.

Compensation

Monthly retainer, set with the person. Tell us your expectation when you apply.

Location

Remote, US.

Reports to

Our CMO and co-founder.

Start

As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send us your TikTok handle plus short answers to three questions:

  1. Your last 12 months on TikTok Shop, month by month. A screenshot is fine.

  2. The one thing most creators in supplements and wellness get wrong, and what you do instead.

  3. Your time zone and how many hours a day you could give this.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing & Growth
jobs.excerpt: UtiliSave has recovered over $700 million in utility refunds and savings for large commercial and industrial clients — hospitals, universities, commercial buildings, hotels, and government facilities — across the United States.
jobs.description:
UtiliSave has recovered over $700 million in utility refunds and savings for large commercial and industrial clients — hospitals, universities, commercial buildings, hotels, and government facilities — across the United States. We find actionable savings in 94% of the accounts we audit, including clients previously reviewed by other firms. We work on a pure contingency basis: if we recover nothing, the client pays nothing. And we are not done. We are marching towards One Billion dollars, and we need the marketing leader who will help us get there.

This is not a role for someone who wants to execute someone else's playbook. We are looking for a senior B2B marketing professional who will own UtiliSave's brand, lead generation engine, and thought leadership platform, building on 35 years of industry credibility to drive measurable pipeline growth and establish UtiliSave and its CEO as the authoritative voice in utility cost recovery.

We are seeking a senior B2B marketing leader who brings deep expertise in digital marketing, content strategy, paid media, and lead generation — with the strategic instincts and executional discipline to translate UtiliSave's extraordinary track record into the dominant brand in utility cost recovery. The right candidate will own our CEO thought leadership platform, amplifying UtiliSave's standing through LinkedIn, industry media, speaking engagements, and content that positions us ahead of competitors who cannot match our 35-year track record.

UtiliSave's success is driven by out-of-the-box thinking, a ceaseless energy to achieve success on behalf of our clients, and the ability to uncover novel opportunities within a complex set of rules. We expect our marketing leader to bring the same traits: intellectual curiosity, creative problem-solving, and an ownership mentality that produces measurable results — not just activity.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building and executing B2B marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline, not just impressions. This person is as comfortable setting strategy as rolling up their sleeves to execute. You may be writing a LinkedIn post in the morning, briefing a paid media campaign at noon, and reviewing performance analytics against pipeline targets in the afternoon. This is a senior role with a direct line of influence on company revenue.

What You Will Own

This role carries direct ownership across three domains:

  • Brand & Thought Leadership: UtiliSave's market position, CEO personal brand on LinkedIn and industry platforms, speaking and PR pipeline, and all external content and messaging.
  • Demand Generation: End-to-end digital marketing — SEO/SEM, paid media, email, and content — with accountability to pipeline metrics, not campaign metrics.
  • Marketing Operations: Budget, analytics stack, CRM integration, reporting cadence, and continuous channel optimization against measurable revenue outcomes.

What You Will Build Here

You are joining as UtiliSave's founding marketing leader — the person who establishes the function, sets the standards, and defines how UtiliSave goes to market. As the business scales toward the One-Billion-dollar milestone and beyond, you will help select and build a marketing support team: identifying talent gaps, participating in hiring decisions, and managing and developing the people you bring on. The expectation is not that you do everything alone forever. It is that you build something that lasts.

To apply, email your resume, a brief cover letter, and if available, a portfolio or examples of B2B marketing campaigns you have led to . Use the job title as the subject line. Please include your state of residence, work authorization status, and compensation expectations.

Requirements

Please confirm you meet the following before applying:

  • Full-time remote; core hours 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zone (CT Zone states: Illinois, Missouri, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or active Green Card holder. Visa sponsorship is not available.
    · Must have the certifications and proficiency in the technologies noted in the job description.
    Responsibilities
  • Own the marketing roadmap — setting priorities, allocating budget, tracking performance against pipeline and revenue targets, and continuously optimizing based on data.
  • Develop and execute marketing strategies — social media, email campaigns, content, and all marketing materials — with every initiative measured against its contribution to new client acquisition and brand authority.
  • Lead brand strategy and ensure consistent, differentiated messaging across all touchpoints — ensuring UtiliSave's proof points (94% success rate, $700M+ recovered, 35-year track record, contingency model, legal backstop) are woven into every client-facing communication.
  • Own and optimize all digital marketing channels — SEO/SEM, LinkedIn paid media (the primary B2B channel for this audience), Google Ads, email marketing, and website performance — with clear KPIs tied to lead volume, lead quality, and cost per acquired client.
  • Conduct and supervise research to monitor market trends, competitive activity, and client behavior — identifying gaps and white space that UtiliSave can own before competitors do.
  • Build and execute the CEO thought leadership platform: speaking engagements, industry publications, podcast opportunities, and LinkedIn content strategy that cement UtiliSave's CEO as the authoritative voice in utility cost recovery.
  • Report on campaign results, ROI, pipeline impact, and brand health to leadership on a regular cadence, using dashboards and attribution data that connect marketing activity to revenue outcomes.
  • Serve as brand guardian for all internal and external communications — ensuring every client touchpoint, proposal, and outreach reflects UtiliSave's positioning with precision and consistency.
  • Participate in the selection and onboarding of marketing support staff as the team grows — setting clear role expectations, managing day-to-day work, and developing team members to expand the marketing function's capacity and reach.
  • Build and manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and freelancers — maintaining quality and cost discipline while scaling output beyond what the internal team can execute alone.
  • Leverage AI tools — including generative AI for content drafting, AI-assisted analytics, and marketing automation powered by machine learning — to maximize output, accelerate campaign cycles, and maintain UtiliSave's competitive edge. UtiliSave is actively integrating AI across its operations and expects its marketing leader to be at the forefront of that adoption.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field required. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 2 years in a strategy-owning or marketing leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring direct reports, junior staff, or agency/vendor teams — with a track record of developing talent and expanding team output.
  • Proven success building and executing B2B strategic marketing plans that drove measurable pipeline growth — not just brand awareness. References and portfolio of results required.
  • Deep knowledge of digital marketing, paid media, SEO/SEM, and performance analytics with a proven ability to tie channel performance to pipeline and revenue, not just impressions and clicks.
  • Deep familiarity with LinkedIn as a B2B marketing and thought leadership platform including LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Newsletter, and organic content strategy for company pages and executive profiles. LinkedIn is the primary channel for reaching UtiliSave's target buyer (CFOs, VPs of Real Estate Operations, Facilities Directors at large commercial and institutional organizations) and hands-on expertise is required, not optional.
  • Current certifications in Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing, SEO, and email marketing/CRM platforms strongly preferred. Certifications demonstrate currency — this industry moves fast and we expect our marketing leader to stay ahead of it.
  • Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot or Salesforce preferred), marketing automation tools, and data visualization/reporting platforms.
  • Experience with graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Photoshop) and video editing software — with the ability to produce professional-quality content independently when needed.
  • Experience with website management platforms (WordPress preferred; Squarespace or Wix acceptable).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools — generative AI for content creation, AI-assisted analytics platforms, and machine learning-driven marketing automation. UtiliSave is actively integrating AI across its operations; the successful candidate leads that adoption, not follows it.
  • Self-starter with a proactive, creative mindset and an ownership mentality — this person does not wait to be told what the next initiative is.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines under tight time constraints.
  • Ability to communicate clearly at all levels — from writing a LinkedIn post the CEO is proud to publish to present pipeline analytics to the leadership team.

Additional Information

  • UtiliSave is growing rapidly and this role grows with the company. As UtiliSave expands its client base toward the One-Billion-dollar milestone, the marketing function will scale in budget, headcount, and strategic influence. You will be its architect.

Benefits

o Base salary: $85,000–$110,000 per year, commensurate with experience

o Performance bonus: year-end bonus and merit increases tied directly to delivered results

o Health, dental, and vision insurance

o 401(k) with company match

o 3 weeks paid time off to start, plus 11 paid holidays

o Full-time remote

ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will play a critical role in guiding the planning, coordination, and execution of advanced electrical systems on large-scale infrastructure projects. You will work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners to ensure that all designs are technically robust, code-compliant, and aligned with project objectives. Your focus will be on delivering reliable, efficient, and scalable electrical solutions while upholding safety, quality, cost, and schedule commitments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • You will serve as a key liaison between internal departments, external consultants, contractors, and the Engineer of Record (EoR) to troubleshoot and resolve electrical design challenges.

  • You will lead the development and review of electrical documents, including one-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, submittals, technical studies, and RFIs.

  • You will research and develop emerging trends and new technologies to optimize electrical systems and infrastructure in data centers, enhancing efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

  • You will be responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of design packages by identifying bottlenecks, introducing efficiencies, and proactively managing evolving project requirements.

  • You will ensure electrical systems meet all applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IEC) while maintaining design quality and mitigating technical risk.

  • You will contribute to budget management by evaluating the cost impact of design changes, tracking electrical expenditures, and analyzing contractual obligations tied to the EoR.

  • You will participate in risk assessment and commissioning efforts, including factory and site acceptance testing, milestone inspections, and integration verification.

  • You will coordinate closely with mechanical, controls, and architectural teams to ensure the electrical systems are fully integrated into the broader design framework.

  • You will mentor and support junior engineers, reinforcing consistent design practices and ensuring knowledge continuity across the team.

  • You will help capture lessons learned and apply them to improve future design processes, standards, and project outcomes.

  • You will support construction activities in the field, resolving installation issues, conducting walkthroughs, and ensuring a successful handoff to operations.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Engineering with electrical building systems emphasis.

  • Revit BIM design experience required.

  • Proficiency in power distribution and lighting design, including controls implementation.

  • Experience with short circuit analysis and utilization of analytical modeling software such as SKM or similar tools.

  • Strong background in the design, construction, and commissioning of medium and low voltage electrical distribution systems, and power management or SCADA tools.

  • Preferred qualifications include a Professional Engineering (PE) license.

  • Experience in mission-critical facilities and their electrical/mechanical infrastructure.

  • Knowledge and experience in estimating, electrical design, operation, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, and power monitoring.

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in A/E industry preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of professional services from conceptual design through project close-out.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, organizational skills, and ability to motivate and mentor staff.

  • Familiarity with sustainable design approaches and related project impacts.

  • Passion for improving workflows and mentoring team members.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Productivity Suite products.

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a team that's redefining how data centers get built, we'd love to hear from you. At Worldwide Mission Critical, you'll find the support, trust, and room to grow that helped us become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country — and we're just getting started.

Job Description

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of

Abbott Medical Devices, with revenue of $21B in 2025, is a global leader in providing life changing technology for the management and treatment of people living with chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic pain, and movement disorders.


The Opportunity

The Senior Clinical Monitoring Lead (CML) serves as the regional subject matter expert for clinical monitoring quality, oversight, and execution. This role partners with Clinical Site Management Leadership to drive monitoring excellence through report quality review, monitoring performance oversight, training, mentoring, compliance support, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

The Senior CML provides leadership and support to Clinical Site Leads across the region, helping ensure consistent execution of monitoring plans, regulatory compliance, timely issue resolution, and adherence to company standards. As a recognized monitoring expert, the Senior CML acts as a key liaison among field monitoring teams, study teams, and quality functions to support operational effectiveness and inspection readiness.


As a recognized subject matter expert in Site Quality Monitoring, KCI process, SIV, PMV, and COV, the Senior CML will exhibit fluency on monitoring-related clinical data systems and study-specific Monitoring Plans. Along with monitoring their own assigned sites, the Senior CML will provide direct mentorship on monitoring training, execution, and best practices for all Clinical Site Lead’s throughout the region and also serve as a liaison to Field Clinical Quality Managers.


May be consulted in the following areas: study design, site payments, site audits, local document review, study documents preparation, and submission to site or competent authority/ethics committee. Beyond monitoring assigned sites, the Senior CML is a nationally recognized leader/expert in monitoring who provides support, mentoring and guidance to other clinical site management colleagues and consistently delivers prolific contributions to Global Clinical Operations and/or Business Units.


What You’ll Work On

Monitoring Oversight & Compliance

  • Serve as a regional monitoring expert providing oversight of monitoring quality, monitoring documentation, and compliance with study requirements, GCP, and company procedures.
  • Review and provide feedback on monitoring visit reports, monitoring trends, and quality metrics to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
  • Support CAPA activities, issue escalation management, inspection readiness initiatives, and monitoring-related quality investigations.

Training & Development

  • Provide mentoring, coaching, onboarding, and ongoing support to Clinical Site Leads and monitoring personnel.
  • Lead or contribute to monitoring-focused training initiatives and best practice sharing across the organization.

Monitoring Operations Leadership

  • Partner with study teams, regional leadership, and quality functions to identify risks, monitor performance metrics, and drive resolution of monitoring-related issues.
  • Support development and maintenance of monitoring tools, processes, guidance documents, and operational resources.

Strategic Contributions

  • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance monitoring effectiveness, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as a monitoring subject matter expert for special projects, audits, inspections, and cross-functional initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • 5 years’ experience in a clinical research environment or other equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of regulations and standards (Good Clinical Practices) for conducting clinical research.
  • Polished communicator: written documentation and oral presentations/discussions/meetings
  • Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail
  • Experience and training on GCP

PreferredQualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biological Sciences, Nursing, or a related field OR equivalent or related experience in cardiology or clinical research.
  • 2 years’ experience as a field clinical monitor specialist
  • 5 years relevant clinical trial experience in the cardiovascular and/or Neuromodulation field.

jobs.excerpt: Product DesignerRemote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity About the RoleWe’re looking for a Product Designer to help define how people interact with our product in an AI-native world.
jobs.description:
Product Designer

Remote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help define how people interact with our product in an AI-native world.

This is not a traditional design role where you receive fully scoped tickets and produce polished mockups in isolation. You’ll work directly with engineering, product, and customers to shape the core product experience from first principles. You’ll design workflows where AI is not a bolt-on feature, but a fundamental part of how users think, decide, create, automate, and get work done.

You should be excited by ambiguity, fast iteration, and the opportunity to help build product experiences that feel dramatically better than the SaaS tools people are used to today. We care about taste, speed, craft, product thinking, and your ability to turn messy product ideas into simple, useful, elegant experiences.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help shape and execute design across our core product experience, from early discovery through shipped products. This includes:

  • Designing AI-native workflows that help users move faster, reduce manual work, and trust the system

  • Translating complex product, data, and automation concepts into intuitive user experiences

  • Partnering closely with engineering and product to rapidly prototype, test, and ship new ideas

  • Creating flows, wireframes, prototypes, interaction models, and high-fidelity product designs

  • Defining UX patterns for AI-assisted experiences, including agents, copilots, approvals, suggestions, generated outputs, human-in-the-loop review, and automation transparency

  • Talking to users, watching how they work, and using those insights to improve the product

  • Building and maintaining a lightweight design system that helps us move quickly without sacrificing quality

  • Improving onboarding, activation, navigation, information architecture, and product clarity

  • Using AI tools as part of your own design workflow to move faster and explore more options

  • Raising the product bar by bringing strong taste, clear thinking, and a deep care for usability

What Makes This Role Different

We are building for a world where software is no longer just forms, dashboards, filters, and static workflows. The best products will increasingly feel like intelligent systems that understand context, anticipate work, and help users accomplish outcomes with less friction.

That creates new design challenges:

  • How should users understand what the AI knows and does not know?

  • When should the product act automatically versus ask for approval?

  • How do we make AI-generated work trustworthy, editable, and explainable?

  • How do we help users feel in control without making them do unnecessary manual work?

  • How do we design interfaces that combine deterministic software, probabilistic AI, and human judgment?

You’ll help answer these questions through real product work.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have 3–5 years of product design experience working on complex software, ideally B2B, SaaS, developer tools, data products, productivity tools, or AI products

  • Have excellent UX and product instincts, with the ability to translate customer problems into clear requirements and simplify complicated workflows without losing power or flexibility.

  • Are comfortable working from rough ideas, customer problems, or technical concepts rather than polished product specs

  • Can move quickly from low-fidelity exploration to high-quality shipped design

  • Have strong visual design taste and care about details, hierarchy, spacing, interaction, and clarity

  • Are comfortable working directly with engineers and product leaders

  • Can explain your design decisions clearly and invite critique without becoming defensive

  • Are curious about AI and actively use AI tools in your own work

  • Have a bias toward shipping and learning rather than perfecting work in a vacuum

  • Are ambitious, take ownership of your work, and are eager to develop stronger product thinking and strategic design skills over time

AI-Native Design Experience

You do not need to have spent years designing AI products, but you should be deeply interested in them. We want someone who is actively experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, Midjourney, Runway, or similar tools to accelerate research, prototyping, ideation, writing, and production.

We’re especially excited about designers who think AI changes the product design process itself. You should be interested in using AI to generate concepts, test flows, analyze user feedback, write microcopy, prototype faster, and explore product directions that would have previously taken much longer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing AI copilots, agents, automation tools, workflow builders, or data-heavy interfaces

  • Experience designing for operations teams, product teams, engineering teams, or internal tools

  • Experience with front-end implementation, design engineering, or prototyping in code

  • Comfort working in Figma, Framer, v0, Cursor, React, or similar tools

How We Work

We move quickly, stay close to users, and expect everyone on the team to operate with high ownership. You’ll work closely with founders, product, design, and engineering to identify the highest-leverage opportunities and turn them into shipped product.

We value people who are:

  • High agency

  • Clear communicators

  • Intellectually honest

  • Low ego

  • Strong collaborators

  • Deeply curious

  • Comfortable with ambiguity

  • Obsessed with building useful products

You Might Love This Role If

You want to help define the product experience of an AI-first company from the ground up. You enjoy taking vague, complex problems and turning them into simple, elegant workflows. You like working directly with engineers and customers. You care about speed, taste, and impact. You believe AI will fundamentally change how software is designed and used, and you want to be one of the people shaping that future.

You Might Not Love This Role If

You prefer clear specs, defined handoffs, and a UXR team to run a research phase before design begins. You want what a bigger, established design org gives you: a mature design system, and room to specialize in a narrower part of the product. This role trades that for breadth, speed, and proximity to messy product decisions.

What You’ll Bring

Please share a portfolio or examples of product work that show how you think. We care less about perfectly polished case studies and more about your ability to reason through complex problems, simplify workflows, and ship high-quality product experiences.

Strong examples might include:

  • A complex workflow you made simpler

  • A product experience you designed from zero to one

  • A before-and-after redesign with measurable impact

  • A design system or interaction pattern you created

  • An AI, automation, data, or productivity product you worked on

  • A prototype or side project that shows your taste and initiative

This position requires a technical leader with extensive experience in GPU-accelerated infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), enterprise networking, storage architecture, and AI platform integration.

The ideal candidate will combine deep infrastructure engineering expertise with the ability to advise customers on complex technology investments, develop scalable solutions, and translate business requirements into practical architecture designs.

This individual will collaborate with engineering teams, technical stakeholders, and business leadership to develop infrastructure solutions capable of supporting demanding AI workloads, including large language models (LLMs), machine learning, model training, and enterprise inference applications.

The role requires both hands-on technical knowledge and the ability to lead architectural discussions with senior IT executives.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Infrastructure Architecture

  • Design enterprise-scale infrastructure environments supporting AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads.

  • Develop architecture solutions integrating GPU compute platforms, high-throughput networking, enterprise storage, and workload orchestration technologies.

  • Evaluate infrastructure requirements based on application performance, scalability, resource utilization, and operational costs.

  • Produce technical architecture documentation, infrastructure diagrams, hardware specifications, and implementation plans.

  • Lead infrastructure discovery sessions and technical workshops to identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Design solutions supporting on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid AI computing environments.

  • Assess existing data center infrastructure and recommend upgrades necessary to support GPU-intensive computing.

GPU Computing and Accelerated Infrastructure

  • Architect solutions utilizing NVIDIA accelerated computing technologies and alternative GPU platforms.

  • Provide technical guidance on NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing environments.

  • Evaluate NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell architectures for AI training and inference requirements.

  • Design scalable GPU clusters supporting distributed computing and resource-intensive AI applications.

  • Support GPU platform sizing, performance analysis, capacity planning, and infrastructure optimization.

  • Evaluate AMD Instinct and Intel accelerator technologies when appropriate for customer workloads.

  • Assess infrastructure dependencies including rack density, power distribution, cooling, and physical data center capacity.

High-Performance Networking and Storage

  • Develop high-bandwidth network architectures designed for distributed GPU processing and AI applications.

  • Design and evaluate InfiniBand, RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet connectivity solutions.

  • Integrate high-performance storage platforms supporting large-scale data processing and model training.

  • Evaluate NVMe-based storage, parallel file systems, and distributed storage technologies.

  • Identify network and storage bottlenecks that could affect AI workload performance.

  • Collaborate with network, storage, and data center engineering teams to ensure infrastructure interoperability.

AI Platforms, Automation, and Workload Management

  • Design infrastructure platforms supporting containerized AI applications and distributed computing workloads.

  • Implement architectural solutions involving Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift AI, and Linux-based computing environments.

  • Evaluate workload management platforms including NVIDIA Run:ai, Slurm, and other GPU scheduling technologies.

  • Provide architectural guidance for NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related AI infrastructure software.

  • Support integration of MLOps platforms used for model development, training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Develop infrastructure automation strategies to improve deployment consistency, operational efficiency, and resource utilization.

  • Assist with capacity planning and performance optimization for AI training and inference workloads.

Infrastructure Security and Governance

  • Incorporate enterprise security requirements into AI infrastructure architecture.

  • Design secure environments supporting sensitive datasets, proprietary AI models, and regulated workloads.

  • Implement architectural controls supporting workload isolation, identity management, access control, and infrastructure monitoring.

  • Evaluate security considerations associated with shared GPU resources and multi-tenant computing environments.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to align infrastructure solutions with applicable organizational and regulatory requirements.

  • Provide guidance on infrastructure logging, observability, auditability, and operational resilience.

Technical Consulting and Solution Development

  • Serve as a senior technical advisor during customer discovery, solution planning, and architecture engagements.

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into actionable infrastructure recommendations.

  • Work with technical sales and delivery teams to develop solution designs, equipment requirements, implementation strategies, and project estimates.

  • Present proposed architectures to technical teams, IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.

  • Evaluate competing technology solutions and provide objective recommendations based on performance, cost, and business requirements.

  • Develop reusable technical documentation, architecture standards, and solution frameworks.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging AI infrastructure technologies and evolving industry architecture practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or related disciplines.

  • Significant experience designing complex data center or high-performance computing environments.

  • Strong knowledge of NVIDIA GPU computing technologies and enterprise AI infrastructure.

  • Experience with accelerated computing platforms, GPU cluster architecture, and infrastructure sizing.

  • Advanced understanding of enterprise networking, including high-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand, or RoCE.

  • Experience producing high-level designs, detailed technical specifications, and infrastructure implementation documentation.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. Lightweight Governance & Reporting

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
  • Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
  • Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.

  • Contribute to improving TwinStream’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.

  • Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

  • Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
  • Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
  • Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.
  • Confidence operating in environments that value structure but avoid heavy process.
  • A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset and the ability to bring clarity in uncertainty

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you
