jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer & AI Specialist

About the Role

As Analytics Engineers you would combine insurance domain expertise with full-stack data and analytics engineering capabilities. You will help build the data foundations that power Snowflake's AI platform.

This role is focused on the layers that make AI reliable: clean, well-modeled data, governed pipelines, and semantic models that expose business meaning to natural language interfaces. You will design rigorous data models, build data pipelines, and construct the semantic layer that sits between raw data and AI agents. You will be responsible for setting up data that is structured, trusted, and agent-ready. The deployment patterns and data model gaps you surface feed directly back to LOB teams, making you both a practitioner and a source of signal for what gets built next.

What You'll Work On

Data Modeling and Architecture

  • Architect flexible, performant data models that drive LOB team toward single sources of truth across their LOB business domains
  • Use SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake to build and maintain data infrastructure for reporting, analysis, and automation
  • Perform data QA and develop automated testing procedures for Snowflake data models
  • Provide input into data governance strategies including permissions, data lineage, and data definitions
  • Design Data security so that the model only has access to the data

Semantic Layer and Agent Readiness

  • Build semantic data models that expose LOBs data to natural language queries via Cortex Analyst, turning complex schemas into something a business stakeholder and Clients can ask a question of
  • Define and validate the metrics, dimensions, and relationships that AI agents need to reason correctly over LOBs data
  • IMP
  • Identify and resolve gaps in data structure, naming, and coverage that would cause an agent to fail or produce incorrect results

Documentation

  • Documented playbooks, reusable data model templates, and semantic model libraries that can be maintained and extend
  • Run technical workshops to upskill other team members
  • Author semantic view configurations and skill files (YAML + Markdown) that a non-technical analyst can invoke in plain English

Hard Skills Required Must-Have

  • Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, incremental pipeline patterns. You can write complex queries without referencing documentation.
  • Analytics engineering and data modeling: Experience building data infrastructure involving large-scale relational datasets; strong instincts for pipeline design, QA, and testing across the full stack from ingestion through semantic layer.
  • dbt: Experience building and maintaining dbt projects with testing, documentation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Python: Modern, type-hinted, readable. You understand Python-based data pipelines and automation workflows.
  • AI-assisted development: You have used an LLM coding assistant (CoCo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development environment. Daily usage is the baseline.
  • Semantic modeling: You can write a semantic view configuration or structured skill file that handles edge cases and encodes enough domain knowledge that the model behaves like a subject matter expert.
  • Client-facing communication: You write code, but your output needs to make sense to a business leader who has never opened a terminal. You are the translation layer between what Snowflake's AI can do and what the customer actually needs.
  • Snowflake Cortex: Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Dynamic Tables.

Strong Plus

  • Experience with Airflow or other orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with enterprise business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS, or similar).

Soft Skills Required

  • Owns the outcome: Tracks adoption after go-live, identifies stall points, and re-engages until the data product is reliable and can be handed over to run teams.
  • Codifies, doesn't customize: Instinct is to turn patterns into reusable templates and playbooks that the next engineer can deploy at the next customer, not to build bespoke every time.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: Engages with customers to derive requirements, prototypes fast, gathers feedback, and iterates.
  • Signal clarity: Distills messy deployments into clean, actionable feedback for Leaders, explaining root causes and suggesting fixes, not just reporting problems.

Minimum Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role, with at least a portion of it customer-facing or cross-functional
  • Daily use of an AI coding assistant as a primary development tool
  • Proficient in SQL; can write window functions and complex joins without referencing documentation
  • Experience with dbt
  • Has shipped production data model or pipeline that non-technical business users actually relied on
  • Comfortable in Git (PRs, branches, code review)
  • Demonstrable experience translating business requirements into technical specifications

Why This Role Is Different

Most analytics engineering roles stop at the data model. Most field roles stop at the recommendation. This role starts where both leave off. You own the full data stack from source ingestion to semantic layer, and you ensure every layer is clean, tested, and structured for AI agents to reason over reliably. You write the code. You build the semantic foundation. You make sure it runs in production and the run team can maintain it.

Why Join Nimble Gravity?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Marketing & AI Innovation

What You Will Be Doing

Brand without performance accountability is positioning. Performance without brand coherence is noise. This role exists at that intersection. You will design and orchestrate omnichannel campaigns across web, email, and social that build brand presence and move measurable business metrics, using agencies and freelancers as execution arms while you own the strategy, the brief, and the outcome. You will also serve as the brand intelligence layer for paid media, feeding creative direction and audience signal to the teams running paid so that owned and paid tell the same story and reinforce each other.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Design omnichannel campaigns with a defined performance thesis: what the campaign is supposed to move, how each channel contributes to that movement, and how the audience journey connects web, email, and social into a single arc rather than parallel activations.
  • Own AEO and SEO strategy as a performance lever, not a hygiene function. Define how the brand wins organic discovery, brief agencies to execute against that architecture, and hold them accountable to rankings, traffic quality, and content performance.
  • Conceive social media campaigns with measurable intent, then direct creative agencies to execute with fidelity to the original strategy. Organic social is the proof of brand voice; you own what it says and what it is trying to do.
  • Own always-on email as the highest-accountability channel in the mix: lifecycle architecture, segmentation logic, automation sequences, deliverability, and performance. This is where brand investment converts to relationship, and you treat it accordingly.
  • Brief web agencies on messaging hierarchy, page intent, and conversion narrative. The brief is your product; the agency executes it.
  • Quantify brand performance: share of voice, earned mentions, amplification rates, sentiment movement, and how those signals correlate with downstream pipeline or revenue metrics. Present brand health as a business argument, not a marketing report.
  • Supply paid media teams with creative strategy, audience insights, and messaging frameworks drawn from owned channel performance, so that paid amplification reflects what is actually working, not what looks good in a deck.

Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years in brand, content, or digital marketing with a clear throughline of performance accountability: roles where you were measured on outcomes, not output.
  • Proven ability to architect campaigns that operate across owned channels simultaneously, with the discipline to define how each channel's job is distinct and how they compound.
  • Strong AEO and SEO strategic fluency, including an understanding of how large language models and answer engines are reshaping organic brand discovery.
  • Agency management experience with evidence that your briefs produced sharp, on-strategy work, not just adequate work.
  • Deep operational ownership of email as a performance channel: you have built lifecycle programs, optimized sequences, and reported on email's contribution to business outcomes.
  • Ability to connect brand metrics to business metrics. You can explain why share of voice moved, what drove it, and what it is worth.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor's in Communication, Journalism, or related Marketing degrees

You Are Not the Right Fit If

  • You think brand and performance are different teams' problems.
  • You measure success by what you produced rather than what it moved.
  • You let agency interpretation substitute for strategic clarity in your briefs.

About the role

We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.

What you'll do

  • Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.
  • Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.

  • Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.

  • Experience in both agency and corporate recruiting.
  • Demonstrable examples of using AI to improve recruiting efficiency and performance management, with outcomes you can quantify.
  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder skills, including with senior leaders.
  • Fluency with an ATS and recruiting analytics.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as the business changes.
  • A track record of building and leading TA teams through growth and change, including hiring, developing, and retaining recruiting managers and individual contributors.
  • Experience managing leaders and managers, plus a distributed team across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience owning a TA budget and a hiring plan, including capacity modeling and agency and vendor spend.
  • Experience building or rebuilding a recruiting operating model: team structure, process, tooling, and reporting.
  • Experience presenting TA strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences, and partnering with Finance on workforce planning.

Overview

The Data Engineer/Analyst collaborates with clients, data scientists, and software engineers to develop and optimize data pipelines, ETL processes, and database structures that support IRS compliance activities. The role involves identifying and integrating data sources, enhancing data quality and accessibility, and creating scalable solutions to extract insights on payment collections and taxpayer behaviors. This position ensures that analytical models and data solutions are validated and prepared for deployment within agency functions.

  • Experience with structured databases and query languages (e.g., PL/SQL, Postgres, MySQL), including optimization of SQL queries.

  • Critical thinker with excellent attention to detail.

jobs.title: IT Service Technician I
jobs.excerpt: At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them.
jobs.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:
In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support to VC3 clients, with a strong focus on resolving client requests to their satisfaction. You will also assist your Service Technician teammates with their incident ticket workload when needed.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide end user support to VC3 clients via inbound phone, email and webchat, following ITIL founded triage model to determine the appropriate course of action
  • Troubleshoot technical issues including hardware (monitors, keyboards, printers), applications, VPN/remote access, network drives, DNS, and workstation performance issues
  • Support user account management in Active Directory, Exchange, and O365, including account set ups/terminations, password resets, email updates and permission changes
  • Perform standard service tasks such as IMAC (installs, moves, adds and changes) requests, software installs, system updates
  • Manage mobile and telephone support, including email set up on mobile, adjust phone systems, call forwarding and updating extensions
  • Investigate spam/phishing emails, secure compromised email accounts, and complete malware scan and removal
  • Escalate out of scope issues to the appropriate elevated team
  • Ensure proper documentation by updating tickets, changing logs, internal guides, and knowledge base articles
  • Participate in the on-call rotation (1 week every 3-4 months)
  • Additional duties as required

The tools you bring:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support or customer service position OR recent technical education experience in a post-secondary environment
  • Demonstrable understanding of Windows OS (7–11), Office Suite/365, Windows Server (2016–2025), Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, and Terminal Services, MS Entra environment
  • Go Beyond– you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated.
  • Own It - You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line.
  • Be Curious - You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning.
  • Serve as One - You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success.

What’s in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment
Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Job Summary

Our premier destination marketing solutions power destinations across the globe, helping communities attract visitors, meetings, conventions, and sporting events. The Destination Insights team partners with Destination Marketing Organizations (DMOs), Convention & Visitor Bureaus (CVBs), and other destination stakeholders to deliver both technology solutions and strategic guidance that help clients make smarter, data-driven decisions.

We are seeking a customer-facing Senior Data Insights Analyst to support the development and delivery of innovative analytics solutions, reporting products, and strategic insights for destination customers. This individual contributor role combines business analysis, analytics, reporting, and data visualization to transform complex data into actionable recommendations and customer-facing analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing business goals with a customer, designing reporting solutions, analyzing data, developing dashboards, and partnering with technical teams to deliver repeatable analytics and reporting solutions. This role serves as a bridge between customer needs, business objectives, and technical implementation, helping ensure our solutions deliver measurable value to customers and internal stakeholders.

Who We Are

  • Data-driven thinkers, grounding our insights and recommendations in measurable data and business context.
  • Innovators, leveraging design thinking and other frameworks to help our customers embrace change and unlock new opportunities for growth.
  • A team that values curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement in pursuit of better customer outcomes.

How We Show Up to Work

  • Demonstrate polished, professional relationships with colleagues and customers.
  • Assume positive intent and be collaborative, creating space for different perspectives and expertise.
  • Be dependable, accountable, organized, and effective in managing priorities and commitments.
  • Be proactive, curious, adaptable, and willing to try new approaches.
  • Be empathetic to the needs and experiences of customers and colleagues.
  • Be open to feedback and committed to continuous growth.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Essential Functions

    • Lead customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, gather requirements, define KPIs and reporting needs, and design data-driven solutions.
    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics products, including dashboards, reports, KPI frameworks, and other repeatable reporting solutions.
    • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights, translating findings into clear recommendations.
    • Work with Data and Engineering personnel to define data requirements, business rules, KPI calculations, and reporting requirements. Validate data quality, business logic, and reporting accuracy.
    • Serve as a customer-facing analytics resource by presenting findings, facilitating discussions, providing strategic recommendations, and supporting solution adoption.
    • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, Implementation, and Client Success teams to enhance analytics products and services.
    • Contribute to repeatable analytics solutions, standards, documentation, and best practices for the Destination Insights team.
    • Translate analytical findings into clear narratives, presentations, and recommendations tailored to customer business goals and executive audiences.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Analytics & Data Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into repeatable analytical, reporting, and dashboard solutions. Advanced SQL skills for querying and analyzing large datasets, investigating data issues, preparing analysis-ready outputs, and validating business logic and reporting results.
  • Experience working with relational databases, cloud data warehouses, and multiple data sources.
  • Understanding of relational data structures, KPI development, reporting frameworks, and how data is organized for analytics and business intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Knowledge of data quality management, validation methodologies, and troubleshooting data inconsistencies.
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines, data transformations, and cloud data environments sufficient to document requirements, communicate effectively with Data and Engineering teams, investigate issues, and validate analytics outputs.
  • Ability to clearly document source-data requirements, business rules, KPI calculations, reporting logic, and acceptance criteria.

Consulting & Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience leading customer and stakeholder discovery, eliciting requirements, facilitating discussions, and translating business needs into analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Ability to present insights, recommendations, and reporting solutions to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation and business communication skills.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Ability to independently manage projects and priorities from concept through delivery.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to continuous improvement.

Experience/Credentials:

  • You have 5-8 years of related experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis, including experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, mathematics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Skilled in working with large data sets, including strong proficiency in SQL for analysis and validation.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations directly to customers, executives, or senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience leading requirements gathering, stakeholder discovery sessions, and KPI definition workshops.Proficiency with analytics, reporting,and presentations tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint and similar platforms.
  • Other ideal qualifications include:
    • Experience in the tourism or hospitality industry
    • Experience with hospitality technologies, particularly Simpleview CRM and event and meeting technology.

If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. jobs.description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the collection, extraction, cleansing and validation of commercial data across Ergomed, PrimeVigilance and ADAMAS, working with business data owners to resolve discrepancies and ensure reliable reporting inputs.
  • Prepare and deliver weekly commercial reports to agreed deadlines, highlighting key movements, trends, exceptions and areas requiring leadership attention at Group, business and regional levels.

  • Design, build and maintain Microsoft Power BI data models, dashboards and reports, providing consistent Group-level views and business-specific drill-downs with appropriate access controls and reliable refresh processes.

jobs.description:
ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    The Electrical Estimator will serve as a critical member of the preconstruction team, providing leadership and specialized expertise for electrical scopes of work, including electrical distribution, medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, low-voltage, communications/structured cabling, and fire alarm. The Electrical Estimator will be responsible for initial market research, conceptual budgeting, cost estimating, change order forensics, and buyout support for these scopes, working in concert with the Lead Estimator and Mechanical Estimator to deliver complete, well-coordinated project budgets.

Primary Responsibilities

    Market Research & Analysis

  • Conduct regionally-specific market research on electrical systems, including labor availability for electrical trades, commodity trends for copper, aluminum, conduit, and switchgear, equipment lead times for long-lead items (generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS, medium-voltage gear, busway), and other factors affecting costs.

  • Maintain detailed records of historical project costs, including labor, materials, and equipment.

  • Analyze historical data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for cost optimization.

    • Conceptual Budgeting & Cost Estimation

  • Develop conceptual budgets for electrical scope elements based on market analysis and project scope.

  • Prepare detailed estimates for labor, materials, and equipment, factoring in project complexity and location.

  • Generate cost variance reports at major design milestones to track trends, inform stakeholder decisions, and identify value-engineering opportunities.

  • Lead and support takeoffs using Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, LiveCount or similar tools.

  • Lead in the analysis of subcontractor, vendor, and OEM pricing for electrical distribution, generators, switchgear, UPS, medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, low-voltage/security, communications, and fire alarm scopes of work.

    • Cost Reconciliation and Change Order Support

  • Collaborate with general contractors and trade-partners to reconcile project costs and ensure scope alignment.

  • Provide support for change order forensics and perform cost reconciliation with trade-partners as needed to verify pricing accuracy.

    • Constructability Reviews and Value Engineering

  • Conduct thorough constructability reviews focused on electrical, medium-voltage, low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm scopes to identify potential challenges and improvements in design, including coordination of electrical systems with the building structure, mechanical systems, and architecture.

  • Work with project stakeholders to implement value-engineering solutions that optimize efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

  • Evaluate alternative materials, methods, and technologies to enhance constructability and reduce long-term maintenance expenses.

    • Trade Procurement & Buyout Oversight

  • Contribute electrical scope requirements and specifications to WWMC-prepared RFP documentation for general contractor (GC) procurement, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and complete scope coverage.

  • Provide review-and-assist oversight of the GC-led buyout of electrical trade partners, reviewing bid packages across electrical distribution, medium-voltage, site dry utilities, low-voltage/security, communications, and fire alarm for completeness and alignment with the project scope.

  • Review and assist with bid-leveling, analyzing trade-partner proposals to normalize pricing and identify scope gaps, exclusions, and pricing anomalies.

  • Participate in GC and trade-partner selection meetings, offering independent input on firm suitability, qualifications, and cost competitiveness.

  • Assist with pre-bid RFIs and site walks by reviewing responses and flagging issues relevant to electrical scopes.

  • Provide oversight of the GC-led post-bid interview and negotiation process, validating assumptions and confirming pricing accuracy on the owner's behalf.

  • Occasional travel to project sites for kick-offs, pre-bid walks, and constructability reviews.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • 5+ years of estimating experience with a strong emphasis on electrical, medium-voltage, low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm scopes in mission-critical, data center, or other heavy industrial projects.

  • Proven ability to estimate projects $50M+ in total electrical contract value.

  • Ability to perform quantity takeoffs for electrical distribution and conduit/feeders, equipment (generators and switchgear, UPS, etc), medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, structured cabling/low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm systems.

  • Proficiency with estimating software (Accubid, or similar) and Microsoft Excel.

  • Solid understanding of data center-specific electrical challenges, including critical power topologies, redundancy concepts, and the ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and specifications.

  • Familiarity with electrical equipment lead times and procurement strategy for long-lead items such as generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, and medium-voltage gear.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with the estimating team.

    • Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent estimating experience in lieu of a degree.

We are seeking an experienced Test Manager to lead the testing strategy, governance, and delivery assurance for large-scale data platform transformation initiatives. This role will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end testing across modern data environments, ensuring high-quality delivery through robust test management practices, stakeholder engagement, and effective coordination with vendors and project teams.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in testing complex data ecosystems, cloud-based platforms, and enterprise-scale data programs. You will play a key role in defining test strategies, managing test execution, driving automation initiatives, and ensuring quality outcomes across multiple streams of work.

This role will lead the end-to-end testing strategy and delivery for large-scale data platform and cloud transformation initiatives, ensuring quality outcomes across complex enterprise environments. The Test Manager will be responsible for developing test strategies, governance frameworks, and delivery plans, overseeing test execution across Unified Data Platforms (UDP), Master Data Management (MDM), Network Data Fabric, and cloud-based data solutions such as Azure Databricks, GCP, and BigQuery. Working closely with business stakeholders, project teams, and external vendors, the role will drive test automation, manage risks and defects, ensure adherence to quality standards, and provide delivery oversight throughout the project lifecycle. The successful candidate will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support the adoption of modern testing practices, including AI-driven and agentic testing capabilities where appropriate.

  • Proven experience in a Test Manager role delivering testing services across large-scale enterprise programs and complex technology environments.
  • Strong background in data platform testing, including data migration, data quality, ETL/ELT validation, integration testing, and analytics platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure Databricks, Unified Data Platforms (UDP), GCP, and BigQuery.
  • Experience testing enterprise data solutions across Master Data Management (MDM), Network Data Fabric, and modern data ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in test strategy development, test planning, execution management, defect management, and quality assurance governance.
  • Strong understanding of test automation frameworks, tools, and best practices, with the ability to drive automation adoption across programs.
  • Experience managing testing vendors, distributed test teams, and multiple stakeholder groups in complex delivery environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and reporting skills.
  • Ability to manage risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes while ensuring adherence to testing standards and governance requirements.
  • Exposure to AI-driven testing, intelligent automation, or agentic testing approaches would be highly regarded.
  • Experience supporting cloud transformation, data modernisation, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives is advantageous.

We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: About UsSTACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform their workflows from first bid through final handoff.
jobs.description:
About Us

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform their workflows from first bid through final handoff. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

Contractors buy STACK to change how they bid and build. Your job is to make sure that happens. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a book of about 440 growing contractor teams – companies with two to four STACK users – and help each of them get real, lasting value from the platform.

You'll work from customer signals. When usage drops, a renewal gets close, or a new user goes quiet, you'll know about it and reach out with a plan. It's a great fit for someone who cares about customer outcomes and wants their time to go where it makes the biggest difference.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own a named book of about 440 accounts. Keep a current health score on every account, refresh it monthly, and know where each customer is in their journey.
  • Respond to customer signals within 48 hours. Each signal points to one account and one specific problem. Pick the right play, act on it, and record the result so the team learns what works. When an account goes quiet, treat that as a signal too.
  • Drive adoption and value. Our north star is customers doing real work: someone active in STACK on at least five days in the last 30. Find the accounts that have slipped and help them get back on track with practical, workflow-focused conversations.
  • Manage renewals. Keep a renewal calendar for your book and start every renewal conversation at least 90 days out. Automated reminders handle the routine work, so you can focus on results.
  • Protect and grow seats. Help customers keep the users they have and add more as their teams grow. Spot expansion opportunities and pass qualified leads to our sales team.
  • Forecast accurately. Call commit, risk, and lost renewals by name each week.
  • Be your customers' go-to contact. Answer workflow questions yourself, bring in Support for product issues, and loop in our Industry Consultants for trade-specific work.
  • Pick up accounts from implementation. Accounts with two or more users join your book from our Onboarding & Consulting team at day 120.

Onboarding and Time to First Value:

The first 90 days shape the whole customer relationship. Our Onboarding & Consulting team gets new customers to first value. You step in when the signals show a customer is stuck, and you help that early momentum last.

  • First value is a completed takeoff in week one. Customers who run a takeoff in their first week are 4.72x more likely to still be active at day 30. Every new user added to an account should reach that same milestone.
  • Work closely with Onboarding & Consulting. Know which incoming accounts missed early milestones before they reach your book, so nothing gets lost in the handoff.
  • Share what you learn. You'll often spot a pattern before the data does. Bring it to Onboarding & Consulting and Digital Success so the whole program gets better.

How Success Is Measured:

We measure you on the work you can influence day to day. Company-wide results like gross and net revenue retention matter too, and the whole team shares them.

  • Primary measure: Percentage of your book with a current health score, refreshed monthly
  • Secondary measures: Signals answered within 48 hours, signal queue cleared daily, renewals started 90 days out, forecast accuracy each quarter
  • Team goals: Customers doing real work across the enterprise segment, week-one takeoff rate, month-three usage rate, net seat retention rate, gross revenue retention

Your First 90 Days:

  • Weeks 1–3: Get to know your book and set a health score on every account. Start working renewal and usage-risk alerts right away.
  • Weeks 2–6: Build a renewal calendar for the next four quarters, and start any renewal that's already inside the 90-day window.
  • Weeks 4–8: Focus on accounts at risk of reducing seats, and reach out to customers who have stopped using STACK.
  • Weeks 8–12: Run your first full forecast cycle and compare it with actual results at quarter end.

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years owning enterprise or strategic accounts.
  • Experience managing a named book of hundreds of accounts, with a realistic approach to how you spend your time.
  • A habit of acting on what customers are doing in the product, and the discipline to keep your queue clear.
  • Comfort holding a renewal conversation and a workflow conversation in the same call, with customer value leading the way.
  • Curiosity about the product. You'll use STACK yourself so you can help customers solve real problems.
  • A careful, accurate approach to forecasting.
  • An understanding of seat growth as a retention strategy. Customers with more than one user are far more likely to stay.
  • Experience in construction or estimating is a plus. Familiarity with Salesforce and Gong is expected.

What We're Building:

Our Customer Experience team is building a signal engine that brings risk, adoption, and expansion signals together in one place. Today, much of that work happens by hand with renewal tracking and usage alerts in Slack. Over the next two quarters, we're adding nightly risk monitoring, a single work queue, and automated digital outreach, followed by recommended plays for each signal. You'll help shape how it works.

How Our Team Works:

Five beliefs guide how our Customer Experience team serves customers:

  • Meet customers where they are. A one-person roofing company and a 40-person general contractor get the same commitment, delivered in the way that fits each of them best.
  • No customer left behind. Every customer gets our full activation program, including in-app guidance, learning paths, community, and webinars.
  • Adoption compounds. A well-placed in-app moment can help thousands of customers at once, so we invest in programs that scale.
  • Signals guide our time. We reach out when something happens in an account, including when it goes quiet.
  • Earn the renewal early. A customer's decision to renew takes shape in their first few months, so our work starts in week one.

Each team has a clear focus: Onboarding & Consulting teaches, Customer Success intervenes, Support answers, and Digital Success builds the programs that help customers at scale.

About Scale
For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the full customer journey, from the first ad someone sees to their tenth order.

You will own the truth behind our Retention, Acquisition, and Content performance. We need a Customer Value Master who understands ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon Ads), CRM and loyalty platforms (Klaviyo, Loyalty Lion), and creative performance data, and who can build the predictive models that tie them all together.

Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Retention, Media Buying, Amazon, and Creative teams, connecting acquisition spend and content performance to the outcome that matters most: long-term customer value.

What You'll Do

1. Predictive Modeling

  • Churn & LTV Models: Build, validate, and maintain churn, predicted LTV, and purchase propensity models, and get them into regular use by the retention and acquisition teams.
  • Customer Segmentation: Develop segmentation that informs targeting, offers, and bidding strategy.
  • Model Health: Monitor model performance over time and retrain as customer behavior shifts.

2. Retention & Lifecycle Mastery

  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Analyze data from our CRM and loyalty platforms (Klaviyo, Loyalty Lion) to provide granular insights on LTV, repeat purchase rates, and cohort degradation.
  • Customer Logic: Define and maintain "active vs. lapsed vs. churned" logic for both subscription and one-time purchasers.
  • Incrementality: Measure the true incremental impact of email, SMS, and loyalty programs, including holdout testing.

3. Acquisition & Attribution Mastery

  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Analyze paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Amazon Ads to provide granular insights on ROAS, CAC, payback, and new-customer quality.
  • Attribution Expert: Move beyond "last-click." Design and read incrementality and lift tests, and use our marketing measurement platform (e.g., WorkMagic) and MMM outputs to guide budget allocation.
  • Reconciliation: Explain the gaps between ad platform, attribution, and Shopify/Amazon data clearly to media buyers.

4. Content & Creative Performance

  • Creative Analytics: Analyze ad creative and content performance (hooks, formats, angles, landing pages, and video engagement) to identify what drives efficient acquisition.
  • Downstream Impact: Connect creative-level data (e.g., Motion) to conversion and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel metrics.
  • Creative Support: Give the creative and content teams a clear, repeatable read on winners, fatigue, and what to test next.

5. Data Transformation & Visualization

  • Data Preparation: Handle the "last mile" of data prep using dbt or Python to build the datasets behind retention, acquisition, and creative analysis.
  • Business Logic Application: Write efficient SQL in Snowflake that reflects our specific business rules.
  • Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain high-impact dashboards in Sigma that give each team a trusted, consistent view of performance.

6. Leadership & Collaboration

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Present findings and recommendations to marketing and growth leadership in a clear, compelling way.
  • Raise the Bar: Review other analysts' work and share modeling best practices across the team.

What We're Looking For

The Essentials (Experience & Tech Stack)

  • Experience Level: 5+ years of Data Analysis experience, with meaningful time in DTC, subscription, or consumer marketing analytics. (We are looking for a senior, hands-on individual contributor, not a people manager.)
  • Predictive Modeling: Hands-on experience building and shipping churn, LTV, or propensity models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting) that the business used to make decisions. This is required.
  • Industry: Proven experience in DTC E-commerce is required. You must be fluent in Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and Klaviyo data schemas.
  • Warehousing & BI: Expert SQL in Snowflake, strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or similar), and proficiency with Sigma or a comparable BI tool.
  • AI Tools: Fluency with Claude Code (or comparable AI coding tools) for data manipulation and analytics.
  • ELT Familiarity: Awareness of how ELT tools (like Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer.

The "Customer Value Master" Skill Set

  • You understand the difference between pixel data, server-side tracking, and ad-platform reported data, and you can explain the discrepancy between Facebook Ads Manager revenue and Shopify revenue without blinking.
  • You have designed or analyzed conversion lift tests and understand incrementality (ideally using a measurement tool like WorkMagic, Lifesight, or Measured).
  • You are deeply versed in Klaviyo and Loyalty Lion data, and you understand how deliverability and Apple's Mail Privacy Protection (MPP) distort lifecycle metrics.
  • You can tell a creative that drives cheap clicks from one that drives high-LTV customers.

The Customer & Growth Mindset

  • You are comfortable with subscription metrics (MRR, churn rate, retention curves, payback periods).
  • You have the patience and precision to trace a single customer's journey from first ad click through email opens, SMS clicks, and loyalty redemptions to their true lifetime value.

What We Offer

  • Salary: $100,000 - $125,000 depending on experience
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous Paid Time Off program
  • Discounted Products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

jobs.excerpt: Our missionWe're making Africa the first cashless continent.
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

  • Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.
  • Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.
  • Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.
  • Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.
  • Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.
  • Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.
  • Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

In this role, you'll...

  • Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
  • Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction.
  • Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
  • Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.
  • Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
  • Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.
  • Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you’ve shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you:
    • Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org
    • Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation.
  • Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you’ve seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don’t just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you’re excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you’ll feel right at home here.

If that’s you, we’d love to meet you.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

About the Job

The Student Service Advisor (SSA) is a full-time, non-exempt, remote position reporting to the Director of Retention for the College of Adult and Graduate Studies (CAGS). The SSA guides and assists CAGS students toward successful degree completion and attainment of educational goals. This position is a key component in the retention and persistence of students.

While the campus is in Lakewood, CAGS students are located in varying regions both inside and outside of Colorado. As a result, this position requires high levels of accurate and concise communication (email, phone, and in-person, depending on the student’s location).

A polished, professional demeanor is required. Hours may vary depending on student need and may include evenings and weekends.

Job Location

Remote - must reside and work legally in the U.S. All work must be performed within the U.S.

About CCU

Colorado Christian University is the premier interdenominational Christian university in Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region, delivering world class education to thousands of students. The fully accredited, nonprofit University is located in Lakewood, Colorado, a suburb of Denver.

Colorado Christian University was founded in 1914. CCU’s motto is--grace and truth. This motto comes from John 1.14: “And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory, the glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.” (ESV)

CCU's mission is Christ-centered higher education transforming students to impact the world with grace and truth.

Colorado Christian University cultivates knowledge and love of God in a Christ-centered community of learners and scholars, with an enduring commitment to the integration of exemplary academics, spiritual formation, and engagement with the world. We envision graduates who think critically and creatively, lead with high ethical and professional standards, embody the character and compassion of Jesus Christ, treasure the gospel, and who thereby are prepared to impact the world in their callings.

CCU embraces an educational model that was present at the foundation of many of the great western and American universities. It is made up of three pillars—competence, character and Christ-centered faith. Secular universities have abandoned two of those pillars. We think this is a major oversight that eventually undermines education. Furthermore, we believe this classical educational model is both life-giving and greatly needed in our time.

A leader in higher education, CCU has been consistently ranked in the top 2 percent of colleges and universities nationwide for its core curriculum by the American Council of Trustees and Alumni. CCU has had ten consecutive years of enrollment growth and has been named one of the five fastest-growing master’s granting universities by The Chronicle of Higher Education.

CCU offers more than 200 degree program options for traditional and adult students through its two colleges--the College of Undergraduate Studies and College of Adult and Graduate Studies. More than 9,000 students attend the University on the main campus, in regional centers throughout Colorado, and online.

What is most appealing about working at CCU?

  1. Faith-friendly: CCU’s culture is unique to higher education. Where else can you pursue academic excellence yet read the Holy Bible, pray with teammates and students at work, and work to impact our culture in support of Christian values?
  2. Convictionally Christian: As a university, we have an enduring commitment to Christ, his kingdom and the truth of God’s Word.
  3. Live out your calling: We are a traditional evangelical university where you can invest your God-given talents and abilities alongside coworkers and teammates, while having a profound influence on students as they deepen their relationship with Jesus Christ.
  4. Equip students for kingdom work: You can be a part of helping students discover their callings and preparing them for positions of significant leadership in the church, business, government, education, and other professions, as a key part of our University's Strategic Priorities.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  1. High technology proficiency; fluency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
  2. Confidence with a high level of inbound/outbound calls; proven ability to articulate clearly and persuasively, yet professionally, with students.
  3. Self-confidence, patience, empathy, and availability when building rapport with students; ability to understand and adapt quickly to multi-generational needs and characteristics.
  4. Ability to be a creative, out-of-the box thinker who takes initiative to find solutions while clarifying and enforcing CCU’s expectations and policies.
  5. Flexibility, a teachable spirit, and openness to change; ability to proactively locate appropriate resources to assist with unfamiliar situations; confidence in asking questions, and ability to recognize and learn from mistakes.
  6. Consistently cohesive working relationships, ability to view conflict positively and operate with honesty and respect in all communication.
  7. Disposition to enjoy a high-energy call center-type work environment, maintain focus amidst unexpected distractions, and manage disruptions with professionalism.
  8. Previous advising, student service, higher education, public relations, customer service, or similar experience preferred.
  9. Bachelor’s degree (preferred).
  10. Bilingual speaking and writing proficiency in Spanish/English preferred.

Key Job Duties

  1. Contribute to CCU’s mission: CCU provides Christ-centered higher education to transform students to impact the world with grace and truth. The SSA contributes to this mission by guiding and encouraging students to fulfill their God-given calling and educational goals by providing quality, Christ-centered advising to enhance and advance exemplary academics, spiritual growth, and engagement with the world.
  2. Answer student questions via phone, email, and in-person advising appointments (depending on location); documents details in student’s record. Sample topics include: course registration, financial aid, academic progress, transfer credits, life/school balance, available student resources, faculty concerns, and other student needs.
  3. Initiate outbound calls to students to assess early intervention needs, build advisor/advisee relationships, ascertain obstacles to course completion or registration, and proactively and persuasively challenge students to successful continuation and academic excellence.
  4. Analyze, organize, and update reports, spreadsheets, and templates for effective time management, data integrity, efficient student communication, and trending student retention.
  5. Interpret and analyze student data in order to proactively contact students and achieve monthly retention goals.
  6. Partner strategically with other departments to facilitate and process time-sensitive student requests.
  7. Prepare and plan for future blocks/semesters; collaborate with colleagues on special projects; attend team meetings and training webinars/conference calls.
  8. Perform other duties as assigned.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, you may be required to walk, stand, sit, reach with hands and arms, balance, stoop, speak with clarity, and have appropriate vision and hearing capabilities. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

What we offer our employees:

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. Our benefit package includes: a tuition waiver program, excellent healthcare, generous paid time off, matching 403(b) retirement plan, and additional organizational paid benefits and voluntary benefit offerings. Pay and benefits will be discussed in more detail as candidates progress through the interview process.

Colorado Christian University’s pay philosophy is based on internal and external data for pay equity; along with budgetary considerations for effective stewardship. Pay will be assigned based on relevant experience at a range of $18.00 - $18.82/hour. We reserve the right to pay an equitable rate that we believe is within our salary structure or that may fit a candidate’s qualifications or experience for the job. A wage range posted is not a guarantee of a specific wage range for a job offer. CCU reserves the right to make pay decisions based on economic and equity considerations to attract the best possible talent. CCU does not determine pay based on sex or any other protected status.
