The ideal candidate combines the coordination and problem-solving abilities of an experienced travel consultant, the patient-service skills of a healthcare administrator, the commercial mindset of a sales professional, and the digital confidence of an experienced remote worker.

The Patient Experience & Operations Coordinator is responsible for front-desk support, patient communication, appointment coordination, enquiry follow-up, administrative accuracy and selected social media and digital operations.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused position for someone who enjoys managing multiple moving parts, anticipating what needs attention, solving problems and ensuring that tasks are completed without constant supervision.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working across several digital platforms, communicating professionally with US-based patients and colleagues, and balancing patient service with commercial outcomes such as bookings, retention and reactivation.

Key responsibilities

Patient experience and front-desk operations

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for current and prospective patients.

  • Manage incoming calls, voicemails, emails, texts and other assigned communication channels.

  • Provide timely, professional, empathetic and helpful responses to patient enquiries.

  • Explain approved service information, pricing, appointment availability and booking procedures.

  • Assist patients with scheduling, rescheduling and general administrative questions.

  • Handle concerns professionally, recognizing when an issue requires escalation to the General Manager or a clinician.

  • Maintain a positive, relationship-focused patient experience consistent with The Sports Pod's brand and service standards.

  • Ensure patient enquiries and unresolved issues have a clear next step, owner and follow-up deadline.

Appointment coordination and scheduling

  • Manage appointments, cancellations, rescheduling, confirmations and related follow-ups using Jane or the clinic's designated practice-management system.

  • Monitor schedule changes and identify opportunities to fill available appointment slots.

  • Follow up with patients who cancel, miss appointments or leave without a future appointment where appropriate.

  • Help patients arrange their next appointment in accordance with clinician recommendations and established workflows.

  • Maintain accurate appointment statuses and communication records.

  • Coordinate competing scheduling requests and communicate changes to the appropriate team members.

  • Ensure outstanding scheduling matters are tracked through to resolution.

Sales, enquiry conversion and patient retention

  • Respond to prospective patient enquiries and guide suitable prospects through the booking process.

  • Follow up with prospective patients who have not completed booking.

  • Use approved scripts, service information and professional communication to address questions and booking objections.

  • Maintain a structured record of enquiries, contact attempts, bookings and outcomes.

  • Support patient retention through appropriate follow-up, rescheduling and reactivation workflows.

  • Contact inactive patients or patients who have fallen out of their usual care schedule using approved processes.

  • Identify missed booking opportunities and communicate trends or recommendations to management.

  • Support the clinic's revenue and utilization objectives through consistent execution of patient follow-up processes.

Healthcare administration and recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate patient records, appointment information and administrative notes.

  • Follow clinic procedures for documentation, patient communication and information handling.

  • Handle confidential information responsibly and comply with applicable privacy and security requirements.

  • Recognize the boundaries between administrative support and clinical decision-making.

  • Direct clinical questions to the appropriate clinician rather than providing unauthorized clinical advice.

  • Support administrative processes related to patient payments, billing follow-ups and outstanding administrative items, within approved procedures and permissions.

  • Identify missing information, discrepancies or incomplete tasks and take appropriate action.

Social media and digital engagement

  • Assist with the day-to-day management of The Sports Pod's business social media presence, particularly Instagram and LinkedIn.

  • Schedule and publish approved content in accordance with the content calendar.

  • Monitor social media comments, direct messages and enquiries.

  • Respond to routine enquiries using approved guidance and direct prospective patients into the appropriate enquiry and booking process.

  • Assist with organizing photos, videos, captions and other content assets.

  • Create or adapt basic social media content, including captions, simple Canva graphics and short-form video edits, as required.

  • Repurpose existing approved content for different platforms.

  • Monitor basic engagement and enquiry metrics and report useful observations to the General Manager.

  • Maintain the clinic's brand voice and professional standards across all online interactions.

  • Protect patient confidentiality and ensure required authorization is obtained before any patient-related content is published.

  • Escalate clinical questions, sensitive comments, complaints and content requiring approval.

Technology and digital systems

  • Use digital tools confidently to manage communication, tasks, documentation, reporting and daily operations.

  • Use Slack for team communication, updates, handoffs and escalation.

  • Use Notion to manage assigned tasks, update statuses, follow standard operating procedures and maintain operational documentation.

  • Use Jane or similar practice-management software for scheduling and patient administration.

  • Use Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs and Google Drive, for correspondence, tracking, file management and reporting.

  • Use Canva or equivalent tools for basic graphic design and content preparation.

  • Learn new software and digital workflows quickly.

  • Troubleshoot routine technical and workflow issues and escalate problems appropriately.

  • Maintain organized digital records and follow security requirements for passwords, account access and confidential information.

  • Demonstrate an interest in AI tools, automation and process improvement, including identifying repetitive administrative tasks that could be simplified.

Task management and operational accountability

  • Manage multiple concurrent responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

  • Prioritize work according to urgency, patient impact, business requirements and established procedures.

  • Maintain clear task statuses and next actions in Notion or the designated task-management system.

  • Follow documented standard operating procedures and checklists.

  • Ensure assigned tasks are completed, documented and closed out appropriately.

  • Provide a concise end-of-day update covering completed work, outstanding items, blockers and matters requiring management input.

  • Communicate proactively when deadlines may be missed or a task cannot be completed.

  • Identify recurring problems and suggest practical improvements to reduce errors and unnecessary manual work.

  • Work independently while maintaining clear communication with the General Manager and wider team.

Required qualifications and experience

Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Previous experience working remotely with a US-based employer, customer base or client team.

  • Experience in a hospital, healthcare facility, medical practice or another patient-facing healthcare administration environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple simultaneous tasks, changing priorities and competing deadlines.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with professional telephone and customer-service skills.

  • A sales-oriented mindset, with experience in lead follow-up, booking conversion, customer retention, reservations or service recommendations.

  • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated record of completing tasks reliably.

  • Confidence working with digital platforms and learning new software.

  • The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and escalate issues appropriately.

  • A professional, empathetic and solutions-oriented approach to customer and patient interactions.

  • Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable remote-working environment.

  • Availability during the agreed working hours aligned with the Dallas clinic's schedule.

Preferred qualifications and experience

The following will strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Previous experience as a travel consultant, travel agent, corporate travel coordinator, reservations consultant or booking coordinator.

  • Experience in hospital admissions, patient access, medical reception, patient coordination or healthcare customer service.

  • Previous experience supporting a US healthcare practice or other appointment-based US business remotely.

  • Professional experience using Slack and Notion.

  • Experience using Jane or another healthcare practice-management system.

  • Experience with CRM systems, task databases, operational trackers or structured follow-up pipelines.

  • Experience scheduling business social media content for Instagram, LinkedIn or similar platforms.

  • Basic Canva design, short-form video editing or content repurposing skills.

  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and basic operational reporting.

  • Exposure to AI productivity tools, automation platforms or digital process improvement.

Personal attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Highly organized: Able to keep track of numerous open tasks without relying on memory alone.

  • Proactive: Notices what needs attention and takes action within their authority.

  • Commercially minded: Understands the importance of bookings, conversion, retention and revenue.

  • Service-oriented: Genuinely enjoys helping people and delivering a positive patient experience.

  • Calm under pressure: Can handle interruptions, urgent requests and changing priorities without losing control of other responsibilities.

  • Accountable: Takes ownership of assigned tasks, communicates issues early and follows through to completion.

  • Technologically confident: Comfortable learning new systems and using digital tools to work efficiently.

  • Professional and discreet: Handles sensitive information and difficult conversations appropriately.

  • Adaptable: Willing to work across patient service, administration, scheduling and basic digital marketing support.

Performance expectations

Performance will be assessed against agreed, measurable targets, including:

  • Reliability of assigned front-desk coverage.

  • Timeliness and quality of patient and prospective-patient communication.

  • Enquiry follow-up and booking conversion.

  • Completion of cancellation, rescheduling, retention and reactivation tasks.

  • Accuracy of appointment records and administrative documentation.

  • Completion of assigned tasks and daily reporting within agreed deadlines.

  • Quality and consistency of social media publishing and enquiry handling.

  • Appropriate use of Slack, Notion and other operational systems.

  • Ability to resolve routine issues independently and escalate exceptions appropriately.

  • Contribution to improving workflow reliability and the overall patient experience.

Specific numerical targets will be established during onboarding based on clinic volume, existing performance and the responsibilities assigned to the role.

What success looks like

The successful candidate ensures that patients receive timely and thoughtful service, enquiries are followed through to booking or a documented outcome, cancellations and follow-ups are managed proactively, records remain accurate, and routine tasks are completed without constant management intervention.

They help maintain an organized, responsive and commercially effective front desk while supporting selected social media activities and using technology to improve operational efficiency.

Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, manages competing priorities intelligently, communicates clearly and consistently closes the loop.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Chinese Simplifiedvoice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
jobs.description:
We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Chinese Simplifiedvoice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 9 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Chinese Simplified.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States.
jobs.description:
Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status.
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!

Role Overview

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Senior CSM) at Deputy, you are the trusted strategic partner and customer advocate for a dedicated portfolio of high-value Mid-Market and Enterprise customers (typically accounts with 250+ to 1,000+ RTE). You engage during implementation by shadow-managing alongside Professional Services—ensuring seamless alignment, intervening proactively if roadblocks arise, and taking formal ownership at Go-Live. Across the customer lifecycle, you drive adoption, mitigate churn risk, lead strategic EBRs, and partner closely with Account Management to identify and qualify expansion opportunities.

This role will be joining our CSM team on a 12 month fixed term contract.

Key Responsibilities

    1. Implementation Partnership & Lifecycle Transition

  • Implementation Shadow-Management: Actively shadow-manage accounts during the onboarding and implementation phase alongside Professional Services to ensure early stakeholder alignment, validate configuration against business goals, and step in swiftly to mitigate risk if milestones or timelines stall.

  • Go-Live Handoff: Lead a frictionless transition from implementation to steady-state operations, ensuring zero loss of institutional context and delivering immediate continuity for customer admins and executives.

    • 2. Strategic Account Ownership & Relationship Management

  • Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture multi-threaded relationships across executive and operational leadership (HR, Operations, Payroll, and C-Suite).

  • Mutual Success Planning: Co-create, maintain, and execute customer-specific Mutual Success Plans aligned with strategic business objectives, operational workflows, and quantifiable ROI.

  • Executive Business Reviews (EBRs / QBRs): Prepare and facilitate high-impact business reviews to showcase delivered value, present adoption metrics, share product roadmap updates, and realign on executive priorities.

  • Customer Advocacy & Proof Points: Cultivate referenceable customer relationships, partnering with Marketing to produce case studies, customer quotes, reference calls, and review platform engagement (e.g., G2).

    • 3. Product Adoption, Enablement & Ecosystem Navigation

  • Drive Depth of Adoption: Monitor portfolio usage telemetry, guiding customers on best practices to deepen adoption of core and advanced modules (e.g., smart scheduling, award interpretation, timesheets, and payroll readiness).

  • Tech Ecosystem Alignment: Comfortably navigate and advise on enterprise software ecosystems, troubleshooting and guiding standard workflows involving HRIS, payroll, and POS integrations (e.g., ADP, BambooHR, Gusto, Xero).

  • Strategic Enablement: Conduct tailored consultative workshops and optimization sessions to help customers operationalize new product capabilities.

  • Internal Feedback Loop: Synthesize customer feedback, recurring friction points, and feature requests to champion customer needs with Product, Engineering, and Design.

    • 4. Retention & Proactive Risk Mitigation

  • Churn Prevention & Health Tracking: Continuously evaluate account health scores, platform telemetry (via Vitally/Salesforce), and support ticket trends to detect early indicators of risk or "silent churn."

  • Escalation Management: Act as the senior point of escalation for complex account issues, mobilizing Support, Professional Services, and Product teams to resolve critical blockers.

  • Renewal Partnership: Partner proactively with Account Managers (AMs) 90–120 days ahead of renewals, sharing usage health, relationship sentiment, and delivered ROI to ensure predictable, on-time contract renewals.

    • 5. Growth, Expansion & Commercial Partnership

  • Expansion Identification: Uncover organizational changes, new business units/locations, or unmet operational workflows suitable for add-on modules (e.g., Deputy HR, advanced compliance, payroll sync) or seat growth.

  • Pipeline Enablement: Scope and qualify expansion leads before passing them seamlessly to Account Managers to close commercial agreements.

    • 6. Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Mentorship: Provide coaching, deal support, and onboarding guidance to Associate and Mid-level CSMs across the Customer Success organization.

  • Playbooks & Tooling: Contribute to internal CS best practices, standard operating procedures, EBR templates, and health check playbooks.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Experience: 5 to 8+ years of B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management experience, with at least 2+ years managing Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts.

  • Ecosystem Acumen: Strong comfort understanding and navigating SaaS tech ecosystems, integration touchpoints (APIs, webhooks, SSO), and upstream/downstream data flows between operational tools and payroll/HR systems.

  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of leading high-stakes meetings, workshops, and EBRs with senior leadership (COO, VP HR, Head of Payroll).

  • Process & Tooling Fluency: Hands-on experience working with modern CS and CRM tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Vitally or Gainsight, Jira, Slack).

  • Problem-Solving Rigor: Demonstrated ability to step into complex or stalled customer situations, diagnose root causes, and align internal cross-functional resources to drive swift resolution.

  • Domain Knowledge: Direct background in Workforce Management (WFM), HR tech, payroll, or time-and-attendance platforms is strongly desired.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net Dollar Retention (NDR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR): Achieve portfolio retention targets (standard benchmark: ≥110% NDR / ≥95% Gross Retention).

  • Platform Utilization & Health: Maintain target health scores and active feature utilization across assigned accounts.

  • Executive Engagement: Execution rate and quality score for scheduled BRs and active Mutual Success Plans maintained in Vitally.

  • Customer Satisfaction: Achieve portfolio-level CSAT and stakeholder NPS targets (typically average stakeholder NPS 35+).

  • Expansion Pipeline Generated: Total qualified expansion pipeline (leads and seats/ARR) handed over to Account Management.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Work Model: Remote

  • Travel Requirements: 10% to 15% travel required for on-site Executive Business Reviews, high-priority customer workshops, and occasional company offsites.

Employee Perks

- Enjoy a flexible work policy (with a work-from-home stipend to set you up for success at home!)
- Own a piece of Deputy through our Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP)
- Take paid parental leave to support you and your family
- We’ll match your 401k contributions to help you save for the future
- Access mental health support with Spring Health
- Get comprehensive health benefits
- Use our commuter reimbursement program
- Take additional leave days — including 20 PTO days, study assistance, celebration days and volunteering
- Join our global working groups; focused on collaboration, belonging and connection
Deputy believes in equal opportunity and that inclusiveness and diversity promotes innovation. Our global team members are from a variety of cultures. And we welcome different perspective and skills.

jobs.title: Fire Alarm Designer
jobs.excerpt: Wachter's greatest asset is the people who work here.
jobs.description:
Wachter's greatest asset is the people who work here. Join the Wachter family and chart your career path!

Wachter is accepting applications for Fire Alarm Designer positions in our Engineering and Design department. This role is responsible for designing and developing fire alarm systems for commercial and industrial projects, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and customer requirements.

Ideal candidates will hold a NICET Level 4 Fire Alarm Systems certification. We will consider a NICETlevel 3 candidate if you are open to getting your Level 4 certification asap.

Candidate must possess equivalent fire alarm design experience with a strong understanding of NFPA codes, AHJ requirements, and industry best practices. Experience designing fire alarm systems for retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site deployments is highly preferred.

We seek self-motivated and reliable candidates who can work independently and find solutions to complete the job. Long-term employment with competitive pay and exceptional benefits for qualified candidates. We value relationships and invest in our employees.

Qualifications:

  • NICET Level 3, (preferably a NICET Level IV) Fire Alarm Systems certification required, or equivalent experience in fire alarm system design and engineering.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience designing commercial and/or industrial fire alarm systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of NFPA 72, NFPA 70 (NEC), IBC, IFC, and applicable local codes and AHJ requirements.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and other design software used for fire alarm system layout and documentation.
  • Experience developing complete construction drawing packages, including floor plans, riser diagrams, battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, device layouts, and equipment schedules.
  • Familiarity with major fire alarm manufacturers such as Notifier, Siemens, Edwards, Simplex, Honeywell, Bosch, or equivalent platforms.
  • Ability to review architectural, electrical, and mechanical drawings and coordinate fire alarm designs with other building systems.
  • Experience supporting permit submissions and responding to plan review comments from AHJs and third-party reviewers.
  • Strong understanding of voice evacuation systems, mass notification systems, and networked fire alarm systems.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining design quality.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.

Responsibilites:

  • Design complete fire alarm and emergency communications systems in accordance with NFPA, NEC, IBC, IFC, local codes, and customer specifications.
  • Prepare detailed construction drawings, submittal packages, device layouts, riser diagrams, sequence of operations, battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, and equipment schedules.
  • Review architectural, electrical, mechanical, and site plans to develop code-compliant fire alarm system designs.
  • Coordinate with project managers, field technicians, customers, authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), and other stakeholders throughout the design and permitting process.
  • Support permit applications and respond to plan review comments, requested revisions, and code compliance inquiries..
  • Ensure all designs meet customer requirements, project schedules, budgets, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Provide technical support to installation teams during project execution and assist with troubleshooting design-related issues.
  • Collaborate with sales and estimating teams to develop scopes of work, equipment recommendations, and design concepts during project planning.
  • Maintain current knowledge of fire alarm codes, emerging technologies, manufacturer requirements, and industry best practices.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo. It's for someone who wants to build something.

The Director of Enterprise Sales will report to our SVP of NorAm Sales (Private Sector). This role requires a seasoned sales leader with a track record of exceeding targets, building high-performing teams and navigating complex sales cycles in the enterprise segment ($1B+ Revenue).

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile

  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

.

.

If you enjoy working alongside our talent Development and Design teams to build enterprise-level web applications, define how the application looks and functions, and drive changes to improve the overall user experience, we’d love to hear from you!

    • Paid casual and sick leave, plus country-specific holidays

In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, and more.

Check us out and learn more at: !

Additional Details: 

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.   
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer, strongly values inclusion, and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. 
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. 
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.  

What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?

jobs.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the role:

At Afresh, we’re building data products to define the future of retail grocery analytics. The nerve center of those products is our analytics platform, and as a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science and Analytics team, you’ll be the technical leader of that platform.

Our growing suite of data products range from standardized reports to AI-driven insight engines and agentic analytics tools. They let our customers understand what’s happening in their stores and empower them to reduce food waste. All of these products require a reliable platform of well-modeled data, clearly-defined metrics, and extensive metadata and context.

This platform is also used by teams across the company to ensure customer success and improve our core products. The Data Science and Analytics team collaborates closely with every team in the company, helping them build products and make decisions with data. You will regularly interact with data engineers, product engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations specialists.

What You'll Do:

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science team, you will own the development of our analytics platform. You’ll evolve our data models, solidify our pipelines, and establish data governance patterns to serve our internal- and customer-facing analytics needs. Some of your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving, extending, and optimizing our data analytics architecture to provide reliable and accessible data for our suite of data products;
  • Collaborating with stakeholders across the company to understand their data needs, and then build extensible dimensional models, semantic layer metrics, and agentic context and tooling that will allow for consistent and reliable AI-assisted insights;
  • Evolving our existing data quality and data governance processes; and
  • Mentoring and up-skilling other engineers

This is a high-impact role with ownership of highly visible projects and a lot of room to grow in your scope.

Skills and experience:

  • 6+ years of experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or similar role.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to facilitate cross-team and cross-functional collaboration and information-sharing.
  • A drive to learn new skills and dive into unfamiliar domains.
  • A strong sense of ownership and agency — taking initiative to spot problems and solve them without waiting to be told.
  • Fluency in advanced concepts in SQL, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design; experience with Cloud Data Warehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Proficiency in dbt
  • Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow/Astronomer, Dagster, or similar)
  • Experience with modern semantic layers: LookML, Cube.dev, Databricks Metrics Views, dbt MetricFlow, etc.).
  • Experience designing and optimizing pipelines of billion+ row datasets
  • Experience working with and extending AI models to produce high quality code and reliable analytics. Experience working on
Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.
*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states: AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA, UT, VA, WI.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Client Account Manager

Location: New York, NY, Atlanta, GA, or Remote, USA

Exemption Status: Full-time, exempt

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.

Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary:

Impiricus is seeking a dynamic Client Account Manager to be the first dedicated client services hire for DocUpdate, supporting Curated, our physician engagement and matchmaking platform. Curated connects physicians with meaningful non-clinical opportunities, including advisory boards, consulting engagements, market research, expert calls, and other professional collaborations across healthcare.

You will be the primary relationship owner for your accounts and manage the client experience from initial intake through successful delivery, serving as the bridge between our clients and the Curated operations team. Your clients will span legal, AI labs and technology companies, medtech, CROs, biotech, locum tenens and staffing, health systems and IDNs, and other industries outside of pharma. You will also be the day-to-day partner for Impiricus’s client services teams, who bring pharma programs onto Curated; those programs run through Curated independently of Impiricus’s commercial teams.

This is a true ground-floor role. There is no existing playbook for client services within DocUpdate, and you will help write it. We are looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful, and commercially curious, who builds trusted relationships easily and is energized by creating structure where it doesn’t yet exist. As Curated scales, so will the team around you, and the people who shape the foundation are the ones we look to as the business grows.

Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of Curated clients across legal, AI and technology, medtech, CRO, locum tenens, health system, and other non-pharma industries, building trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Partner day to day with Impiricus’s client services teams as they bring pharma programs onto Curated, helping them scope, launch, and deliver with a consistent, high-quality experience.
  • Guide clients through the full lifecycle of a physician engagement program, from intake and scoping through physician sourcing, scheduling, delivery, and follow-up.
  • Understand each client’s objectives and ensure projects are delivered with exceptional service and attention to detail.
  • Proactively communicate project updates, timelines, risks, and next steps while maintaining a high-touch client experience.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen relationships and expand partnerships over time, from repeat engagements to new use cases.

Program & Project Coordination

  • Partner closely with internal Curated operations teams to coordinate physician recruitment, scheduling, compensation, and project execution.
  • Manage multiple concurrent client engagements across different industries while ensuring timelines and deliverables remain on track.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication between Operations, Product, Finance, Legal and Compliance, and other internal stakeholders, honoring the separation between Curated’s client work and Impiricus’s commercial teams.
  • Monitor project health and proactively resolve issues before they impact clients.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and project information within CRM and project management systems.

Building the Function

  • Act as the founding member of Curated client services: define how intake, onboarding, communication standards, escalation, and reporting work for external clients and internal partners alike.
  • Turn what you learn from every engagement into repeatable playbooks, templates, and tooling that let the business scale without losing the high-touch experience.
  • Be the voice of the client inside the company, bringing insights to Product and Operations that shape the platform and what we offer.
  • Support onboarding of new clients and contribute to a consistently exceptional customer experience.
  • Demonstrate leadership potential, with the opportunity to grow into a people leadership role, hiring, developing, and guiding the team as the business scales.

Education & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree required, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, Customer Success, Strategic Accounts, or a related client-facing role.
  • Experience within healthcare technology, medtech, digital health, SaaS, marketplaces, or another complex B2B environment.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously across different industries while delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong executive presence.
  • A record of ownership: you have built or improved a process, program, or team function without being asked, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment with limited structure.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar customer management systems.

Preferred

    • Experience supporting clients across healthcare, medtech, biotech, AI, legal, staffing, or life sciences organizations.
    • Familiarity with expert networks, market research, advisory boards, or other physician engagement models.
    • Experience working with Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) or health systems.
    • Experience collaborating across Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance, or serving internal teams as customers.
    • Previous experience helping build or scale client-facing processes, or a client services team, within a growing organization.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary for this role is $95,000 - $115,000.

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Important Notice

To protect candidates, please note that all communication from our team will come directly from an @impiricus.com email address. We do not engage third party recruiters to schedule interviews for this role. If you receive outreach from anyone outside of our domain claiming to represent Impiricus, please disregard and let us know by forwarding the message to

jobs.excerpt: Description﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker This is a hands-on Remote Reconciliation & Payments Specialist (AI-Enhanced) role inside Chargeflow's Billing & Collections team.
jobs.description:
Description

﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker

This is a hands-on Remote Reconciliation & Payments Specialist (AI-Enhanced) role inside Chargeflow's Billing & Collections team. Money comes in from customers of every size — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts — across multiple payment channels, and you are the person who makes sure every payment is matched against what the customer was actually invoiced. It's detailed work, it lives largely in Excel, and getting it right matters.

The core of the job is ownership: you reconcile what a customer owes against what they've paid, you close the loop against the invoice we issued, and you don't let it go until it's genuinely resolved — including chasing an open item well after the month has closed. "It'll probably sort itself out" is not part of the role. If a customer hasn't paid their debt, you stay on it until they have.

You'll work across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or simply wrong — so a critical eye is not optional. You need to be the person who notices that two numbers don't agree and cares enough to find out why. It can be frustrating, but the payoff is real: there's genuine satisfaction in untangling a mess and getting it to tie out.

We're also a company that wants to do this smarter over time. You won't be expected to build automation from day one — but we do want someone who is hungry to turn manual, repetitive work into AI-assisted workflows, with Claude as your day-to-day partner for getting there. The role sits within Billing & Collections and reports to the Billing & Collections Manager.

About Chargeflow

Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.

Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.

What You’ll Own

Reconciliation & Collections

  • Reconcile customer payments against invoices across the full customer base — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts.
  • Match every incoming payment to what the customer was actually invoiced, and close the loop between the payment received and the invoice issued.
  • Investigate every unmatched, partial, or unexpected item down to root cause — don't leave gaps open.
  • Track what each customer owes, confirm the debt has actually been paid, and follow up until it's fully resolved — including items that carry past month-end.
  • Own your accounts end to end: you're responsible for the reconciliation being clean, correct, and complete, not just started.
  • Keep clear, well-documented working papers so anyone can see how a balance was reached.

Working Across the Systems

  • Do the heavy lifting in Excel — this is a spreadsheet-intensive role (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets).
  • Pull and cross-check data across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or inconsistent.
  • Keep a critical eye at all times — assume the data needs verifying, and dig in when two numbers don't agree.
  • Take real ownership of the details: notice the discrepancy, care about it, and drive it to a clean answer.

Communication & Responsiveness

  • Be responsive to the people who depend on you across the company — Billing, Finance, Operations, and Customer Success.
  • Work fluidly across the channels the business runs on: Slack, monday.com, and email.
  • When it's the fastest way to resolve something, get on a call with a customer and walk them through their reconciliation directly.
  • Explain a billing or reconciliation situation in plain, clear language to someone who isn't in finance.

Making the Work Smarter (Over Time)

  • Look for manual, repetitive steps that shouldn't stay manual — and bring the hunger to improve them.
  • Partner with Claude and other AI tools day-to-day to speed up reconciliation and reduce manual effort as you grow into the role.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in reconciliation, collections, billing, or accounts receivable — ideally in fintech, SaaS, or eCommerce - Must
  • A genuine ownership mindset — you take responsibility for your accounts, go down into the detail, and don't consider something done until it's actually resolved - Must
  • The persistence to stay on an unpaid or unreconciled item until it's closed, including well after month-end — you're not comfortable letting things sit - Must
  • Strong Excel skills — this is a spreadsheet-heavy role (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, large data sets) - Must
  • A critical eye for data — comfortable working across multiple systems where the data is broken or inconsistent, and instinctively verifying rather than assuming - Must
  • Strong attention to detail — able to spot when two numbers don't agree and to work a discrepancy down to zero - Must
  • Responsive and easy to work with — comfortable fielding requests across Slack, monday.com, email, and the occasional customer call - Must
  • Clear communicator — able to explain a reconciliation or billing issue simply to people who aren't in finance, including customers - Must
  • Curious about doing the work smarter — interested in using AI tools (Claude included) to reduce manual effort over time. Prior automation experience is not required - Must
  • Native or near-native English — clear, professional written and verbal communication - Must
  • Comfortable working with customers of all sizes, from SMB to Enterprise - Must
  • Familiarity with chargebacks, payment disputes, or PSP data — an advantage.

How We Work
