We are hiring a Graphic Designer for our client, one of the most trusted entrepreneurship media brands in the world.

Our client started as a small digital magazine in Australia and grew into a global education and media company for founders. Today, their content reaches over 1M entrepreneurs each month through podcasts, courses, newsletters, events, social media, and their membership platform.

Their podcast has featured some of the biggest names in business, including Mark Cuban, Tim Ferriss, Tony Robbins, Richard Branson, Arianna Huffington, Seth Godin, Barbara Corcoran, Daymond John, Reid Hoffman, Simon Sinek, Alex Hormozi, Emma Grede, Neil Patel, Gary Vaynerchuk, and many more.

Now they need a talented Graphic Designer who can turn ideas, stories, and business insights into compelling visual content that stands out across digital platforms.

A Day in This Role

You start the day with a new batch of content from Foundr's podcast, social media, or upcoming campaigns.

There are ideas to communicate, stories to tell, and an audience of entrepreneurs to capture.

Your job is to bring those ideas to life visually.

You design scroll-stopping social media graphics, create polished promotional assets, develop campaign visuals, and turn complex ideas into clear, engaging designs that feel unmistakably on-brand.

You might be creating Instagram carousels, podcast promotional graphics, YouTube thumbnails, email banners, or landing page visuals. Each design has a purpose: capture attention, communicate a message, and strengthen the brand.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the content and marketing teams, take creative direction, explore new visual approaches, and refine your work based on feedback and performance.

You end the day knowing your designs helped one of the world's leading entrepreneurship media brands connect with millions of founders.

  • Design engaging social media graphics, carousels, and promotional creatives

  • Create compelling visuals for podcasts, interviews, campaigns, and digital content

  • Design YouTube thumbnails, email graphics, banners, and other marketing assets

  • Maintain visual consistency across different platforms and content formats

  • Translate creative briefs and marketing concepts into effective visual designs

  • Develop layouts, typography, color combinations, and visual compositions that capture attention

  • Adapt designs for different platforms, audiences, and campaign requirements

  • Work with brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas to the table

  • Collaborate with content and marketing teams to bring campaigns and ideas to life

  • Incorporate feedback quickly and continuously improve the quality of your work

  • Keep up with emerging design trends, creative formats, and visual styles

  • You have an excellent eye for typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy

Why This Role Is Exciting

  • You will work with content featuring some of the biggest names in business

  • You will help shape the visual identity of established shows, campaigns, and new content launches

  • You will work with a media brand that has been building for over a decade

  • You will have creative room to experiment, develop new ideas, and elevate the brand's visual presence

Competitive pay based on your region, tool subscription reimbursements, fully remote, ongoing training, and more!

Ready to Create Visuals That Inspire Entrepreneurs?

jobs.excerpt: OverviewNakupuna Services is seeking to hire a DMLSS Multi-Site Support Senior Specialists to support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Defense Medical Logistics Standard Support (DMLSS) Database Sustainment Specialist (DSS) Support contract.
jobs.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Services is seeking to hire a DMLSS Multi-Site Support Senior Specialists to support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Defense Medical Logistics Standard Support (DMLSS) Database Sustainment Specialist (DSS) Support contract. This remote position requires travel to Medical Treatment Facilities (MTFs) as operationally needed and approved by Area of Responsibility Managers (AORMs) and Nakupuna leadership.

Each DMLSS Multi-Site Support Senior Specialist provides strategic, analytical, and quality-assurance support to the broader Multi-Site Support Team. This will also include coordination directly with government representatives, AORMs, MTF personnel, and Operations and Maintenance contractor staff to resolve complex operational concerns and support consistent execution across sites.

While the role may provide direct site support during vacancies or periods of increased need, its primary responsibility is to assess multi-site operations, establish priorities, identify systemic issues, and recommend appropriate courses of action within established contractual and operational parameters. The DMLSS Multi-Site Support Senior Specialist is accountable for maintaining inventory integrity and advancing effective, consistent inventory-management practices across assigned sites and providing recommendations that support sound business and customer-service decisions.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this position but does not restrict tasks that may be assigned.

  • Analyze multi-site inventory data, identify trends and recurring discrepancies, assess operational impacts and risks, and develop recommendations to strengthen inventory controls, accountability, and availability.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in evaluating complex site needs, prioritizing inventory reviews and reconciliations, and recommending appropriate courses of action within established contractual, operational, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate directly with government representatives, AORMs, FOSs, MTF personnel, and operational staff regarding inventory requirements, changing site operations, inventory-control procedures, and logistical needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve multi-site inventory-management processes, recordkeeping practices, quality controls, and customer-support procedures; develop and communicate recommended improvements to leadership and appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide quality-assurance support to Medical Treatment Facilities and Operations and Maintenance contractor staff, as requested by the AOR Manager, to promote consistent inventory-management practices across assigned sites.
  • Independently coordinate inventory-support activities in response to changing government operational requirements, maintaining appropriate communication, accountability, and documentation.
  • Participate in transition calls with AORMs, FOSs, and key site personnel to assess site-specific needs, operational risks, and special circumstances before support is provided..
  • Oversee the DHA Call/Work Management Center customer-support process for assigned MTFs by assessing incoming needs, coordinating appropriate support, identifying recurring issues, and supporting effective customer relationships.
  • Maintain complete records of work performed by date and site and prepare or contribute data and analysis for the consolidated Multi-Site Support Team Monthly Activity Report.
  • Co-lead Training Team initiatives, including taskers and the review of DMLSS-to-LogiCole crosswalk videos, slide decks, and other training tools; provide subject-matter feedback and improvement recommendations.
  • Attend and actively participate in required meetings, training, and program initiatives.

DSS Functions the Multi-Site Support Senior Specialist Must Be Able to Perform:

The Multi-Site Support Senior Specialist must be able to perform the following DSS functions when providing direct site support:

  • Create, maintain, and update DMLSS-FM inventories, includingat sites without Operations and Maintenance support.
  • Maintain the DMLSS-FM Requirements Management Module.
  • Maintain the DMLSS-FM Project Management Module.
  • Support drawing management activities.
  • Support regulatory compliance requirements, including Joint Commission-related activities.
  • Support work requests, preventive-maintenance activities, and real-property installed equipment.
  • Lead or support preventive-maintenance program activities.

Qualifications

Skills/Qualifications: The ideal candidate possesses expertise and experience in project management, especially within infrastructure and environmental services. Key qualifications include:

  • The ideal candidate has substantial DMLSS and multi-site inventory-management experience, strong analytical and decision-making skills, and the ability to work independently in a customer-focused environment.
  • Two to three years of DMLSS experience as a Database Sustainment Specialist (DSS) or other relevant Facilities Management is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze information, interpret results, identify trends or discrepancies, and develop effective solutions.
  • Demonstrated sound judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work confidently and productively in a self-directed environment with limited supervision.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Proficiency in business-intelligence tools and data reporting.
  • At least two years of experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Education:

Minimum Requirement:

  • High school diploma or equivalent and five years of relevant DMLSS, program support, inventory-management, or administrative experience. Relevant experience may be a substitute for formal education.

Preferred: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Information Systems, or related discipline with experience supporting DoD or healthcare programs.

Location: Remote and must be willing to travel up to 30% to sites as needed. Must be willing to work hours that align with typical West Coast hours of 0730 - 1630. Must complete annual medical health screenings required by specific locations.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must be able to pass required background checks and obtain access to military installations.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) (Tier 1) investigation
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC).
  • Must comply with all installation access and security requirements.

Physical Requirements: In addition to the skills and qualifications mentioned above, candidates must, at a minimum, be able to meet the following physical requirements.

  • Sit for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Perform repetitive hand and finger movements.
  • Walk short distances within medical facilities.
  • Occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
  • Maintain focus on detailed data entry and system review tasks.
  • Work in a low-noise office environment within a healthcare facility.

The Nakupuna Companies use a market-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $75,000.00 to $83,000.00 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies total compensation package for employees.

jobs.description:
Description

Orchid Security is the Identity Infrastructure Control Plane - the independent layer that connects what enterprises already own across IAM, PAM, IGA, and SaaS systems. We help security teams see inside applications, govern what actually happens at execution time, and close the gap between identity intent and identity reality.

We’re a 70-person seed-stage company moving fast in a $23B market. Our customers include Fortune 500 banks, global retailers, and complex enterprises where identity security is mission-critical.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Growth Marketing to own and scale the engine that turns market awareness into pipeline. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for a versatile B2B marketer who has built and run demand generation programs end to end, from intent signals to closed pipeline.

You’ll lead our demand generation, growth hacking, inbound marketing, SEO/SEM, social media, and marketing automation functions, building the infrastructure and programs that generate qualified pipeline at scale. This role reports directly to the VP Marketing.

You move fast, make data-driven decisions, and know how to build scalable programs.

In this role, success looks like: pipeline from marketing that is predictable, measurable, and growing quarter over quarter. Every campaign launches with proper tracking and attribution. SEO and inbound channels become compounding sources of qualified demand.

What You’ll Own

  • Own demand generation end to end: strategy, execution, and optimization across inbound and outbound programs that drive measurable pipeline contribution
  • Build and scale growth marketing initiatives: identify and exploit high-leverage channels, test aggressively, and double down on what works
  • Lead SEO and SEM strategy: own organic search performance and paid search programs, from keyword strategy to landing page optimization to ROI reporting
  • Drive inbound marketing: develop content-led demand programs including gated assets, webinars, and nurture sequences that capture and convert buyer intent
  • Own social media and community presence: build Orchid’s organic reach across LinkedIn and relevant security communities, turning followers into engaged prospects
  • Run marketing automation: design, implement, and optimize automated workflows, lead scoring, and nurture programs in HubSpot that accelerate leads through the funnel
  • Collaborate with Marketing Operations on attribution, funnel reporting, and pipeline dashboards so you always know what’s working and why
  • Partner with Product Marketing on campaign messaging and ensure story consistency across every channel and touchpoint

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience with at least 3 to 4 years in demand generation, growth marketing, or a directly comparable role, ideally in cybersecurity, identity, or technical SaaS
  • Proven track record of building scalable demand gen programs that drive measurable pipeline. You can show the numbers
  • Deep hands-on expertise across the growth marketing stack: SEO/SEM, paid social, email nurture, marketing automation, and inbound content programs
  • HubSpot power user: you’ve built complex workflows, lead scoring models, and nurture programs from scratch
  • Strong analytical instincts. You live in dashboards, know your funnel metrics cold, and can quickly diagnose what’s leaking
  • Growth hacker mindset: you run structured experiments, kill what doesn’t work, and scale what does
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs across marketing, sales, and product in a fast-moving startup
  • Comfortable with the enterprise B2B buyer journey. You understand long cycles, multi-stakeholder deals, and how to stay relevant across them

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing identity security, IAM, PAM, IGA, or adjacent enterprise security products
  • Background at an early-stage startup where you built the demand gen function from scratch
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) and intent data tools (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Bombora)
  • Experience hiring and managing a small growth marketing team

Why Orchid

  • Build the growth engine from scratch. This is a rare opportunity to own the demand function at a company with real enterprise traction
  • Your work directly impacts pipeline and revenue in a lean team where everyone’s contribution is visible
  • Early stage with enterprise proof: customers like Costco, Fortune 50 banks, and global insurance firms
  • A differentiated technical story worth telling, not another recycled cybersecurity positioning exercise
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a team that takes great work seriously

About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

jobs.excerpt: Über Lingoda Vor 12 Jahren gegründet, stellt sich Lingoda einer der drängendsten globalen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit: dem Bedarf wachsender Wirtschaften und alternder Bevölkerungen mit der Mobilität globaler Talente zu begegnen.
jobs.description:
Über Lingoda
Vor 12 Jahren gegründet, stellt sich Lingoda einer der drängendsten globalen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit: dem Bedarf wachsender Wirtschaften und alternder Bevölkerungen mit der Mobilität globaler Talente zu begegnen. Angetrieben von unserer Mission – „Menschen weltweit mit Sprachkenntnissen, kulturellem Verständnis und technischem Know-how auszustatten, damit Integration und Erfolg möglich werden“ – hat sich Lingoda als Vorreiter im Bildungsbereich etabliert.
Was wir tun
Lingodas effektives Lernmodell basiert auf Kleingruppenunterricht – mit über 800.000 Kursen pro Jahr, geleitet von 2.400 qualifizierten Lehrkräften. Unsere eigens entwickelte Curriculum-Plattform hilft Lernenden dabei, ihre Ziele zu erreichen – sei es für den beruflichen Aufstieg oder die erfolgreiche Integration in einem neuen Land.
Wen wir unterstützen
Lingoda ist ein schnell wachsendes und ambitioniertes Unternehmen, das sowohl im B2B- als auch im B2C-Bereich tätig ist: Während unser B2B-Geschäft in Deutschland besonders auf den Gesundheitssektor fokussiert ist – mit dem klaren Ziel, in weitere Branchen und Länder zu expandieren – erreichen wir im B2C-Bereich Lernende weltweit. Unsere Studierende lernen Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch, Französisch und Italienisch – ganz egal, wo auf der Welt sie sich befinden.
Eine Sprache mit Lingoda zu lernen, ist eine bereichernde Erfahrung – möglich gemacht durch uns Lingodies, die unsere Lernenden auf jedem Schritt ihrer Reise begleiten. Wir leben das Lernen mit ihnen gemeinsam, um eine Welt der Verbindung und Möglichkeiten zu schaffen.
Warum du bei uns einsteigen solltest
Ein Einstieg bei Lingoda bedeutet, Teil eines Teams zu werden, das gemeinsam besser wird. Wir leben eine inklusive Kultur, in der Mut, Neugier und persönliches Wachstum gefördert werden. Erkenntnisse setzen wir in Taten um – und jede*r Einzelne trägt dazu bei, positive Veränderungen zu bewirken.
Werde Teil unserer Mission, Leben durch Bildung zu verändern.
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine*n Dozent*in (alle Geschlechter) im Fachbereich „Qualifizierung internationaler Hebammen“ auf freiberuflicher Basis mit Sitz in Berlin oder im Homeoffice.
Deine Mission bei uns:
Lingoda ist seit vielen Jahren Marktführer und Dreh-und Angelpunkt in der Qualifizierung internationaler Hebammen. Gemeinsam mit vielen weiteren Akteuren, wie Landesbehörden, Hochschulen, dem Simulationszentrum und Akademie für multidisziplinäre Notfalltrainings (SAM gGmbH), den IQ Fachstellen und vielen mehr, ebnen wir den Weg der Berufsanerkennung, immer nah am individuellen Bedarf der Kolleg:innen.
Du unterstützt uns dabei, unser Bildungsangebot für die Qualifizierung von internationalen Hebammen umzusetzen, indem du als E-Learning Dozent*in die Fachkräfte auf die Kenntnisprüfung vorbereitest.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Moderation und Sicherstellung eines Lösungsverständnisses von Fallbesprechungen (POL) innerhalb der Gruppe (max.12 TN), unter Berücksichtigung individueller Voraussetzungen und Bedarfe
  • Du bereitest die Kolleg:innen in der praxisorientierten Woche theoretisch auf den Präsenzeinsatz in der Simulation vor
  • Du führst individuelle Lernentwicklungsgespräche. Gemeinsam mit den internationalen Hebammen evaluierst du ihren bisherigen Lernerfolg und legst Lernschwerpunkte für die weitere Entwicklung fest
  • Du dokumentierst und kommentierst alle erbrachten Lernleistungen und gibst sie an die relevanten Schnittstellen weiter

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abschluss als staatlich examinierte Hebamme oder an einer Hochschule erworbene Primärqualifizierung zur Hebamme (B.Sc.)
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im klinischen oder außerklinischen Bereich, sowie Erfahrung in der theoretischen Lehre (Fachschule/Hochschule) oder in der Praxisanleitung von Hebammenschüler:innen bzw. Studierenden
  • Verfügbarkeit für Abendkurse (18–21 Uhr), damit auch berufstätige Hebammen und Mütter am Kurs teilnehmen können
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) in Wort und Schrift und eine klare, wertschätzende Kommunikation
  • Flexibilität und Sensibilität für verschiedene Kulturen
  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zoom, Google Docs und Office-Programmen sowie eigene technische Ausstattung (Laptop, stabile Internetverbindung, Headset)
Damit bereicherst du unsere Kultur:
  • Gewissenhaftigkeit und eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe
  • Freude daran, Menschen auf ihrem Weg in den Beruf zu begleiten
  • Eine klare, verlässliche Kommunikation mit den Teilnehmenden und mit uns

Das erwartet dich bei Lingoda:

  • Eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du begleitest internationale Hebammen auf ihrem Weg zur Berufsanerkennung in Deutschland
  • Ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten: Du unterrichtest online
  • Ein gut strukturiertes Onboarding, das dich optimal auf deine Kurse vorbereitet
  • Feste Ansprechpartner:innen und transparente Kommunikation
  • Ein integratives, internationales Umfeld mit Leidenschaft für Bildung
Klingt das spannend? Dann sende uns gleich deinen Lebenslauf!
Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

Lingoda fördert Vielfalt und Integration am Arbeitsplatz. Wir streben nach Chancengleichheit und Maßnahmen der Affirmative Action und wir bemühen uns, eine Belegschaft zu schaffen, die die Vielfalt unserer Nutzende widerspiegelt. Unser Engagement stellt sicher, dass jede Bewerbende auf der Grundlage der eigenen Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen beurteilt wird, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion.
Wir bitten dich, dich direkt über den in der Stellenbeschreibung angegebenen Link oder direkt auf unserer Website zu bewerben. Aufgrund der DSGVO-Bestimmungen werden anderweitig eingesandte Bewerbungen nicht berücksichtigt.

jobs.description:
Why SalesApe?

Join SalesApe, one of the fastest-growing AI companies, recognised as a leader in cutting-edge AI technology and backed by over $20 million from top VCs.

We’re at the dawn of a powerful evolution, set to transform society with our tech. Our mission? To tackle inequality by empowering a huge market of non-tech SMBs—93% of all businesses, think construction, automotive, real estate, and more. While the tech industry has compounded its growth with computing power, these businesses have been technically starved.

With AI agents and our natural language interface technology, we’re unlocking huge productivity gains for our clients. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in small businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team. The emotional bond our clients feel toward their agent is undeniable—they often tell us their ‘Ape’ has become part of the family. Our vision is to become the ‘ brain’ of a business spinning out agent worker, freeing up time and simplifying operations, to ensure humans spend more time in real-life interaction.

If you’re ready for intense, high-energy, meaningful work, come make a real impact with us at SalesApe


Our Vision, Mission and Purpose:

As we started building with large language models and AI-powered natural language interfaces, I had an aha moment. It hit me just how significant this inflection point is: compute—the raw power of computers—is now accessible to people who don’t use computers."

"And when I thought about that, I realized the closest invention humanity has seen to this shift was electricity. When electricity arrived, it didn’t just light up homes—it transformed industries, democratized wealth, and empowered everyone, from factory owners to farmers, to grow and thrive. Today, with AI, we have the opportunity to do the same for the real economy."

"For the last two decades, the tech industry has had an incredible advantage. Computers have been like co-pilots for us, quietly amplifying our productivity and enabling us to grow faster than ever before. But 95% of businesses—builders, plumbers, and real estate agents—have been technically starved. These businesses make up 50% of GDP, five times larger than the entire tech industry, but they’ve never had access to the tools they need to compete."

"This is the inequality we’re solving. APE AI is democratizing technology, bringing the power of compute to businesses that have been left behind. And what’s so rewarding is that we’re not just helping faceless corporations—we’re empowering real people. Small business owners who pour their hearts into their work. People whose success directly impacts their families, their communities, and society at large. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in small businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team."

"For me, this mission is personal. I’ve spent my career building companies that encourage people to connect in real life, to be physically active, and to engage with their communities. This isn’t just about productivity—it’s about health, happiness, and thriving societies. Humans weren’t built to spend their lives staring at screens. We’re wired to interact, to move, to be part of the real world. And what excites me is that Ape AI is helping to make this possible—empowering businesses that create real-world value to thrive at the same pace as the tech giants."

"This isn’t just about technology. It’s about fairness. It’s about giving the power of compute to the people who need it most, so they can grow, thrive, and make a difference. That’s our mission, and it’s something we can all be proud of.


Role Overview

SalesAPE.ai is looking for a commercially sharp Customer Success Manager to own long-term relationships with our growing portfolio of SMB clients. Post-onboarding, you'll be the person clients call, trust, and grow with. You'll understand their business goals, monitor how their AI agents are performing, and take ownership of driving outcomes that keep them renewing and expanding.

This role sits within the Professional Services & Customer Success function. You're not just managing accounts; you're protecting and growing revenue, and you'll be expected to approach it that way.

Key Responsibilities & Scope

  • Own a portfolio of accounts post-onboarding, acting as the primary point of contact through renewal and beyond

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, understanding their goals and driving outcomes from their AI agents

  • Proactively manage renewals and spot expansion opportunities, owning commercial conversations with confidence

  • Monitor account health continuously, identifying risks early and acting before they escalate

  • Run regular performance review calls, using data to demonstrate ROI and guide client decisions

  • Work closely with the onboarding team to ensure smooth handoffs

  • Feed structured client insights back to product and GTM teams

What We're Looking For

We want someone who thinks commercially, acts proactively, and builds client relationships where churn simply isn't on the table.

Essential:

  • Proven B2B SaaS Customer Success or Account Management experience, ideally with SME clients

  • A genuine sales instinct with a track record of driving retention and growth

  • Strong relationship builder who clients want to call

  • Data driven and able to demonstrate ROI clearly

  • Highly self-managing with a bias for action

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in AI, sales technology, or a fast-growing startup

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales workflows

What We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in a fast-growing AI startup with a unique product offering

  • Competitive compensation including base and commission

  • A chance to grow to lead a team in a high-growth market

  • A collaborative, innovative, and supportive work culture

  • Opportunities for professional growth in the emerging field of AI solutions

  • Freedom and autonomy are our principal values

Description

Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker

We’re looking for a Customer Support Representative to help our B2B clients get the most out of Chargeflow through clear communication, practical guidance, and reliable problem-solving.

This role combines live customer support with investigation and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll handle inquiries across billing, technical, administrative, and chargeback-related topics, guiding customers through challenges and taking ownership of their resolution.

You’ll be a trusted point of contact for businesses using Chargeflow to manage disputes and protect their revenue. This is a role for someone who can turn complex questions into clear next steps, manage competing priorities, and make every interaction helpful and reassuring.

About Chargeflow

Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.

Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.

The impact you’ll have

  • Help customers use Chargeflow confidently to manage chargebacks and protect their revenue.
  • Build trust and customer loyalty through timely, accurate, and thoughtful support.
  • Bring customer concerns and feedback to internal teams to help improve the customer experience.

What you’ll own (Your arena)

Live Customer Support

  • Provide exceptional support to our B2B clients through live chat and email.
  • Handle billing, technical, administrative, and domain-related inquiries about chargebacks and fraud prevention.

Investigation & Resolution

  • Investigate customer concerns, identify the right next steps, and work toward prompt, accurate resolutions.
  • Provide step-by-step guidance on product usage, features, and troubleshooting.

Collaboration & Escalations

  • Collaborate with internal teams, manage escalations, and prioritize customer issues to keep resolutions moving.
  • Keep customers informed throughout the process and collect feedback on their experience.

Documentation & Product Knowledge

  • Document and track customer interactions accurately across our communication, CRM, and ticketing systems.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Chargeflow’s products, features, and updates to provide relevant and reliable support.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years in customer support roles.
  • English communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to customers.
  • Problem-solving: Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a practical approach to investigating and resolving issues.
  • Organization & ownership: The ability to manage multiple systems, stakeholders, and customer inquiries while delivering clear, timely resolutions.
  • Support tools: Practical experience with CRM and ticketing systems.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech & SaaS: Experience providing live customer support in fintech and for SaaS products.
  • Domain knowledge: In-depth understanding of chargebacks and fraud prevention strategies.
  • Tools: Hands-on experience with Intercom or Zendesk.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with relevant regulations and compliance standards in the fintech sector.

Salary: 650$ non negotiable

How We Work

We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of the customer experience. Our support team combines product knowledge with thoughtful communication, keeping customers informed and working closely with internal teams to resolve issues.

We care about fast responses, accurate answers, and helping customers move forward with confidence.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the Philippines.

If you’re looking for a role where you can solve problems, build customer trust, and help businesses protect their revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

Our AI-native platform helps more people get to “yes” at the moments that matter with personalized offers, transparent terms, and no added consumer fees. We are guided by people-centered values: Serve Others Before Self, Include Always, Connect Genuinely, Innovate for Good. These values shape how we build, how we support customers and merchants, and how we work with each other.

What makes Sunbit different is an AI-native infrastructure that runs through the full customer and merchant journey. Our interconnected AI systems power instant decisioning, streamline fraud checks with human-in-the-loop safeguards, and enable highly personalized offers at scale. The result is a quick, fair, and simple experience for consumers and merchants.

We pair this technology with inclusion and transparency. Sunbit delivers industry-leading approval rates — 90%+ in auto service and 85%+ in dental — while maintaining zero consumer fee-based revenue. It is a better way to serve people and merchants, proven at scale.

Today, Sunbit is available across a nationwide, in-person merchant network of 30,000+ locations spanning auto service centers, dental and optical practices, veterinary clinics, and other specialty services. We help teams say “yes” more often and help customers move forward with confidence.

﻿The Role:

Sunbit is seeking a highly experienced Director of Card Operations to lead and scale the operational infrastructure supporting our growing card business. This leader will serve as the company's subject matter expert on card processing, issuer operations, and Fiserv capabilities, while driving operational excellence across the cardholder lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines deep card operations expertise with strong program management and leadership skills. They have extensive experience working with card processors—particularly Fiserv/First Data—and understand how to translate business objectives into scalable operational solutions. This individual will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Fraud, Compliance, Finance, Customer Experience, and external partners to optimize performance, reduce operational friction, and accelerate execution across the card organization.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for improving operational efficiency, managing key vendor relationships, and ensuring the card platform is positioned to support Sunbit's continued growth.

Requirements

What you'll own:

Card Operations Strategy & Execution

  • Serve as the operational leader for Sunbit's card platform, driving performance, scalability, and continuous improvement across card operations.
  • Own the implementation, optimization, and governance of core card processing functionality, ensuring operational processes align with business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the card ecosystem by optimizing processes, automating workflows, reducing costs, and establishing scalable operational controls and performance standards.

Fiserv & Processor Leadership

  • Act as Sunbit's primary expert and executive point of contact for Fiserv and related card processing partners.
  • Lead the evaluation, design, implementation, and optimization of capabilities across the Fiserv ecosystem, ensuring platform enhancements align with business objectives and operational needs.
  • Influence and navigate Fiserv's organization to accelerate project delivery, resolve operational challenges, and maximize the value of existing platform capabilities.

Strategic Programs & Product Enablement

Lead operational workstreams for major card initiatives including:

  • New product launches
  • Co-brand and partner card programs
  • Portfolio conversions and migrations
  • Fraud and risk initiatives
  • Collections enhancements
  • Digital servicing capabilities
  • Data and reporting initiatives
  • Debit card and network expansion opportunities

Vendor & Network Management

  • Own strategic relationships with card processors, networks, fulfillment providers, and other operational partners, driving performance, accountability, escalation management, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and monitor vendor performance metrics, service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational KPIs.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, and other network stakeholders on operational initiatives, compliance requirements, and program enhancements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Card Operations team responsible for day-to-day card servicing and operational support.

Financial & Operational Management

  • Own the Card Operations budget and P&L, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining strong service levels.
  • Develop business cases for operational investments and strategic initiatives.
  • Track, analyze, and report on operational performance metrics, costs, and vendor spend.

Risk, Compliance & Controls

  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams to ensure operational processes meet regulatory, network, and internal control requirements.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of consumer lending, card servicing, dispute management, fraud operations, and card network regulations.
  • Ensure operational readiness for audits, examinations, and regulatory reviews.

﻿What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in card operations, card processing, payments, fintech, banking, or consumer lending environments.
  • Deep expertise working with Fiserv/First Data card processing platforms, particularly Optis and related operational systems.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale card operations organizations, driving complex operational initiatives, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and driving performance across large external partners.
  • Strong understanding of card issuing operations, transaction processing, disputes, fraud operations, servicing, collections, and card lifecycle management.
  • Experience partnering effectively across Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Experience teams.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizations, influence stakeholders, and drive execution across internal teams and external partners.
  • Experience with key card processing systems, including but not limited to: Optis core (PCF, etc.), card issuance / fulfillment, APIs and data transmission, DecisionQuest, DMM, Fiserv fraud mitigation tools (ex. Defense Edge / Advance Defense), and general Fiserv User guides and operations documentation
  • Strong communicator and business partner, thinking strategically about how to enable others to be a better partner directly with Fiserv in their respective spaces (ex. Data, fraud, card ops, Card digital experience)
  • Experienced manager of a multi-faceted team
  • Strong regulatory fluency and understanding of the compliance requirements in the space

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working both on the issuer side and within Fiserv or another major processor organization.
  • Prior experience as a Client Service Advisor (CSA), implementation leader, consultant, or operations leader supporting issuer clients.
  • Experience supporting credit cards, debit cards, or co-brand card programs.
  • Direct experience working with Visa and Mastercard operational, compliance, and network management functions.
  • Fintech experience within a high-growth, consumer-focused environment.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

﻿Why Choose Sunbit?

Sunbit is recognized as one of the fastest-growing and most admired fintech companies, earning honors from Inc. 5000 (four consecutive years), Forbes Fintech 50, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Financial Times, and FinTech Breakthrough for its innovation and impact. The company has also been featured among Newsweek’s Most Loved Workplaces and CB Insights’ Unicorn Companies, reflecting a valuation of $1.1B.

People choose Sunbit for its people-first culture rooted in service, inclusion, and real-world impact. Powered by AI that helps people in life’s critical moments—offering high approvals, speed, and zero fees—Sunbit has achieved proven scale across tens of thousands of merchants and millions of transactions. Its fast, fair, and simple financial products empower consumers and partners alike through clarity and trust.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAbout Quicklizard Quicklizard is a pricing intelligence and optimization platform for retailers and brands.
jobs.description:
Description

About Quicklizard

Quicklizard is a pricing intelligence and optimization platform for retailers and brands. Our SaaS helps pricing, category and e-commerce teams set the right price across products, channels and markets, using competitive data, business rules and AI-driven recommendations to grow revenue and protect margin.

We are growing our customer base across the US and Latin America and are building a local team to serve and win customers in the region.

The role

We are hiring a hybrid pre-sales engineer and customer success manager to cover the Americas. The split is roughly 50/50: half your time managing and growing our US and Latin America customers, half supporting the sales team on new opportunities across the region.

This is a remote role, based in Mexico or the US, reporting to the Director of Sales. You will work closely with Account Executives, our implementation and R&D teams, and product. Because you will sell and serve the same region, you own the full customer journey: from first demo to go-live, adoption and renewal.

What you'll do

Customer success (about 50%)

  • Own a portfolio of US and Latin America customers as their main day-to-day contact, from onboarding through renewal.
  • Lead onboarding and go-live: gather requirements, translate the customer's pricing logic into strategies and business rules, and coordinate data integration with our implementation and R&D teams.
  • Drive adoption: train users, spot underused capabilities, and recommend improvements to pricing strategies.
  • Run regular business reviews that tie Quicklizard's results to customer KPIs such as margin, revenue and price competitiveness.
  • Protect renewals by flagging risk early, and identify expansion opportunities (new categories, channels, countries or modules) together with the Account Executives.
  • Be the customer's voice internally, feeding requests and feedback to product.

Pre-sales (about 50%)

  • Partner with Account Executives on Americas opportunities, from discovery to signature.
  • Lead business and technical discovery: the prospect's pricing process, data sources, systems (ERP, e-commerce, POS) and competitive data needs.
  • Build and deliver tailored demos, workshops and proof-of-value environments, in English and Spanish.
  • Map prospect use cases to Quicklizard's pricing strategies, rules and integrations, and scope the implementation.
  • Own the technical and functional sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires.
  • Ensure a clean handover from sale to onboarding, so what we promise is what we deliver.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience across pre-sales or solutions engineering, customer success and account management, in B2B SaaS or retail technology.
  • A background in retail: you understand how retailers and brands manage categories, promotions, pricing and assortment.
  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data, data feeds, APIs and system integrations, and able to speak with both IT and business stakeholders.
  • Strong demo and presentation skills, with confidence in front of pricing managers, category managers and C-level executives.
  • Fluent professional English and Spanish, written and spoken.
  • Based in Mexico or the US, with the right to work there, and available for regular travel to customers and prospects in the region.
  • A self-starter who works well remotely, across time zones, and is comfortable building processes in a region we are still growing.

Nice to have

  • Pricing experience: as a pricing analyst or manager at a retailer, or with price optimization, revenue management or competitive price monitoring software.
  • Familiarity with retail systems common in the region, such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify or VTEX.
  • Hands-on data skills (advanced Excel, SQL or Python) to build demo data and analyze customer results.
  • Experience with AI or machine-learning based products.
  • Portuguese, for customers and prospects in Brazil.
  • Experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot.

Why join us

  • Shape how Quicklizard sells to and serves customers across the Americas, at an early stage of our growth in the region.
  • A role that combines commercial and technical work, with direct impact on both new revenue and customer retention.
  • Work with a global, experienced team in retail pricing.
  • Fully remote from Mexico or the US, with a competitive compensation package.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Sandoz is going through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. By creating a new and ambitious path, it will provide a unique opportunity for us all, both professionally and personally.

As the Global Marketing Automation Manager at Sandoz, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of marketing automation strategies and systems to enhance our digital marketing campaigns. You will be responsible for orchestrating personalized and data-driven marketing efforts to engage healthcare professionals, patients, and stakeholders on a global scale.

Job Description

Key responsibilities:

  • Marketing Automation Strategy:
    • Develop and execute a global marketing automation strategy aligned with the company's marketing objectives, ensuring efficient lead generation, nurturing, and conversion processes
  • Campaign Development and deployment
    • Collaborate with a Team of Global Digital Marketing Managers to design and execute automated customer journeys, ensuring relevance and effectiveness
    • Identify all touchpoints on identification and implementation new customer journey and provide clear interaction plans for multiple markets
  • Automation Platform Management
    • Oversee the implementation, and management of marketing automation platforms such as Scout (SFDC) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
    • Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) is required, including Journey Builder, Audience Builder and Email Studio.
    • Work with MCM channel operations team to ensure effective and efficient use of global digital platforms including latest best practices, updates or releases including new functionalities and channels
  • Performance Analytics
    • Monitor and analyze marketing automation performance, providing insights and recommendations for optimization to enhance campaign effectiveness
  • Compliance and Data Privacy:
    • Ensure marketing automation activities adhere to pharmaceutical industry regulations, including data privacy (e.g., GDPR), and work closely with legal and regulatory teams.
  • Training and Support:
    • Provide training and support to marketing teams and stakeholders in using marketing automation tools effectively.

Our requirements:

  • Proven 3-5 years of experience in Marketing Automation area, (nice to have would be to have an experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry)
  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) is required; experience with Salesforce/CRM and other marketing automation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong digital background and successful track of digital initiatives with demonstrated business impact measured by organizational metrics.
  • Strong data analytics and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering personalized and data-driven marketing experiences.
  • Fluent English.
  • University degree (preferably in Marketing/Business/Economics or related).

Compensation Structure & Criteria:

Sandoz compensation is determined by job level, qualifications, niche skills, experience, and location within company salary ranges. Fully proficient and highly effective employees can expect a starting salary around market median, with those new to the level or with less functional depth at the lower end of the range and those with sustained superior or niche skills towards the higher end of the range. Internal equity and external market data inform our range placement. Annual salary reviews consider performance outcomes, market alignment, and business needs.


Job location: Warsaw, Poland (office)

Work mode: remote

Pay range (monthly salary): gross/zł 15 225- 28 275

Variable compensation:

-annual performance-based bonus: 15%

-employee share program;


Additional benefits include:

• Lunch card worth 450 zł per month

• Laptop,

• Medical care

• Life Insurance

• Retirement plan

• Multisport or Kultura + card (co-financed by the employee)

• Additional 2 days off

• Language learning platform

Pay frequency: monthly

Expected weekly working hours: 40h

Contract type: Replacement employment contract


Why Sandoz?

Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us!

Join our Sandoz Network: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to hear more about Sandoz and our career opportunities, join the Network here:

jobs.title: Credit Data Assurance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Overview This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.
jobs.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.

This position serves as a strategic partner across Credit, Reporting, Data, Product, and Technology organizations, ensuring business, data, process, and system changes are effectively assessed for impacts to Credit Reporting and downstream reporting deliverables.

This role is responsible for performing complex business and data impact assessments, translating business requirements into actionable data use cases, leading data triage, and root cause analysis efforts, and driving improvements in data quality, data lineage transparency, and reporting readiness. The analyst will play a critical role in proactively identifying and mitigating reporting and data risks.

The successful candidate will possess strong credit domain expertise, advanced analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across multiple organizations while independently leading strategic initiatives.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

Credit Reporting Impact Assessment

  • Perform portfolio-level impact assessments to identify reporting, data, and operational risks before implementation.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure reporting requirements are understood and incorporated into change initiatives.

Business & Data Requirements Management

  • Translate business requirements into credit data use cases and actionable requirements for Product, Technology, and Data teams.
  • Develop business process maps, data flow documentation, and reporting requirements to support strategic initiatives.
  • Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.

Data Analysis & Data Assurance

  • Perform advanced analysis of credit and reporting data to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve transparency into data quality, data lineage, controls, and reporting readiness across the Credit Reporting ecosystem.
  • Support the design and implementation of processes that enhance data reliability and consumption confidence.

Data Triage & Issue Management

  • Lead data triage activities, root cause analysis, and issue prioritization across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Coordinate the resolution of data quality, reporting, and operational issues by partnering with business, technology, and data teams.
  • Escalate and communicate material risks and issues to senior stakeholders as appropriate.

Reporting Risk Management

  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate reporting and data risks before they impact downstream consumers or regulatory deliverables.
  • Evaluate control effectiveness and recommend enhancements that strengthen reporting accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Support governance and risk management activities related to Credit Reporting and data management.

Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Independently lead cross-functional initiatives involving Credit, Reporting, Technology, Product, and Data organizations.
  • Influence decision-making by translating complex credit concepts into measurable business and data impacts.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on Credit Reporting, data risk, and reporting readiness matters.

Position Specific Skills:

  • Commercial Banking or Lending Operations Experience
  • Data Quality Management & Data Lineage
  • Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration
  • Data Analysis
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Risk Identification & Mitigation

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 4 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 8 years' experience in Analytics, or Modeling, or Reporting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience assessing the impact of data, process, system, or business changes on reporting and regulatory deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of commercial lending, credit products, and the end-to-end credit lifecycle.
  • Experience with data lineage, data governance, data quality, and controls frameworks.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analyzing large, complex datasets.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and leading issue remediation efforts.
  • Knowledge of regulatory reporting, reporting controls, or enterprise risk management practices.
  • Experience working across Credit, Technology, Data, and Reporting organizations.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data transformation, modernization, or credit data initiatives.

Additional Information

This job posting is expected to remain active for 5 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants.

The base pay for this position is generally between $95,000 and $115,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at .

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

This job requires a U.S. Person. A U.S. Person is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals granted refugee or asylee status in the U.S. are considered U.S. persons. For a complete definition of “U.S. Person” go here.

Security Clearance Type:

Required

Security Clearance Status:

Not Required

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

As an Account Specialist supporting the MESPC value stream, you will play a critical role in managing supplier relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products. You will lead cross-functional teams, manage supplier performance, and oversee the qualification and delivery of parts. Key responsibilities include:

  • Manage complex cold start product procurement and supplier relationships.
  • Oversee supplier monthly spares output to ensure timely and quality delivery.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to qualify parts and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to address and resolve quality or delivery issues.
  • Monitor and manage supplier performance metrics, including cost, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.
  • Support strategic sourcing initiatives in alignment with long-term business objectives.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to supplier performance and delivery schedules.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience
  • U.S. Person - Job requires access to ITAR or 600/500-series EAR information or hardware (directly or indirectly) and the company will not seek an export authorization for this role.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience in supply chain management, including procurement and supplier management.
  • Experience with project management processes and tools.
  • Experience managing supplier performance, including quality and delivery metrics.
  • 3 years of experience in procurement.

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:


Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 86,800 USD - 165,200 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Work as a Technical Architect on Salesforce Marketing Cloud projects, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet client requirements.
Lead discovery sessions and design workshops to capture client needs and translate them into technical designs.
Implement solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio, Marketing CLoud Advanced, Marketing Cloud Personalization/Salesforce Personalization, Data Cloud and Intelligence
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with external systems and platforms using APIs, custom scripts (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS), and tools like MuleSoft or custom ETL solutions.

Strong knowledge of Marketing Cloud tools such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Cloud and/or Personalization
Experience with scripting languages (AMPscript, SSJS) and integrating Marketing Cloud with other systems via APIs.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Security Administrator with a primary focus on security administration, audit support, policy management, and third-party risk oversight to maintain a continuous compliance posture against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA, and related frameworks.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong project management skills, audit experience, and the ability to manage multiple security and compliance workstreams while supporting security leadership, privacy stakeholders, vendors, on-site security engineering teams, and independent assessment organizations.

This selected individual will support our SafeGuard Services (SGS) team, a subsidiary of Peraton, which performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review, to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare/Medicaid healthcare programs.

What you'll do:

The Security Administrator will be responsible for the following but not limited to::

Security Compliance & Policy Management

  • Author, maintain, and update security policies, procedures, standards, plans, and control documentation for the SGS Contracts environment.
  • Perform control testing and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA/HITECH and the CMS ARS and PIM.
  • Document deficiencies and manage the Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) lifecycle from identification through verified closure
  • Respond to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), CCIC bulletins, and compliance data calls

Audit & Assessment Support

  • Support maintenance of the control evidence library and GRC platform records, control mappings, and compliance reporting using CFACTs.
  • Serve as the operational-side evidence provider for annual independent assessments and CMS reviews.
  • Support Security Assessment preparation and security assessment report development
  • Ensure audit-readiness on any given day rather than reconstructed compliance

Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management

  • Conduct vendor security due diligence and assessments.
  • Perform contract and control reviews, continuous monitoring, and risk reporting
  • Manage vendor security questionnaires and ongoing compliance verification

Security Management & Monitoring (SMM) Administration

  • Administer SMM platform documentation, audit activities, and training programs
  • Serve as application owner liaison or support PMO coordination for SMM-related activities
  • Support application ID administration and controls

Physical Security & Access Control

  • Generate and audit Lenel access control reports on a weekly and monthly basis
  • Conduct group audits and access reviews.
  • Support training and onboarding activities

Program & Administrative Support

  • Leverage SharePoint and PowerApps knowledge to streamline workflows and reporting
  • Participate and support change control boards; evaluate applications; participate in technical solutioning and evaluation
  • Support program operations which may include and is not limited to; leading small projects and initiatives, supporting business capture and growth, and providing cross functional support

jobs.excerpt: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, IcelandContract: Duration being confirmed.
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.
