jobs.title: Paid Media Strategist
jobs.excerpt: QRY 101Hey there!  We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands.
jobs.description:
QRY 101

Hey there! We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands. We connect brand awareness and performance media to unlock growth, use sophisticated data analytics, and employ a full-funnel marketing strategy to help brands reach their most valuable consumers. We’re a high‑performance, high‑ownership team that values candor, curiosity, and results. We love what we do and the people we do it with.

We’re hiring a Paid Media Strategist to own channel performance across a portfolio of clients. You’ll plan, launch, and optimize social campaigns, keep budgets and pacing tight, and translate data into crisp decisions. You love the details, move with urgency, and can explain complex ideas simply, internally and with clients.

Your day-to-day

This role involves successfully managing client campaigns in the digital advertising space across 4 main sectors:

  • Media Strategy:
    • You plan, book, and optimize paid media campaigns (i.e. Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit) for 6-8 clients, utilizing available media planning tools to develop media plans.
    • You strategize and implement A/B experiments to test audiences, creative, landing pages, offers, etc.
    • You facilitate campaign implementation, including asset collecting and trafficking.
    • With support from Associate Directors, you’ll manage the channel's monthly reporting and strategy sessions with the client, owning overall communication for all channel initiatives.
  • Performance:
    • You scope, develop, and manage channel initiatives to consistently hit the goals for channels across all clients.
    • You act as a strategic advisor and recommend strategic pivots to increase the channel's performance.
  • Reporting + Forecasting:
    • You enthusiastically present reports to clients, highlighting the performance of your channels, how it assisted other channels in the funnel, how it affects the client's business, and recommended next steps.
    • You complete a monthly forecast for respective channels based on budget and/or revenue goals.
  • Cross Channel Strategy + Collaboration:
    • You collaborate with the other media and creative agency team members to ensure the creative specifications of negotiated plans are met.
    • You consistently identify cross-channel strategies / collaborations with clients to improve performance.
    • You effectively communicate with clients on teams' capabilities and opportunities, and proactively offer solutions for ad hoc issues.

How you win

  • Channel performance: You hit agreed KPI targets for your channels (e.g., MER/ROAS, CAC/LTV, revenue, efficiency) within budget and platform guardrails.
  • Learning velocity: You run a disciplined test program with documented hypotheses, win rate, rollout decisions, and measurable lift.
  • Forecast accuracy: You run accurate forecasts on a monthly basis and tie expectations to realistic assumptions.
  • Execution: You deliver decks, reports, and campaign launches with low error rates related to QA or data and you ensure QRY quality is represented in every outcome.

What’s it like here

We’re a high‑performance culture with high support. We’re serious about setting clear goals, providing direct feedback, documenting our progress, and celebrating our wins. You’ll get real ownership, supportive teammates, and the tools to do excellent work.

  • Your first month: You’ll build trust with client and internal partners, learn each brand’s goals and constraints, and align on how success will be measured. You’ll review current channel setups and performance at a high level and agree on priorities and near‑term wins. By the end of the month, you’ll have a good understanding of our clients, their channel set ups, and how our pods work.
  • After month one: You’ll own steady, predictable performance against plans and keep budgets and timelines on track. You’ll communicate often, surface risks early with options, and highlight opportunities for smart growth. The result is consistent delivery, fewer surprises, and clear momentum.

Requirements

✍️​ Experience: You have 2-5 years of successful hands-on paid media management experience in an agency environment. You know the ins and outs of making things run smoothly and have applied successful tactics in a previous role. You have experience leading and managing large media budgets for retail and e-commerce brands, with hands-on experience across paid media platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit. Ideally, you also have experience with programmatic display advertising.

📚 Education: Ideally, you have a bachelor's degree in marketing, science, or a related field.

🔢 Analytical Mindset: You're an analytical thinker. You have experience turning complex data into digestible reports, seeing the big picture, and breaking it down into an actionable plan that gets results. You also have experience with platform-native reporting, GA4, and Looker Studio.

💬​ Communication: Your communication skills are top-notch and you can communicate with senior stakeholders effectively and efficiently.

🧪 Experimentation: You have hands-on experimentation experience, including running A/B tests on audiences, creative, landing pages, or offers and turning results into rollout decisions.

🖥️​ Remote Work Environment: You understand the importance of a clean and quiet work environment suitable for video conferencing. You respect digital etiquette and ensure smooth virtual collaboration.

Benefits

🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 USD/year, based on experience.

💰 Quarterly bonuses. Enjoy quarterly bonuses tied to company revenue.

🏠 USA remote flexibility. Choose your ideal workspace, whether it’s your home office or a coffee shop.

🌴 Time off made easy. Take advantage of our unlimited PTO policy.

🏥 Comprehensive healthcare. We offer exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance, fully covered for employees by QRY. We also offer a $100 monthly budget for your wellbeing, i.e. gym memberships, coworking day pass, etc.

📈 Secure your future. Participate in our 401k program with a company match.

🌱 Growth and development. Nurture your learning and development with our investment to L&D, growth opportunities, and tools such as our Learning & Development Philosophy + Policy, role matrices, and skill assessments.

💻 Latest tech. Team members are provided with the latest Macbook Pro and a one-time $500 stipend to set up their at-home workspace.

🥳 Celebrate and connect. Join us for annual team retreats (we’ve been to Austin, Tennessee, and Utah to name a few), weekly Coffee Chats, and monthly Happy Hours to foster our vibrant culture.

jobs.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The DSP Designer plays a key role in developing and delivering complex signal processing algorithms for Fidus clients, from concept through simulation, fixed-point implementation, and hardware bring-up. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus FPGA/hardware teams to design algorithms, perform quantization and bit-width analysis, and translate DSP concepts into feasible hardware architectures.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving between application domains (communications, radar/sensing, industrial, medical), is comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, and takes pride in producing well-documented, bit-true designs.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and simulate DSP algorithms (equalization, filtering, estimation, detection) in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python, from concept through fixed-point validation
  • Perform quantization/bit-width analysis and produce bit-true fixed-point models suitable for HDL implementation
  • Collaborate with FPGA/HDL and hardware teams to translate algorithms into feasible hardware architectures (pipelining, MAC/resource budgeting, timing closure)
  • Support HDL verification through golden-model test vectors and co-simulation
  • Support lab bring-up, characterization, and tuning of DSP-based hardware against real-world channel/sensor behavior
  • Adapt existing DSP toolkits to new client domains and standards across multiple engagements (e.g., communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor)
  • Document algorithm design decisions, trade-offs, and validation results for client and internal reference

Who You are:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field
  • Strong foundation in signals and systems: Fourier/Z-transform, digital filter design (FIR/IIR), sampling theory
  • Practical experience with estimation/detection theory (e.g., matched filtering, MMSE, Kalman filtering) or adaptive filtering (LMS/RLS)
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for algorithm design and simulation
  • Experience with fixed-point conversion and quantization trade-off analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary (collaborating directly with HDL/FPGA teams)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - ability to explain algorithm trade-offs to non-DSP stakeholders
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in one or more of: optical/wireless communications, radar/sensing, motor control, biomedical signal processing, semiconductor test
  • Experience with high-speed SerDes and PAM4 signaling (e.g., PCIe Gen6, 400G/800G Ethernet electrical) - equalization (FFE/CTLE/DFE), link training, and FEC awareness
  • Familiarity with AMD's Adaptive Computing portfolio (Versal, Alveo) or embedded x86 product lines
  • Familiarity with HDL Coder, HLS, or Simulink-to-HDL co-simulation workflows
  • Hands-on lab experience (scope, VNA, BERT, or domain-equivalent test equipment)
  • Exposure to safety-critical or regulated development processes (DO-178C/DO-254, ISO 26262, IEC 62304/60601) - valued for A&D, automotive, and medtech engagements specifically
  • Experience adapting quickly across multiple industries or client domains (consulting/services background a plus)
  • Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to signal processing on FPGAs, GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs
  • Experience with dedicated DSP processors (e.g., Analog Devices, Texas Instruments)
  • Experience with RF front-end systems and data converter interfaces (ADC/DAC), including digital up/down-conversion (DUC/DDC)

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can't wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

jobs.excerpt: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, IcelandContract: Duration being confirmed.
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Supporting executive management and project sponsors across a portfolio of ten US projects, this position leads financial management, financial modeling, and strategic transaction execution.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Supporting executive management and project sponsors across a portfolio of ten US projects, this position leads financial management, financial modeling, and strategic transaction execution. The role focuses on developing valuation frameworks, links-based financial models, establishing internal controls, coordinating PCAOB-registered independent audits, and overseeing financial readiness for potential Nasdaq direct listings.

Operating on a flexible, part-time 10-15 hours per week remote basis with working hours aligned with regular United States business hours (5pm - 12pm SAST), you will oversee external service providers across accounting, taxation, and audit disciplines. A primary focus of the role involves executing outreach and negotiating commercial terms with intellectual property owners across universities, research institutions, and enterprises to secure technology licences, assignments, options, and joint ventures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construct valuation and financial models (DCF, comparable transactions, risk-adjusted NPV) incorporating development risks, dilution, and sensitivity scenarios to support licensing and acquisition decisions.

  • Lead outreach and commercial negotiations with universities, research institutions, and corporate IP owners to structure and execute IP licenses, assignments, acquisitions, options, and joint ventures.

  • Build linked financial forecasts (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) incorporating R&D, clinical, and engineering milestones, while maintaining 13-week cash flow tracking.

  • Manage entity ledgers, bookkeepers, reconciliations, intercompany balances, payment controls, and US GAAP reporting to achieve a 10-day monthly close target.

  • Appoint and supervise tax preparers to ensure federal, state, franchise, payroll, contractor, and foreign-ownership filings are maintained.

  • Source PCAOB-registered audit firms, maintain auditor independence, prepare audit schedules, and resolve queries relating to IP, R&D, and share-based compensation accounting.

  • Oversee financial preparations for US public listings in partnership with SEC counsel and listing advisers, maintaining cap tables, transaction accounting, and SEC filing calendars.

  • Accept designated appointments as a director, officer, or manager for individual portfolio entities where separately agreed, supporting governance, budgeting, and stakeholder communications.


Requirements

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification (or recognised equivalent) / CA (SA)

  • Proven track record in US GAAP compliance, SEC reporting, and advanced Microsoft Excel financial modeling.

  • Demonstrated experience building valuation and forecasting models, leading financial preparation for completed US public listings/registrations, and managing issuer audits.

  • Strong experience evaluating and negotiating IP licences, acquisitions, or related transactions with universities, research institutions, or commercial enterprises.

  • Capability to manage external professional service providers independently and deliver executive recommendations.

  • Availability to work remotely with schedule alignment to regular United States business hours.

Desirable Requirements

  • Direct experience with US public direct listings.

  • Financial management experience within early-stage biotechnology or energy sectors.

  • Practical experience serving as a director, officer, or senior manager across multiple corporate entities.

Required Software Skills

  • Microsoft Excel.

Integrated Commercial Marketing Manager

Location: Remote within the United States (Eastern or Central Time Zones required; Eastern Time Zone preferred)

The Integrated Commercial Marketing Manager develops and executes integrated marketing strategies that drive growth, increase customer engagement, and deliver measurable business results. This role translates business, product, and commercial objectives into coordinated marketing plans across digital and traditional channels, including web, email, social media, events, websites, and customer campaigns.

Partnering closely with Product Management, Commercial Leadership, and the FHS Centralized Marketing team, this position owns marketing strategy, campaign prioritization, messaging, customer journey development, and performance measurement. While campaign execution is managed through the centralized marketing team, this role ensures all activities are aligned to business priorities and work together to create a seamless customer experience.

The successful candidate will leverage data and customer insights to optimize marketing investments, measure ROI, and continuously improve performance. They will lead cross-functional initiatives that increase brand awareness,

Commercial Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Develop integrated marketing strategies and plans that drive growth, customer engagement, and revenue.
  • Translate business, product, and commercial priorities into marketing campaigns, investments, and growth initiatives.
  • Measure performance, optimize marketing investments, and drive ROI.

Brand, Demand Generation & Customer Experience

  • Drive brand awareness, demand generation, and customer retention through integrated marketing programs.
  • Own customer messaging, website strategy, marketing content, and customer journey development.
  • Support product launches and commercial initiatives with coordinated marketing campaigns and sales enablement materials.
  • Generate qualified sales opportunities through digital, event, email, social, web, and customer marketing programs.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including substantial experience owning integrated marketing strategy, demand generation, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy, product roadmaps, and customer insights into measurable marketing plans.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, website strategy, social media, email marketing, events, webinars, customer communications, and funnel performance.
  • Proven ability to communicate difficult concepts, influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, and negotiate alignment on priorities and investments.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, communication, planning, and project leadership skills, with the ability to identify innovative solutions to complex business challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, technology, SaaS, industrial, or regulated markets.
  • Demonstrated success developing integrated marketing strategies and demand generation programs.
  • Experience with digital marketing, website management, social media, email marketing, and events.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect marketing activities to business outcomes.
  • Ability to influence and lead across functions without direct authority.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke Health Solutions

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. And we believe in giving you the opportunity, accountability, and visibility to do just that.

We are seeking a skilled VFX Artist / Reviewer on a freelance basis. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and approving real-time visual effects created by external vendors to ensure they meet our artistic vision, technical requirements, and project standards.

  • Excellent communication and feedback delivery skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistency across multiple visual effects styles and environments.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryAptive is seeking an experienced Clinical Informaticist III to support the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Health Informatics (OHI), Clinical Informatics and Data Management Office (OCI), in advancing the enterprise standard of care through improved data, tools, and informatics processes across 170+ VA Medical Centers.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Aptive is seeking an experienced Clinical Informaticist III to support the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Health Informatics (OHI), Clinical Informatics and Data Management Office (OCI), in advancing the enterprise standard of care through improved data, tools, and informatics processes across 170+ VA Medical Centers.

This is a senior clinical informatics role. You will assess the information and knowledge-based needs of clinicians and Veterans, characterize and refine clinical processes, and lead the analysis, design, and continuous improvement of clinical decision support, clinical content, and standardized national workflows in the modernized electronic health record. You will translate complex clinical and operational problems into documented, defensible recommendations that VHA governance bodies and Tier 1 Subject Matter Experts can act on quickly.

Work on this program is organized under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Analyses, decision support, and recommendations are delivered as Features within quarterly Planning Intervals, demonstrated to the government on a two-week cadence, and tracked in Jira and Jira Align.

The ideal candidate brings a clinical background, deep informatics expertise, strong facilitation skills, and the judgment to lead others and operate independently in a fast-moving, decision-driven environment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Clinical Needs Assessment. Assess the information and knowledge-based needs of healthcare professionals and Veterans; characterize, evaluate, and refine clinical processes to improve safety, quality, and efficiency at the point of care.
  • Clinical Workflow Analysis and Standardization. Analyze current- and future-state clinical workflows across surgical, primary care, dental, specialty care, pharmacy, and ancillary service areas; document processes using BPM+ notation and value stream mapping to drive enterprise workflow standardization.
  • Clinical Decision Support. Develop, implement, evaluate, and continuously refine clinical decision support, order sets, PowerPlans, templates, alerts, and standardized clinical content in the federal EHR.
  • Clinical Systems Lifecycle. Lead or participate in the customization, development, implementation, management, evaluation, and continuous improvement of clinical information systems and order-entry systems.
  • Feature Delivery. Analyze government-provided problem statements and develop the lean business cases, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements needed to execute work prioritized in Planning Interval planning.
  • Agile Team Participation. Serve as a clinical subject matter expert on interdisciplinary agile teams; participate in daily stand-ups, iteration planning, PI planning, retrospectives, roadmap updates, and biweekly demonstration ceremonies, presenting both completed work and work in progress.
  • Decision Management Support. Intake, capture, and triage incoming clinical decisions through a standardized process; determine the appropriate decision-making authority based on established criteria; and create, maintain, and disseminate decision logs communicating Tier 1 SME decisions to stakeholders.
  • Governance and Consensus Building. Facilitate continuous exploration and iteration of standard configuration National Workflows, obtaining renewed consensus with Tier 1 SMEs, governing bodies, and VHA stakeholders; analyze emergent Courses of Action for adoption as standard workflow configurations or contingency plans.
  • Clinical Content Migration. Support migration of Design Decision Matrices (DDMs), Data Collection Workbooks (DCWs), and problem resolution artifacts, and integrate workflows into a VA National Standards of Practice Model in partnership with Oracle Health.
  • Value and Outcome Measurement. Perform value-based analysis of available healthcare data to assess and recommend how VA measures value delivered at the point of care; contribute to OKRs, KPIs, and leading indicators tied to safety, alignment to standard, timely access, cost reduction, automation, and provider and Veteran experience.
  • Risk and Quality Management. Identify, document, and track clinical and functional risks and issues; maintain risk registers; convey impacts to relevant VHA offices; and support quality assurance activities.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Change Management. Engage clinical and operational stakeholders across VHACO, VISNs, and VAMCs; facilitate working sessions; and support communications and change management for informatics decisions and workflow changes.
  • Mentorship and Leadership. Provide direction, technical review, and mentorship to junior informaticists and analysts; may manage or lead the work of others.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced clinical degree (MSN, PharmD, MD, DO, DNP) or master's degree in health informatics or a related discipline.
  • 10 years of progressive clinical informatics, health systems analysis, or EHR implementation and optimization experience.
  • Clinical background such as registered nurse, nurse informaticist, pharmacist, physician, therapist, Health Informatics Specialist (HIS), or Clinical Application Coordinator (CAC).
  • Demonstrated experience assessing clinical information needs, refining clinical processes, and developing or optimizing clinical decision support.
  • Experience analyzing and documenting clinical workflows, including process mapping using BPM+ or comparable notation.
  • Experience working in an Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including backlog management and delivery tracking in Jira and/or Jira Align.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, and advanced Excel skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief clinical and executive stakeholders and produce decision-quality documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and deliver on a fixed iteration and Planning Interval cadence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Completion of VA Privacy and Information Security Awareness and Rules of Behavior training (TMS #10176) upon onboarding and annually thereafter.
  • Position is located within the United States; legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Informatics certification such as NI-BC (Nursing Informatics Board Certified), CPHIMS, or AMIA Health Informatics Certification.
  • Direct VA or VHA experience, including work with OHI, OCI, CPMO, EHRM, or VA Medical Center informatics operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner Millennium), including PowerChart, PowerPlans, PharmNet, or comparable module-level configuration.
  • Experience with VistA/CPRS and legacy-to-modernized EHR transition, mapping, or dual-system workflow support.
  • Experience supporting EHR governance bodies, decision boards, or Tier 1 SME structures in a large health system.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Remedy, Jazz, or robotic process automation applied to clinical workflow and ticketing integration.
  • Experience with value stream mapping, Lean process improvement, or high reliability organization methods in healthcare.
  • Experience mentoring or leading clinical informatics staff.

About the Role

Provider Operations keeps Steno's nationwide network of court reporters running — coverage, quality, retention, and growth. Today, many of those calls get made on intuition, because the team is lacking direct access to reliable and comprehensive data. This role exists to close that gap: independently define, build, and own the analytics function for Provider Operations — starting with funnel and coverage visibility and expanding into quality and tiering, retention, coverage forecasting, and more. You'll set the roadmap for what gets built and in what order.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director of Provider Operations. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy and you'll be trusted to exercise business judgment on trade-offs that affect coverage, cost, and provider experience, not just technical judgment on how to build the analysis.

Who We're Looking For

Someone equal parts analytically strong and operationally curious. You're comfortable with the technical side of the work, but you don't stop at the number — you dig into why it moved, what's driving it operationally, and what it means for the team's next decision. Analysis that's technically correct but that no one can act on isn't a win here; usable, contextualized insight is the bar.

On a Regular Basis, You Will

  • Build and own the reporting and analysis backbone for Provider Operations — spanning the provider funnel (sourcing, onboarding, activation), coverage and fill rate, quality and tiering, retention, and rate strategy
  • Partner day-to-day with our Provider Operations pillars and leadership to understand how the business actually runs, and translate that context into analysis the team can use
  • Own dashboards and recurring reporting that make the health of the provider network visible — where it's working, where it's leaking, and why
  • Build and refine a reporter quality and tiering framework that connects performance data to sourcing, retention, and incentive decisions
  • Develop coverage and fill rate forecasting that flags risk by market before it becomes a miss
  • Analyze retention and rate strategy — what keeps reporters engaged versus what drives attrition
  • Field ad hoc data and analysis requests across Provider Operations, prioritizing based on business impact
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to build proper tools and instrumentation, rather than patching solutions together manually long-term
  • Present findings and recommendations to Provider Operations leadership and own follow-through on adoption

You'll Thrive in This Role If

  • You're analytically strong — comfortable with SQL, dashboarding tools, and turning ambiguous business questions into structured analysis
  • You're operationally curious by nature — you understand the operational reality well enough that your analysis is contextualized and immediately usable, not just technically sound
  • You can translate complex analysis into something a non-analyst can read, understand, and act on
  • You have experience in operations, marketplace, or high-volume service environments, and understand how ground-level work actually happens
  • You prioritize well — you know which questions matter most right now and focus there first, rather than chasing every interesting thread

  • You communicate clearly, both in writing and when presenting findings to technical and non-technical audiences alike

Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients.
jobs.description:
GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients. The role combines hands-on tax compliance delivery with technical support to the business-development process.

The postholder prepares and reviews UK Corporation Tax and VAT returns and files them with HMRC to deadline, while maintaining the supporting accounting records. In addition, the postholder provides technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing, and advises clients across corporate tax and VAT.

The role sits within the Accounting, Tax & Payments function and reports to the Regional Product Owner (EMEA). Two positions are available, at Senior and Junior level, to provide cover, resilience and a route for progression. The working language is English and no additional language is required, giving access to a broad candidate pool from UK practice and industry.

GoGlobal acts as its clients’ UK tax agent, and is registered with HMRC and supervised for anti-money-laundering purposes in accordance with HMRC’s Standard for Agents. The postholder operates within this framework.

Roles & Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance

• Prepare and review UK Corporation Tax returns (CT600) and computations, including iXBRL tagging, and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Address capital allowances, tax adjustments to the accounts, loss and group relief, and Research & Development claims where relevant.

• Manage Corporation Tax payment deadlines, including Quarterly Instalment Payments for larger companies.

VAT Compliance

• Prepare and review VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD) and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Manage VAT registrations and de-registrations, and advise on schemes and treatments, including flat-rate, partial exemption, and place-of-supply and cross-border matters.

• Manage VAT deadlines, payments and reconciliations across the client portfolio.

Accounting and Statutory

• Prepare and review statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105) and management accounts in support of the tax work.

• Support Companies House filings, including annual accounts and the confirmation statement, and maintain statutory records.

Business Development Support

• Provide technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing.

• Represent the tax function in client and prospective-client meetings, presenting GoGlobal’s UK capability accurately and credibly.

• Identify opportunities to extend GoGlobal services (entity management, payroll, accounting and Employer of Record) within the client portfolio.

• Contribute to service documentation, scoping templates and technical guidance for UK tax.

Client Relationship and Advisory

• Manage the relationships within an assigned client portfolio and provide proactive, practical UK tax and accounting advice.

• Resolve client queries and issues promptly, and communicate technical matters clearly and commercially.

HMRC, Controls and Quality

• Manage HMRC correspondence, agent authorisations (form 64-8), enquiries and filing calendars.

• Apply four-eyes review, GoGlobal internal controls and data-protection standards, and operate within anti-money-laundering requirements and HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Key Performance Indicators

• Corporation Tax, VAT and statutory-accounts filings completed accurately and on time, with no missed HMRC or Companies House deadlines.

• Contribution to business development, measured through proposals supported and new or extended work won.

• Client satisfaction and retention across the portfolio.

• Turnaround times and quality of work, including levels of rework.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• Qualified in UK corporate tax and VAT: ATT (Association of Taxation Technicians), or qualified by experience in corporate tax and VAT compliance.

• No statutory licence is required in the United Kingdom to prepare or file Corporation Tax or VAT returns. A chartered-accountant qualification (ACA or ACCA) or CPA is not required, as this is a tax role rather than an audit role.

• CTA (Chartered Tax Adviser) is desirable, particularly for the Senior position. Candidates for the Junior position may be ATT-qualified or part-qualified and studying.

• GoGlobal provides the anti-money-laundering supervision and HMRC agent registration; the postholder is expected to meet fit-and-proper standards and to work within HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Core Requirements

• Practical working knowledge of UK Corporation Tax (CT600, computations and iXBRL) and VAT (MTD), together with UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105).

• Familiarity with HMRC online services, Making Tax Digital and Companies House filings, and competence with tax and accounting software (for example Alphatax, Digita, CCH, TaxCalc, Xero or Sage).

• Commercial awareness and a client-facing manner, with the confidence to support business development through scoping, pricing and client meetings.

• Strong written and spoken English, and a well-organised, accurate and deadline-driven approach.

• The right to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred

• Experience in practice (an accountancy or tax firm) managing a portfolio of clients, ideally including international or foreign-owned entities.

• Exposure to payroll and PAYE, Research & Development relief, or cross-border and international tax.

• Experience contributing to proposals, pricing or business development, and with cloud accounting software such as Xero.

Who Thrives in This Role

• Technically strong tax professionals who are also commercially minded and comfortable supporting business development.

• Client-facing advisers who enjoy variety across corporate tax, VAT and accounting, and managing a growing portfolio.

• Clear communicators who can make technical matters simple and useful for clients.

Benefits

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.

Nuclear Medicine and Nuclear Cardiac Industry acumen.

Annual Budget Planning & Freight accruals

  • Track actuals vs. budget; identify variances, provide analysis, and support Logistics leadership in financial decision-making.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Logistics Operations to align budget assumptions with network realities and contractual commitments.

Logistics Data Products: End-User representation

  • Serve as the primary end-user voice for reporting, KPI, and performance-data requirements within Logistics Data Products;.
  • Partner with the Global Logistics BPO, DTE, and the Supply Chain SCORE team to ensure data products deliver the analytical capabilities Logistics needs to operate and improve.

  • Champion data-driven decision-making across Logistics; build the analytical culture and capability within the function.

The Impact You Will Make

This role helps Risepoint understand how organic discovery, AI search, and the digital experience contribute to student demand and enrollment. The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics will lead day-to-day analytical work across SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), website/DXP performance, and the organic funnel. By connecting visibility and website behavior to leads, applications, and enrollments, this person will help the organization understand what happened, why it happened, where it is concentrated, and what actions should follow.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life
The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics is the primary day-to-day analytics partner for SEO, AEO, organic content, and DXP/CRO measurement within Channel Analytics. Working under the direction of the Sr. Director, Channel Analytics, this person leads analytical execution, develops measurement approaches, defines business and reporting requirements, conducts deep-dive analyses, and translates findings into clear recommendations. They partner closely with Analytics Solutions, which develops production dashboards, as well as SEO/AEO, Digital Experience, CRO, CRM, Data Engineering, and other analytics stakeholders. The role measures and evaluates organic strategy; it does not own SEO/content execution.

What You Will Do

  • Lead monthly Organic MBR analysis and recurring performance diagnosis across SEO, AEO, website/DXP, and the organic funnel, including traffic, leads, applications/enrollments where available, conversion, YoY/MoM drivers, where performance is concentrated, opportunities, and risks.
  • Analyze SEO performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms, including impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings/visibility, branded vs. non-branded demand where useful, landing-page/content performance, and where performance gains or declines are concentrated.
  • Lead AEO measurement across AI visibility, citations, Citation Share/Share of Voice, prompts/topics, engine-level performance, AI referral traffic, competitive/source analysis, and downstream outcomes; partner with Profound or similar platform data as available.
  • Design measurement for AEO, SEO, DXP, and CRO initiatives by establishing baselines, intervention dates, comparison groups or matched controls where appropriate, and post-launch reads; evaluate uncertainty, confounding, and whether observed changes are reasonably attributable to the intervention.
  • Measure website and funnel performance from organic/AI discovery through landing-page behavior, forms, leads, applications, and enrollments; distinguish traffic-driven changes from conversion-driven changes and evaluate DXP migrations, site releases, and CRO changes.
  • Reconcile GA4/GSC/SEO/AEO/CRM data, investigate material Organic performance changes, identify tracking or taxonomy issues before results reach leadership, and translate findings into 2–4 decision-ready insights rather than metric dumps.
  • Define KPI logic, reporting requirements, analytical views, intervention/change logs, and data-quality needs; partner with Antonio/Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering to bring GA4, GSC, AEO platform, Salesforce, and intervention data into scalable reporting and Databricks-based workflows rather than relying on manual Excel processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic MBR analysis is delivered with clear drivers, concentrations, business implications, and recommended actions, allowing the Sr. Director to review and sharpen the story rather than perform the first-pass analysis.
  • SEO, AEO, and DXP performance can be connected from visibility and search demand through website behavior, leads, applications, and enrollments, with known data limitations clearly documented.
  • AEO reporting moves from manual snapshots toward a scalable history and measurement process with clear hero metrics, engine-level views, prompt/topic and URL-level analysis, intervention tracking, and credible post-launch reads.
  • Material Organic, content, and website changes can be diagnosed quickly, including whether movement reflects demand, visibility, traffic quality, conversion, tracking, taxonomy, or maturation effects.
  • The Senior Manager becomes the primary day-to-day analytics partner for Organic, AEO, and Digital Experience stakeholders, increasing Channel Analytics capacity while the Sr. Director retains overall strategy, prioritization, and cross-channel accountability.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Reliability, adoption, and usefulness of Organic MBR analysis and recurring SEO, AEO, DXP/CRO, and funnel reporting.
  • Quality of business requirements, KPI definitions, analytical specifications, and data QA provided to Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering.
  • Improved visibility into organic traffic quality, search/content effectiveness, AI-search performance, website conversion, and progression through application and enrollment.
  • Quality and credibility of pilot, test, migration, and rollout measurement, including appropriate treatment of baselines, comparison groups, intervention timing, uncertainty, and confounding.
  • Clarity and actionability of recommendations and evidence that insights influence SEO/AEO, content, DXP/CRO, partner, and prioritization decisions.
  • Reduction in repetitive manual analysis and stakeholder confidence in the Organic analytics story presented to leadership.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience & Skills That Matter Most (Required)

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in digital/web analytics, organic/SEO analytics, marketing analytics, or a closely related data-driven environment, with demonstrated strength diagnosing performance rather than only producing reports.
  • Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently pull, join, QA, and investigate complex web, marketing, and CRM datasets in cloud data environments.
  • Strong analytical proficiency with GA4 and Google Search Console plus working knowledge of SEO data/tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent; understand traffic sources, landing pages, events, funnels, rankings/visibility, queries, content performance, and technical SEO concepts.
  • Strong funnel analytics skills, including the ability to connect sessions and website behavior to leads, applications, enrollments, conversion rates, cohort/maturation considerations, and known attribution or identity-resolution limitations.
  • Strong analytical diagnosis, data QA, and executive storytelling skills: identify whether unusual results are real or caused by tracking/taxonomy issues and translate findings into what happened, why, where it is concentrated, and what should happen next.
  • Experience defining KPI logic, business requirements, and reporting specifications for BI/Analytics Solutions teams; strong Excel skills and enough data-visualization fluency to design useful reporting without being the production dashboard developer.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation and causal measurement concepts, including pre/post design, control or matched-comparison groups, confounding, uncertainty/statistical significance, and the limits of correlation; deep experimental-design expertise is not required.

Experience That’s Great to Have (Preferred)

  • AEO/generative-search literacy, including citations vs. mentions, prompts and prompt themes, AI visibility/Share of Voice, source attribution, branded vs. non-branded prompts, engine differences, AI referrals, zero-click/offsite discovery, and experience with Profound, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Semrush AI visibility tools, or similar platforms.
  • Deeper experimentation/causal-inference experience, including matched controls, difference-in-differences, natural experiments, incrementality, or rollout measurement; Python or R experience for large-scale prompt/citation analysis, URL classification, topic clustering, or competitor analysis is also valuable.
  • Experience with Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake, Salesforce data, Power BI, GSC/API data, web scraping/log-file analysis, DXP/CRO teams, or higher-education/high-consideration lead-generation environments.

jobs.description:
Job Summary


The Senior Performance Engineer is responsible for expected-versus-actual energy performance across SunStrong’s serviced fleet, spanning residential systems, commercial and industrial sites, community solar, and utility-scale projects. This role models production, quantifies and defends contractual performance obligations, and drives underperformance to root cause with operations and field services. As the senior technical authority on fleet performance, the position sets the data requirements behind performance reporting, advises on dashboard and analytics development rather than building it, and partners with asset management and O&M on billing and settlement accuracy. The role sits on the Fleet Management Technology team and requires equal comfort with a residential inverter fleet, a metered utility-scale PPA settlement, and the data platform that carries both.

Responsibilities

  • Model and monitor energy performance across residential, C&I, community solar, and utility-scale assets in PlantPredict and the fleet monitoring platforms (AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, 3E), comparing metered production against simulation using weather and irradiance data from Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.
  • Calculate and defend contractual performance metrics including availability, performance ratio, production guarantees, and liquidated damages exposure, and produce the recurring analysis that supports billing, PPA and lease invoicing, and investor and securitization reporting.
  • Evaluate billing and settlement accuracy with the asset management and O&M teams, reconciling metered, monitored, and invoiced quantities and resolving discrepancies at the source.
  • Investigate underperformance to root cause across inverters, meters, communications, energy storage, and site conditions, and drive corrective work to closure with O&M and field services.
  • Direct the data requirements for fleet performance — tags, granularity, units, timestamps, and quality rules — and support data collection, ingestion, and reconciliation with the data platform team.
  • Advise on the development of Power BI dashboards and performance reporting, defining metric definitions, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria, and validating output rather than building the reports directly.
  • Define monitoring, revenue-grade metering, and telemetry requirements for new and retrofitted sites, and validate commissioning data before a site is accepted into the fleet.
  • Establish performance baselines and data mappings for newly acquired or transitioned portfolios, including migration from legacy monitoring platforms.
  • Validate storage system performance against contracted operating modes, including dispatch behavior, state of health, cycling, and demand-charge and tariff-driven response.
  • Apply AI tooling and agentic workflows to accelerate fleet diagnostics, anomaly triage, and recurring analysis, and define where model output requires engineering verification before it is relied on.
  • Serve as technical reviewer for warranty, insurance, and equipment claims requiring quantified production loss, and mentor junior engineers and analysts on performance methods.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years in solar or storage performance engineering, asset performance management, or renewable O&M engineering, including 3+ years supporting commercial or utility-scale assets.
  • Hands-on experience with PV performance modeling in PlantPredict (PVsyst or SAM acceptable as a secondary), and with satellite irradiance and weather datasets including Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.
  • Working experience with fleet monitoring and asset performance platforms including AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, and 3E, including data extraction, tag mapping, and alarm configuration.
  • Proficiency in SQL and in Python for engineering analysis (pandas, numpy, pvlib or equivalent).
  • Practical fluency with AI tooling — coding assistants, LLM-based analysis, and agentic workflows — applied to engineering work, with sound judgment on where output must be verified.
  • Demonstrated ability to specify data requirements, validation rules, and reconciliation logic for engineering and BI teams, and to review dashboards and reporting for correctness.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring, metering, and SCADA data acquisition, including common protocols and vendor APIs (Modbus, SunSpec, DNP3, REST).
  • Familiarity with leased, PPA, and securitized portfolios, including production and availability guarantees, settlement mechanics, and investor reporting obligations.
  • Battery energy storage experience covering BMS behavior, state-of-health analysis, and dispatch validation.
  • Ability to work against incomplete legacy as-built and monitoring data, and to state assumptions and uncertainty explicitly to engineering, asset management, and capital partners.

jobs.excerpt: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, BelgiumContract: Duration being confirmed.
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Belgium

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Belgium. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

At Storyteq, we help some of the world's biggest brands simplify their marketing operations, streamline creative production and bring campaigns to life faster.

We're looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer (C#/.NET) to join our MediaCentre team, working on a platform used by major retail brands to manage everything from campaign planning and production through to delivering marketing materials across stores.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting stuck into technical challenges, taking ownership of their work and making a real impact. You'll be working on a mix of existing applications and exciting new features, collaborating with engineers, Product Owners and technical specialists to continuously improve the platform.

We're looking for someone with solid C#/.NET experience who's comfortable working independently but also enjoys being part of a collaborative team. You don't need to know everything, but you should be curious, proactive and keen to develop your technical skills.

  • Develop, maintain and improve applications and services using C#, ASP.NET and .NET technologies.
  • Take ownership of delivering features and improvements, from understanding requirements through to development, testing and release.
  • Work closely with Product Owners and engineers to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria and technical solutions.
  • Build, maintain and integrate REST APIs to support the platform's functionality.
  • Work with SQL databases and Entity Framework to implement and optimise data access.
  • Write and maintain automated tests to ensure code quality, reliability and performance.
  • Use Docker and established CI/CD pipelines to support development, testing and deployment.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvements.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, Solution Architects and Platform Engineers on technical designs and more complex challenges.
  • Communicate progress, challenges and potential risks clearly with the wider team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing applications, development processes and technical documentation.

Essential

  • Minimum of 3 years' professional software development experience, including hands-on C#/.NET development within a collaborative engineering team.
  • Strong practical experience with C# and ASP.NET MVC or Web API, with familiarity across both .NET Framework and modern .NET.
  • Experience working with SQL and relational databases, ideally SQL Server, using an ORM such as Entity Framework.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating REST APIs, including validation, authentication and error handling.
  • Experience developing or supporting cloud-hosted applications using GCP, Azure or AWS.
  • Working knowledge of Docker, including building images, running containers and troubleshooting configuration issues.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, pull requests and code reviews within a structured development environment.

  • Understanding of application security principles, including authorisation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.

  • Experience working with gRPC.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes or infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as New Relic, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.

  • Exposure to front-end technologies such as Razor, jQuery, Vue.js or Angular.
  • Experience maintaining established applications or working with complex business workflows.
  • Experience contributing to technical design discussions and identifying opportunities to improve application performance and scalability.

jobs.description:
About Veradigm

Veradigm is a healthcare data and technology company that connects providers, payers, and life sciences around the patient. Our Health Network Architecture (HNA) brings clinical, financial, and administrative data together across our EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, and patient engagement products, so a capability built once can serve every practice we support. Our products, including Practice Fusion, Veradigm EHR, Veradigm Practice Management, and FollowMyHealth, are used by thousands of independent practices and millions of patients.


About the role

This is an individual contributor role with broad influence. You will lead initiatives across multiple product and engineering teams while staying close to architecture, code, data, user experience, infrastructure, and production operations. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear technical direction, align teams around practical solutions, and improve engineering effectiveness across the organization.


We measure success by outcomes, not output. You will partner with product managers and designers to understand the problem and weigh in on feasibility before committing to a solution, test ideas early with customers and data, and judge results by whether they make a real difference for patients, practices, and partners. Shipping a feature is a step, not the goal.

We hold an unreasonably high bar for excellence. That means clear success criteria, designs and code that others can build on, systems that stay secure and reliable in production, and the discipline to simplify or stop work that is not delivering.


We value engineers who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn and share what they discover. You will help multiple teams improve how they build software, including the responsible and effective use of AI-assisted development practices.


About the team

You will join the Patient Engagement group, which builds the tools patients use to schedule, check in, message their care team, pay their bill, and understand their care journey. You will work across existing and new patient engagement offerings; all integrated with our EHR products.

What you will do

  • Lead complex, multi-team initiatives from discovery through delivery and production operation.
  • Define architectures and roadmaps across databases, applications, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and deployment platforms.
  • Stay hands-on by prototyping, designing, coding, debugging, reviewing, and implementing critical or high-risk work.
  • Create alignment across teams by making technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and evolution paths clear.
  • Establish shared patterns and standards that help teams deliver consistently without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Identify and address systemic risks in security, scalability, resilience, performance, data, cost, and developer experience.
  • Lead modernization of large or long-lived systems while protecting customer value and operational stability.
  • Set quality standards through design reviews, testing strategy, observability, incident learning, and operational readiness.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders and influence engineering practices without relying on direct authority.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and AI-assisted development practices, establish useful patterns, and share guidance across teams.
  • Help teams learn from delivery and production feedback through documentation, technical discussions, demos, and communities of practice.

What you bring

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years of professional experience delivering and operating production software.
  • A record of leading complex technical initiatives across multiple engineering or product teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver full-stack solutions across relational data, backend services and APIs, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.

jobs.description:
About LemonEdge

Private markets run on numbers that have to be right. Yet much of the industry still relies on spreadsheets and manual processes to manage increasingly complex financial operations.

LemonEdge is building the next generation of accounting technology to change that. Our platform helps fund administrators and asset managers automate complexity, improve accuracy, and scale with confidence.

The engineering challenge is significant: building software that makes complex financial processes simpler, more reliable, and more transparent. Every calculation matter, and every feature needs to stand up to real-world scrutiny.

What We're Looking for

We’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer ready to take ownership of meaningful work, from the first conversation in refinement through development, testing, and production.

At LemonEdge, you won’t just be picking up tasks and passing them along. You’ll own your stories end to end, make thoughtful engineering decisions, and grow toward taking responsibility for an entire component.

This is a full-stack engineering role with a strong backend focus: approximately 75% server-side development in C# / .NET and 25% frontend across our WPF desktop application and React web application.

What You'll Do

  • Own your work end to end. Take stories from refinement through design, development, testing, and production deployment. Follow through to make sure your changes work as expected in a live environment.
  • Build for accuracy. Validate outputs against expected results, investigate discrepancies, and test edge cases rather than relying solely on happy-path scenarios.
  • Make thoughtful engineering decisions. Work within our existing architecture and modules, write maintainable code, and understand and communicate the trade-offs behind your approach.
  • Use AI thoughtfully. Leverage AI-assisted development tools where they add value, while applying appropriate scrutiny, testing, and verification based on the risk and complexity of each change.
  • Take responsibility for what you ship. Participate in a light on-call rotation, using established runbooks and working alongside experienced engineers when issues need escalation.
  • Bring clarity to complexity. Ask questions, engage the right stakeholders, and turn ambiguous requirements into well-defined, actionable work.

What You'll Bring

  • Professional experience developing and shipping software, with evidence that you can take work from start to finish with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency in at least one statically typed programming language, such as C#, Java, Go, or TypeScript. Our primary technology stack is C# / .NET.
  • Solid SQL skills, including working with relational data models, writing queries, and understanding query execution plans.
  • A strong testing mindset, with an appreciation for edge cases, validation, and the importance of verifying AI-generated code.
  • An understanding of secure development fundamentals, including input validation and protecting sensitive information in code, logs, and application workflows.
  • A structured approach to debugging: forming hypotheses, using debuggers and logs to investigate issues, and understanding why problems occur rather than simply fixing symptoms.
  • Clear, proactive communication skills, including writing useful pull request descriptions, responding constructively to feedback, and raising blockers early.

Bonus Points If You Bring

  • Professional experience with C# / .NET.
  • Experience integrating with external services, including appropriate use of timeouts, retries, and idempotency.
  • Experience writing reversible database migrations and validating them against realistic data.
  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted SaaS applications, CI/CD pipelines, or containerized environments.
  • Exposure to finance, accounting, or another domain where accuracy, consistency, and reconciliation are critical.
  • Frontend development experience, particularly with WPF or React.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI workflows or building AI-powered capabilities into a product.

Our client is building the software that hearing clinics run on patient records, bookings, hearing tests and sales. Clinic chains and hospitals use it every day. You join the team that owns the Sales domain: quote, invoice, insurance claim and payment. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who ships business outcomes, not just tickets. You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.

  • Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.
