Product Mindset

As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

  • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

  • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

  • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

  • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

jobs.excerpt: Position Name: Full-Stack Python Engineer Location: Lincoln, MA, San Francisco or Remote Employment Type: Full-timeCitizenship: US Citizens onlyNotes: Direct Hire.
jobs.description:
Position Name: Full-Stack Python Engineer

Location: Lincoln, MA, San Francisco or Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Citizenship: US Citizens only

Notes: Direct Hire. No third-party assistance is approved for this role.

About The Job: At Jaxon, we are on a mission to make AI trustworthy. The adoption of large language models (LLMs) in corporate settings is hindered by the “hallucination problem,” where AI models produce inaccurate or entirely fabricated responses. For regulated industries and high-risk applications, this issue is preventing LLM use altogether.

As a Full-Stack Python Engineer at Jaxon, you will play a key role in building the next generation of applications that are powered by our cutting-edge AI platform. You will be responsible for some frontend, but will be interfacing with backend systems, creating a seamless user experience tailored for DSAIL users. This includes designing and implementing intuitive, responsive applications using modern frontend technologies like Dash, and integrating them with a Python backend and RESTful APIs that connect to Jaxon's services.

In this role, you will shape the design and technical direction of the platform, propose and implement best-in-class technologies, and drive decisions that impact user satisfaction and product scalability. You will ensure that our products deliver high performance, scalability, and a fluid user experience, ultimately helping engineers and data scientists perform complex tasks like model deployment, evaluation, and visualization with ease.

The basics of this role require the ability to:

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into our existing systems and workflows, enhancing product capabilities.

  • Demonstrate Technical Proficiency: Demonstrate solid frontend development experience, particularly with data-intensive applications. Be comfortable showing leadership on frontend design best practices.

  • Understand Machine Learning Models: Be familiar with machine learning models, particularly how they work and are used, so you can understand DSAIL and what we do.

Soft Skills:

  • Able to context switch as needed

  • Able to compartmentalize different projects with different goals

  • Able to communicate clearly and precisely - not just abstractions and "lines-and-boxes"

Specific Technologies:

  • Python

  • Building and deploying component libraries

  • Web APIs and how to integrate with them

  • Familiarity with Python Data Science Stack - NumPy, Pandas, Scikit Learn, various deep learning packages

  • Knowledge in AI/ML techniques is a major plus

Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience with the Dash framework or a willingness to learn if not already proficient

  • Comfortable with frontend state management libraries like Redux and MobX

  • Bonus points for knowledge of React or a similar frontend frameworks

  • Experience with using Figma as part of a design and implementation workflow

  • Familiarity with TypeScript and JavaScript

  • Familiarity with CSS and SASS or SCSS

About Jaxon: Jaxon is a leading provider of machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions. We are committed to helping our customers solve complex problems with AI. Our products and services are used by businesses of all sizes, from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

What Makes Jaxon Different?

  • Human First: Our leaders get it — life happens. Whether it’s flexible working hours or understanding the need for a mental health day, we prioritize your well-being. Our CEO recognizes that happy people do the best work and he backs that up with an empathetically led culture – and I’m not just saying that because he’s going to read this post.

  • Laid-Back Culture: We know that the best work comes from a place of comfort and authenticity. At Jaxon, you’re encouraged to be yourself, dress casually, and embrace your quirky side. It’s just one of the benefits of being an early-stage, high-growth startup.

  • Tech Lover's Dream: From hackathons to tech talks with industry leaders, we fuel our passion for innovation with constant learning and development opportunities.

  • Grunt Work to Grand Projects: Every task you tackle, big or small, matters. You think I’m writing job descriptions for fun? Sometimes things need to get done and it’s an all hands on deck situation to get them to the finish line. We're looking for team players who understand that achieving groundbreaking AI innovations sometimes involves rolling up your sleeves to tackle the essential, yet less glamorous tasks.

  • ​​Excited about the prospect of free snacks, massages, and a hot tub at the office? You might have to keep looking, as we're a fully remote team. However, if you ever feel the need to switch up your work environment, you’re always welcome at our office space in Lincoln, Massachusetts—includes a dartboard for slow afternoons.

Added Perks:

  • Unlimited PTO: (seriously!)

  • Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Competitive Salary: We provide competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience

  • Stock Options: All compensation plans include stock options - join now and benefit from future acquisitions

  • Holidays Off: ALL federal holidays are paid time off

About You: You're the type of person who's naturally driven—not necessarily because you built a rocket in your backyard as a kid, but because you have a genuine curiosity about the world of technology. In your spare time, you might find yourself deep-diving into technology subreddits, following the latest industry trends, or exploring which companies are innovating and how. Your passion isn't just about staying informed; it's about thinking how you can take these emerging concepts and scale them up, make them faster, or more impactful. At Jaxon, we're looking for someone who sees a baseline and instinctively wants to build beyond it. If you’re ready to take what exists and make it extraordinary, you’ll fit right in.

The engineering team at Jaxon warned me that all engineers hate when job descriptions specify bullet lists of X years of experience in technology Y such that time_exists(Y) < X. With that being said, there are no hard tech requirements, but experience with the python ML ecosystem and with LLMs is expected. Additionally:

  • You’re going to need proven expertise in building ML applications.

  • Proficient Python including demonstrable experience with libraries relevant to data manipulation.

  • Ideally some experience with machine learning, in particular NLP applications.

  • You are primarily in a development role, but are comfortable being customer-facing when needed.

  • Active security clearance is a bonus.

  • 2 or more years equivalent professional or military experience.

  • All candidates must derive backpropagation on a whiteboard. (Just kidding! Made you blink.).

We are looking for somebody who thrives in an environment where day-to-day priorities and tasks may rapidly change. The role is not a fit if you value "business as usual".

We value team members who are bold enough to pitch creative ideas, even if they're still rough around the edges or might not make the final cut.

Education and Length of Experience

Preferably applicants will have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar, however at Jaxon, we value skills and dedication over degrees. We strongly encourage people without degrees to apply if you have at least 5 years of experience.

Jaxon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Jaxon, we're revolutionizing the way businesses interact with artificial intelligence.

Our cutting-edge tool, DSAIL, is designed to significantly reduce AI hallucinations and is at the forefront of enhancing the reliability and accuracy of AI applications.

Come work with us as we make AI trustworthy!

jobs.title: 🇩🇪 Product Engineer / Entwickler (100% Remote) – Deutsch fließend
jobs.excerpt: In den meisten Firmen bekommt ein Entwickler ein Ticket, baut es und nimmt sich das nächste.
jobs.description:
In den meisten Firmen bekommt ein Entwickler ein Ticket, baut es und nimmt sich das nächste. Mit dem Kunden hat jemand anderes geredet, was gebaut wird, hat jemand anderes entschieden, und ob es am Ende geholfen hat, fragt keiner.

Wir suchen Entwickler, die die ganze Arbeit machen wollen: mit den Leuten reden, die die Software nutzen, entscheiden, was gebaut wird, es bauen und dranbleiben, bis es für sie funktioniert. Das meinen wir mit Product Engineer. Den Begriff haben wir von PostHog, die ihn in ihrem Product Engineer Handbook gut beschreiben.

Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Du sprichst direkt mit ihnen, deshalb ist fließendes Deutsch für diese Stelle Pflicht.

Über uns

ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Inbox, CRM, Dokumente, Telefonie, Videocalls, Team-Chat und KI-Agenten in einer Plattform, damit Hausverwalter ihre tägliche Arbeit an einem Ort erledigen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit Sitz in Worms und arbeiten komplett remote. Wir finanzieren uns selbst und sind profitabel.

Was ein Product Engineer bei uns macht

  • Du redest mit Kunden. Du liest die Supportanfragen und das Feedback zu deinem Bereich, schaust dir an, wie Kunden ihn nutzen, und sprichst direkt mit ihnen, auf Deutsch. Niemand filtert das für dich.

  • Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird. Für deinen Bereich legst du fest, was als Nächstes kommt, nach dem, was Kunden brauchen und was für die Firma wichtig ist. Du schreibst auf, warum, damit das Team folgen und Feedback geben kann.

  • Du lieferst früh. Die erste Version geht an ein paar Kunden, sobald sie nützlich ist. Dann verbesserst du sie nach dem, was sie sagen und tun.

  • Du baust alles. Datenmodell, Backend, Frontend und UI. Das Ergebnis muss aufgeräumt, einfach und verständlich sein, nicht nur funktionieren.

  • Du machst den Support für deinen Bereich. Wenn etwas kaputt ist oder ein Kunde nicht weiterkommt, behebst du es und sagst ihm Bescheid.

  • Du prüfst, ob es funktioniert hat. Deine Arbeit ist nicht fertig, wenn das Feature live ist. Du schaust, ob Kunden es nutzen und ob es ihr Problem gelöst hat.

  • Du automatisierst, was geht. Wenn ein Kunde eine Supportfrage stellt, trägst du die Antwort in unsere Wissensdatenbank ein und passt unseren internen Agenten an, damit es beim nächsten Mal von selbst läuft. Vieles läuft bei uns schon automatisch, Bugfixes werden bereits halbautomatisch bearbeitet, und wir automatisieren weiter.

Beispiele, woran du arbeiten könntest

  • Ein Kunde will seine alte Dateiablage in unsere Dokumentenverwaltung holen, mit eigener Ordnerstruktur und tausenden Dokumenten, schnell und mit KI-Unterstützung. Du schaust dir an, wie er seine Dateien sortiert hat, baust den Import als allgemeines Feature für alle Kunden, richtest ihn für ihn ein und testest ihn mit seiner Ordnerstruktur. Danach prüfst du, ob die KI jedes Dokument dem richtigen Gebäude, der richtigen Wohnung oder dem richtigen Kontakt zugeordnet hat, und korrigierst, was nicht passt.

  • Ein Kunde meldet, dass der Inbox-Agent einem Mieter eine falsche Antwort gegeben hat. Du schaust dir an, was der Agent gemacht hat, korrigierst das Tool oder seine Anweisungen und gibst dem Kunden Bescheid.

  • Nur wenige Kunden bauen eigene Agenten in der Sandbox. Du findest heraus, warum, über die Daten und Gespräche mit Kunden, machst die Einrichtung einfacher und prüfst, ob danach mehr Kunden sie nutzen.

  • Hausverwalter machen dieselbe Aufgabe fünfzigmal am Tag und brauchen dafür zu viele Klicks. Du merkst das, redest mit ihnen darüber, wie sie arbeiten, und machst es schneller.

Unser Tech-Stack

Alles ist TypeScript, vom Datenbankschema bis zum Frontend.

Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Agenten: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit für Telefonie

Du baust mit Claude und bekommst so viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst.

Gehalt

  • 1.500 – 3.000 $ pro Monat brutto, mit Luft nach oben in den nächsten Monaten und Jahren

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in deinem Wohnland über unseren Partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100 % remote

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Selbst finanziert und profitabel, kein Investorengeld, das verbrannt werden muss

  • Kleines Team, was du baust, geht live

  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine unnötigen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen

Unser Gesundheitsprogramm

  • Einzelzimmer im Krankenhaus, weltweiter Schutz

  • Freie Arzt- und Facharztwahl, keine Gesundheitsprüfung, Vorerkrankungen spielen keine Rolle

  • Partner und Kinder sind mitversichert

  • Operationen, Krebsbehandlung, MRT/CT/PET und Diagnostik voll abgedeckt

  • Zahnbehandlung und Zahn-OP zu 90 % abgedeckt

  • 675 $ pro Jahr für Physiotherapie, Osteopathie, Chiropraktik und Akupunktur

  • 100 $ Krankenhaustagegeld pro Nacht, bis zu 20 Nächte

  • Medikamente, Impfungen, Brillen/Kontaktlinsen, häusliche Pflege und Krankentransport abgedeckt

Unsere Grundprinzipien

  • Speed of Implementation: Wir setzen schnell um. Eine erste Version geht früh live und wird mit dem Feedback der Kunden besser.

  • Radikale Ehrlichkeit: Wir sagen offen, was ist, im Team und gegenüber unseren Kunden. Gerade dann, wenn es unangenehm ist.

  • Hohe Ansprüche an die eigene Arbeit und an die der anderen

Requirements

Voraussetzungen

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), du kannst mit Kunden telefonieren und schreiben

  • Gutes Englisch

  • Mehr als ein Jahr Erfahrung mit Code, der produktiv im Einsatz ist

Worauf wir achten

  • Dir ist wichtiger, dass Kunden ihre Arbeit erledigt bekommen, als die perfekte Umsetzung.

  • Du hast ein gutes Auge für Gestaltung und UI. Du lieferst nicht einfach, was die KI erzeugt, sondern arbeitest an der Oberfläche, bis sie aufgeräumt und für die Nutzer so einfach und verständlich wie möglich ist.

  • Du machst Dinge fertig. Ein Feature, das zu 80 % fertig ist, hilft niemandem, deshalb bleibst du dran, bis es gut funktioniert.

  • Du hast eine Meinung dazu, was gebaut werden soll, und begründest sie mit dem, was Kunden sagen und tun. Wenn das Feedback etwas anderes sagt, änderst du deine Meinung.

  • Du nimmst Feedback gut an und gibst selbst ehrliches Feedback.

  • Du schreibst klar. Als Remote-Team arbeiten wir viel schriftlich: Issues, kurze Vorschläge, PR-Beschreibungen.

  • Du verstehst die Grundlagen des Geschäfts: wer unsere Kunden sind, wofür sie zahlen und warum sie bleiben.

  • Du schreibst fast deinen gesamten Code mit KI und verstehst Architektur gut genug, um zu beurteilen, was sie schreibt.

  • Du automatisierst eine Aufgabe lieber, als sie zweimal zu machen.

  • Du bist Generalist und lernst schnell Neues.

Schön zu haben

  • Du hast ein eigenes Produkt oder Nebenprojekt gebaut, das echte Menschen genutzt haben, oder schon direkt mit Kunden gearbeitet.

  • Erfahrung mit Datenbankdesign und der Optimierung von Abfragen nach Geschwindigkeit und Kosten

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten, Queues und lang laufenden Workflows im Produktivbetrieb

Die Stelle passt nicht zu dir, wenn

  • du willst, dass jemand anderes entscheidet, was du baust, und dir Tickets gibt

  • du lieber nichts mit Kunden oder Support zu tun haben willst

  • du Code wochenlang polieren willst, bevor ihn jemand sieht

  • du gern zur nächsten Idee springst, bevor die letzte wirklich funktioniert

So stellen wir ein

  1. Kennenlerngespräch

  2. Interview mit unserem Gründer über deinen Werdegang und das, was du gebaut hast

  3. Referenzgespräch mit einer früheren Führungskraft

  4. Angebot

Mehr über das, was wir bauen, siehst du auf unserem YouTube-Kanal.

jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We are currently seeking an ambitious pace-setter to join our team as a Senior Manager, Product Analytics (Growth) remotely in the US.

iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and the Senior Manager, Product Analytics (Growth) is the analytics owner of the funnel. You are accountable for the data and insight behind every step between a new visitor and a paying, retained member: onboarding, activation, paywall, trial to paid, and free to paid.

You sit on the Analytics team and partner daily with the Growth Product Leader and the Growth Marketing Leader and the Chief Subscription Officer.

ROLE COMMITMENTS

  • Own measurement of onboarding, activation, paywall, trial to paid, and free to paid.
  • Own methodology for Growth A/B tests: hypotheses, power, success metrics, and readouts.
  • Analyze demographics, behavior, acquisition channel, and equipment ownership to show who converts and retains, and where we can lift results.
  • Define the early behaviors and activation moments that predict long term subscribers, and report on engagement through the first 30 days.
  • KPI definitions. Own definitions for activation, conversion, cohorts, LTV, and CAC, so every team works from the same numbers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the app analytics framework, including event taxonomy, tracking plans, and instrumentation standards, partnering with Product and Engineering to ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistent across iOS, Android, web, and connected equipment.
  • Build and maintain funnel analytics from install and trial start through paid conversion, activation, and renewal, identifying drop-off points and sizing the opportunity.
  • Analyze user engagement and behavior including feature adoption, engagement frequency, and content consumption, and identify the leading indicators of retention and churn.
  • Develop cohort, retention, and lifecycle analyses, and translate behavioral signals into churn-risk and propensity models that CRM can act on.
  • Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments with Product and Growth teams, defining success metrics, sample sizing, and readouts.
  • Monitor subscription, churn, and revenue performance against forecast, and maintain forecasting and retention models.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting that give Product, Finance, and CRM a shared view of subscriber health.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education and Basic Qualifications

  • 5 or more years in product analytics, data analysis, or business intelligence, including ownership of recurring reporting that others depend on
  • Proven record of moving funnel metrics through experimentation: onboarding, paywall, trial, and conversion.
  • Strong command of A/B testing and statistics (power, significance, causal inference).
  • Strong command of subscription metrics: LTV, CAC, cohort retention, and conversion funnels.
  • Hands-on experience with subscription or recurring revenue metrics: cohort retention, churn, conversion, and LTV
  • Advanced SQL against a cloud data warehouse, with the ability to build and maintain models rather than only query them
  • Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Snowflake and Tableau proficiency
  • Python or dbt for transformation and pipeline work
  • Experience supporting a new product launch or a business in its first year of revenue
  • Familiarity with product and event analytics tools such as Amplitude, and with attribution logic
  • Consumer subscription, fitness, or direct-to-consumer background
